jobs.description:
Er du en engasjert helsefagarbeider som ønsker å gjøre en forskjell i menneskers liv?

Hjemmetjenesten Sør har ledig en fast stilling på 52% som helsefagarbeider på natt, og vi søker etter dedikerte medarbeidere til hjemmetjenesten i vår vakre distriktskommune.  Hjemmetjenesten sør har kontorer på Halsa, Vall, Meløya og Bolga i Meløy kommune. Den aktuelle stillingen vil per tiden ha base på Halsa og Vall.

Hjemmetjenesten yter tjenester til hjemmeboende i alle aldre som har rett på nødvendig helsehjelp i henhold til Helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven. Våre brukere har vedtak på hjemmetjeneste, middagslevering, trygghetsalarm og praktisk bistand. Gjennom hjelp til selvhjelp gis pleie- og omsorgstrengende mulighet til å bo i eget hjem så lenge som mulig. Hjemmetjenesten er bemannet 24 timer i døgnet hele året. Som helsefagarbeider i hjemmetjenesten vil du oppleve meningsfulle menneskemøter hver dag. Du får muligheten til å bidra til at våre brukere kan leve et trygt og godt liv hjemme. Arbeidsoppgavene er varierte og givende, og du vil være en viktig del av et inkluderende kollegium med en sterk delingskultur.
Våre brukere bor spredt i kommunen, det betyr en del kjøring i løpet av arbeidsdagen. 

Oppstart 2.november, eller etter avtale. Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Utøve pleie i overensstemmelse med yrkesetiske retningslinjer, avdelingens målsetninger og verdigrunnlag
  • Legge til grunn kunnskapsbasert praksis i eget klinisk arbeid
  • Observere, kartlegge, journalføre, iverksette og prioritere nødvendige tiltak ut fra brukerens behov.
  • Fortløpende tilegne seg kunnskap om og følge avdelingens rutinebeskrivelser for å ivareta pasientsikkerheten i egen arbeidsutøvelse.
  • Samarbeide tett med brukeren og deres pårørende i utøvelsen av tjenestetilbudet for å ivareta brukerens rett til brukermedvirkning
  • Samarbeid med kollegaer i avdelingen, overordnet ledelse, andre faggrupper og samarbeidspartnere
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Helsefagarbeider med autorisasjon (offentlig godkjent). Andre med relevant erfaring og forpliktelse til å påbegynne helsefaglig utdanning innen nærmere avtalt tidspunkt kan vurderes.
  • Du må beherske norsk godt, både skriftlig og muntlig. Dersom du har et annet morsmål enn norsk, svensk, eller dansk, må du dokumentere norskkunnskaper tilsvarende minimum B2-nivå.
  • Førerkort klasse B
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du er løsningsorientert, fleksibel og liker å jobbe med mennesker
  • Du har gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner
  • Du er ansvarsbevisst
  • Du evner å arbeide strukturert og selvstendig
  • Du ønsker å gjøre en positiv forskjell i brukers hverdag
Vi tilbyr
  • Er du ny i Meløy setter vi deg gjerne i kontakt med lokale lag og foreninger etter ditt interesseområde.
  • Som senior hos oss kan du fra fylte 62 år, få tilrettelagt for å kunne stå lengre i arbeid. Dette kan være tjenestefrie dager med lønn gradert etter stillingsstørrelse, tilpasset arbeidstid eller tilrettelegging av arbeidsoppgaver
  • I stillingen har du rett på en av Norges beste pensjonsordninger. Offentlig tjenestepensjon er en utbetaling som varer fra den dagen du slutter å arbeide og livet ut. Pensjonen inkluderer også uføre- og etterlattepensjon om noe uventet skulle skje.
  • Med pensjonsrett i KLP får du medlemspris og flere gunstige betingelser på lån, forsikring og spareprodukter. Du får fri ulykke- og gruppelivsforsikring.
  • En ny ordning for sletting av studiegjeld tredde i kraft den 1. januar 2025. Har du folkeregistrert adresse i Meløy kan du få slettet inntil 25 000kr av studielånet ditt hvert år. Du finner mer informasjon og detaljer om søknadsprosessen på Lånekassens nettsider: Sletting av gjeld i distriktskommuner.

Annet:

  • Vi gjør oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søkerne kan offentliggjøres selv om det er bedt om at søknaden unntas offentlighet. Søkerne vil i så fall bli varslet om dette.
  • Søknader der det ikke er ført opp utdanning eller praksis vil ikke bli vurdert.
  • Vitnemål må lastes opp i WebCruiter.
  • Dokumentasjon av opplysninger gitt i søknaden vil bli etterspurt i forbindelse med intervju, eller ved forespørsel.
  • Søkere med utdannelse fra andre land enn Norge må fremlegge godkjenning av sin utdannelse fra Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse/Nokut inklusivt vitnemål på engelsk eller norsk.
  • Politiattest av nyere dato må fremlegges før tiltredelse.
  • Helseattest for tuberkulose og MRSA skal fremlegges før tiltredelse.
  • Meløy kommune er opptatt av mangfold og oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uavhengig av alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, etnisitet eller nasjonal bakgrunn.
Kontaktinformasjon

Emma Rapunsel Østerhus Johnsen, Enhetsleder, +47 90223418, emmjoh@meloy.kommune.no

Arbeidssted

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vi er ca. 6 200 innbyggere i kommunen. Meløy er langstrakt, og den nordlige grensen er om lag 12 mil sør for Bodø.  Kommunen er en kraftkommune med industri, landbruk, fiske, fiskeoppdrett, kraftproduksjon og servicenæringer som viktige elementer. Ørnes er kommunesenter og er knutepunkt for hurtigrute, hurtigbåter, ferge og bussforbindelser.  Engenbreen, en vestlig utløper av Svartisen, er kommunens største turistattraksjon.  Vi har et desentralisert skole-, SFO- og barnehagetilbud, samt videregående skole.  Det er mye flott natur i kommunen vår, både i fjellet og ved fjorden, og rike muligheter til variert friluftsliv året rundt. Godt  utvalg i idretts- og kulturaktiviteter finner du også i Meløy. 

Har du en samboer, ektefelle eller venn som også ønsker seg jobb i Meløy? Nettsiden meloy.no gir deg en oversikt over ledige stillinger i Meløy kommune innen både kommunal sektor, industri og annen næring. Kanskje finner dere stillinger der som vil være interessant for dere begge?

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Digital Entrepreneurship
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for position as PhD Research Fellow in Digital Entrepreneurship available at the Department of Informatics.

The fellowship period is three (3) years. Starting date no later than January 5, 2027.

Depending on the candidate and the teaching needs of the department, the fellowship period can be extended with a fourth year for compulsory work consisting of e.g., teaching and supervision duties and research assistance.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is the Department of Informatics at Ole-Johan Dahls hus, Oslo.


Job description

Entrepreneurial culture celebrates failure as a teacher: founders share their fiascos on stage, post-mortems circulate as cautionary tales, and "fail fast" has become a mantra. Research, too, increasingly samples failed ventures to extract lessons for founders, investors, and policymakers. Yet a foundational assumption underlying all of this remains largely unexamined: that failures carry rich, transferable lessons, knowledge useful to others beyond those who failed.

This PhD project investigates failure in digital ventures: how and why digital startups stagnate and shut down, what their founders learn from the experience, how they narrate it, and more fundamentally what kind of knowledge venture failures can offer anyone beyond those who experience them directly.

The project combines conceptual work on the informational value of failure cases with qualitative empirical studies. A well-defined empirical setting is already identified: the candidate will recruit and study ventures founded by alumni of the Department's MSc programme in Entrepreneurship and Innovation Management who have received STUD-ENT funding over the past decade. 

The candidate will have genuine influence on the design of the individual studies. Possible research questions include how founders narrate and attribute their ventures' outcomes; whether they treat what they learned as specific to their case, or as broadly applicable lessons, ones they carry into future ventures or that others could learn from; and how discontinued ventures compare with closely matched surviving ones.

The position is affiliated with the Entrepreneurship (ENT) group, and the candidate will be actively involved in the group's daily research, teaching, and social activities. The dissertation will be article-based, with supervision by faculty in the ENT group (main supervisor: Associate Professor Daniel Leunbach) and a co-supervisor from the Digital Innovation (DIN) group. The position also offers opportunities for co-authorship with other faculty at the Department and access to the Department's broader research environment on information systems, entrepreneurship, strategy, and digital transformation.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in entrepreneurship, innovation, management, information systems, informatics, psychology, or another field relevant to the project
  • Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • A strong interest in, and preferably documented experience with, qualitative research methods (e.g., interviewing, narrative analysis, comparative case studies)
  • Demonstrated ability to engage with abstract, conceptual, or theoretical work
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

Candidates without a master’s degree have until 15 December 2026 to complete the final exam.

Desired qualifications:

  • Personal experience from entrepreneurship or the startup ecosystem, including ventures that did not succeed; we regard such experience as a strength
  • Familiarity with the Norwegian or Nordic entrepreneurship and innovation eco-system
  • Proficiency in a Scandinavian language is an advantage for fieldwork, but is not a requirement

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. For more information see:
http://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Strong analytical ability and rigorous, independent reasoning
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Reliability, thoroughness, and the ability to work independently over the course of a multi-year research project
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods
  • The ability to approach research participants who have experienced venture failure with professionalism, curiosity, and care

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We can offer you
  • A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (maximum two pages) describing your motivation, relevant background, and initial reflections on the project theme
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications)
  • Transcripts of records, copies of the original Bachelor’s and Master’s degree diploma (see below)
  • Documentation of English proficiency, if applicable
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee (e.g., a copy of the Master’s thesis or a draft, if not yet completed)
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job". Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Informatics (IFI) is one of nine departments belonging to the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. IFI is Norway’s largest university department for general education and research in Computer Science and related topics. 

The Department has more than 1800 students on bachelor level, 600 master students, and over 240 PhDs and postdocs. The overall staff of the Department is close to 370 employees, about 280 of these in full time positions. The full time tenured academic staff is 75, mostly Full/Associate Professors.

jobs.title: Researcher in Solar Physics
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a Researcher position at the Rosseland Centre for Solar Physics (RoCS) at the Institute of Theoretical Astrophysics (ITA).

The position is for a period of 2 years.

Starting date is flexible between 1st of January 2027 and 1st of October 2027.

Place of work is Rosseland Centre for Solar Physics, Institute of Theoretical Astrophysics at Blindern, Oslo.


Project description

The position is funded by the Research Council of Norway through the Researcher Project for Early Career Scientists (FRIPRO) “MultiSCORE: Multi-scale structure of the coronal environment” and led by Petra Kohutova. The MultiSCORE project focuses on the formation of large- and small-scale structure in the solar corona and combines high-resolution solar observations with numerical modelling. The successful candidate will contribute to the observational aspect of the project using multi-vantage-point observations of the solar corona from Solar Orbiter and the Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO). The candidate will work on the analysis of fine-scale structure in the corona using Solar Orbiter/EUI imaging and SPICE spectroscopic data, and on reconstruction of three-dimensional structure of active regions by combining multi-vantage-point Solar Orbiter and SDO/AIA observations with constraints from magnetic field extrapolations. Observational results will be compared with synthetic observables from numerical models. The candidate will be expected to participate in the dissemination of the research results through journal publications and conference presentations in Solar Physics and Astrophysics as well as through outreach activities.


What skills are important in this role?

Doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and completed defence are eligible for appointment.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English 
  • Experience with Solar Orbiter data analysis
  • Programming skills in Python/IDL/Julia

jobs.title: Logistikchef
jobs.description:
Arbetsbeskrivning

Rollen som logistikchef hos oss innebär ett helhetsansvar för logistikflödet – från planering till leverans – med fokus på leveransprecision, kvalitet och kostnadseffektivitet. Du arbetar både strategiskt och operativt – nära verksamheten, affären och våra samarbetspartners. Du blir en del av fabrikens ledningsgrupp och rapporterar direkt till Plant Manager. Du har också en Planeringschef underställd Logistikchef som ansvarar för ca 17 pers. På hela logistik arbetar det ca 130 pers inkl konsulter Verksamheten är en högvolymsfabrik som levererar över 550 000 artiklar per vecka till ett flertal stora kunder. Vi söker en ledare som vill vara med på vår utvecklings- och förändringsresa. Rollen är på 100 % och utgår från vår fabrik i Färgelanda.

    Tydlig och kommunikativ ledare: Du är en trygg chef som sätter klara ramar och arbetsbeskrivningar, samtidigt som du coachar ditt team till att tänka nytt och fatta egna beslut.
    Prestigelös och handlingskraftig: Du är absolut "hands on" när det krävs, är lyhörd för organisationen men har samtidigt modet att stå fast vid fattade beslut.
    Analytisk och datadriven: Du fattar beslut baserat på fakta och data. Du har lätt för att göra analyser som räddar dagen här och nu, men också säkrar flödet för framtiden.
    Resultatorienterad: Du arbetar strukturerat mot uppsatta mål och följer upp verksamheten genom nyckeltal.

I den här rekryteringen samarbetar Artifex med Randstad. Tjänsten kan komma att bli tillsatt innan sista ansökningsdag, ansök därför så snart som möjligt. För information kontakta: Liza Dahlin, rekryteringskonsult e-mail: liza.dahlin@randstad.se



Ansvarsområden

    Resultat- och leveransansvar: Säkerställa hög leveransprecision, kundnöjdhet samt uppföljning av relevanta KPI:er kopplade till logistik och flöde.
    Logistikstyrning: Ansvara för lagerstyrning, kapacitetsplanering samt utveckling av effektiva material- och informationsflöden.
    Leverantörssamverkan: Säkerställa effektiva samarbeten med leverantörer och interna funktioner för att optimera flöden och tillgänglighet.
    Förbättringsarbete: Driva och implementera förbättringsinitiativ enligt våra principer.
    Hälsa och säkerhet: Driva och prioritera arbetsmiljö- och säkerhetsfrågor som en naturlig del av den dagliga verksamheten.




Kvalifikationer

    Erfarenhet: Gedigen och stor erfarenhet inom logistik samt ett dokumenterat framgångsrikt ledarskap.
    Branschbakgrund: Erfarenhet från fordonsindustrin (Automotive) och förståelse för dess komplexa processer är starkt meriterande. Alternativt har du bakgrund från någon större logistikaktör samt arbetat med logistikflödet kopplat till produktion.
    System och IT: God vana av SAP samt mycket starka kunskaper i Excel.
    Språk: Då vi arbetar på en internationell marknad krävs mycket goda kunskaper i både svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
    Geografiskt fokus: Vi ser gärna att du bor i exempelvis Trollhättan, Uddevalla eller Stenungsund med omnejd då det passar bäst för pendling.




Om företaget



Artifex Systems AB

Artifex Systems AB is a trusted partner in the European automotive supply chain, delivering high-quality components and systems to leading premium vehicle manufacturers. With three strategically located sites in Sweden—Låssby (Gothenburg), Skara, and Färgelanda—we operate as a unified and agile business unit, capable of managing the entire journey from concept design to finished products.
Our strength lies in combining engineering expertise with advanced manufacturing to provide complete, reliable solutions tailored to customer needs. Driven by a culture of continuous improvement, we are committed to sustainable innovation that balances performance with responsibility. By fostering long-term partnerships with global automotive brands, Artifex Systems AB positions itself as a future-ready supplier, dedicated to shaping the next generation of mobility.
Vision: Provide tailor-made interior and exterior solutions, driven by passion, precision and the power of our people. Driving Innovation with Purpose.
Mission: Create tailor-made interior and exterior solutions for the global automotive industry premium segment. With a strong focus on design, precision, and material quality, we deliver components that enhance both the experience and value of every vehicle.

jobs.title: 🌙 Trygg nattevakt søkes - fast deltidsstilling med mulighet for ekstravakter
jobs.description:
Litt om oss

Vi er foreldre til ei tenåringsjente som trenger litt ekstra støtte i hverdagen. På dagtid er hun aktiv, sosial og full av liv - men på natten er det viktigste at hun og vi får sove trygt og godt. Derfor søker vi etter nattevakter som kan være til stede og skape ro og trygghet.

For oss betyr BPA at hun kan ha et mer selvstendig liv, og at vi som foreldre kan være uthvilte og ha overskudd til å være nettopp det vi ønsker å være - mamma og pappa. Din jobb som nattevakt gir oss alle bedre dager fordi vi vet at natten er ivaretatt.

Som nattevakt hos oss er du våken gjennom natten og følger med dersom hun trenger hjelp. Store deler av natten er rolig, men din rolle er avgjørende - både for hennes trygghet og vår nattesøvn. Du har et selvstendig ansvar, men er samtidig en viktig del av teamet rundt henne.

For oss betyr det alt å vite at hun sover trygt om natten og at vi også kan få hvile. For deg betyr det en jobb med mening - der du gjør en forskjell hver eneste natt.

Vi har nå ledig en liten fast stilling tilsvarende én nattevakt annenhver uke. For den rette kandidaten vil det i tillegg være gode muligheter for å ta ekstravakter, og for den som ønsker å jobbe mer vil det ofte være anledning til å ta ledige nattevakter.

✨ Høres dette ut som en stilling for deg? Da håper vi å høre fra deg snart - vi intervjuer fortløpende.


Kvalifikasjoner og egenskaper

Formelle krav

  • Plettfri vandel (politiattest)
  • Gode ferdigheter i norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig (minimum B2-nivå)
  • Du må være fylt 18 år
  • På grunn av arbeidets art søker vi kun kvinner

Vi ser etter deg som

  • har evne til å bygge gode relasjoner og skape trygghet
  • er til stede, rolig og løsningsorientert i arbeidshverdagen
  • møter vår datter med respekt, varme og nysgjerrighet
  • er personlig egnet – dette vil bli sterkt vektlagt

Mye mer enn bare penger

Visste du at med erfaring fra jobben som personlig assistent er du ettertraktet også i andre jobber?

Når du jobber så tett på mennesker som assistenter gjør, får du en helt egen kunnskap om relasjonsbygging. Du får kunnskap og erfaringer som er unik og verdsatt i arbeidslivet! All arbeidserfaring er relevant for BPA assistenter. Vi mener at BPA ikke er en helsetjeneste, våre BPA-assistenter skal bidra til at våre vedtakseiere hver dag får en bedre hverdag!

Hva du får som assistent i BPA Nord:

  • Sikre deltids- og heltidsstillinger | Varierte arbeidstider
  • Kurs og god opplæring | Assistentmanual
  • Timelønn som ligger over gjennomsnittet i liknende jobber
  • Kompetanseutvikling via gratis E-læringskurs
  • Kveld/natt/helg- og helligdagstillegg
  • Pensjonsavtale for alle ansatte uavhengig av stillingsstørrelse
  • Personalforsikringer (Yrkesskade, Fritidsskade, Gruppeliv og DNBs døgnkontinuerlige Helsetelefon)
  • Verneombud | Bedriftshelsetjeneste
  • Enkle digitale registreringssystemer
  • En ekte nordnorsk arbeidsgiver – nær, varm og på lag med deg

Vil DU bidra til en bedre hverdag for mennesker med assistansebehov, samtidig som du får en spennende CV?
Søk assistentjobb hos BPA Nord!

Gjennom BPA legger vi til rette for at mennesker med funksjonsnedsettelser kan leve selvstendige liv med frihet, valgmuligheter og innflytelse over egen hverdag. Vår visjon er en bedre hverdag!

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Front-end Engineer who’s excited to shape how people at the world’s largest companies work with AI day to day.

At Magentic, you’ll have a huge amount of ownership over the product experience, building the interfaces through which enterprise users collaborate with AI agents operating in real time. You’ll also play a key role in evolving our frontend technical practices and driving the architecture as we scale.

We’re redefining how people interact with enterprise software. We’re rethinking what great enterprise software looks and feels like, and building intuitive experiences for complex, high-impact workflows.

You’ll be working at the cutting edge of human-computer interaction, helping us define new patterns for how people interact with increasingly intelligent software.

We’re building next-generation agentic systems that can manage entire procurement workflows, with a mission to make global manufacturing supply chains more resilient to an ever-changing world. That’s a $3tn market opportunity.

We’re backed by world-class investors including Sequoia Capital, and you’ll be joining an exceptional team bringing together experience from OpenAI, Meta, Revolut, NASA and McKinsey.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the development of high-quality user-facing experiences, from early ideas through to production

  • Help drive the architecture and technical direction of our frontend as the product and engineering team scale

  • Improve frontend engineering practices, raising the bar for code quality, performance, testing and maintainability

  • Work directly with users to understand their problems and make complex AI workflows feel simple and intuitive

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design and Engineering to shape what we build and continually increase the impact of our product

You Might Be a Great Fit if You:

  • Have 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience building complex frontend applications

  • Are highly proficient in TypeScript/JavaScript and React

  • Have strong frontend architecture experience and have helped improve technical practices within an engineering team

  • Have experience building products powered by LLMs or other AI technologies

  • Thrive in an early-stage, high-ownership environment where you can move quickly, influence decisions and communicate effectively across technical and business teams

Bonus Points:

  • Comfortable moving between product thinking, interaction design and frontend implementation

  • Have experience building or evolving scalable design systems

  • Have worked on complex, data-heavy enterprise products

  • Familiarity with supply chain, procurement or manufacturing domains

  • Comfortable working with Python

Compensation and Benefits:

At Magentic, we recognise and reward the talent that drives our success. We offer:

  • Competitive Equity: play a real part in Magentic’s upside.

  • Salary: £120,000 - £135,000 per annum

  • Visa sponsorship available

  • Hybrid London HQ (3 days in the office).

  • Company provided meals at the office

  • Monthly “Social budget” to spend getting to know your colleagues (coffee, food, activities, etc.)

  • Salary sacrifice pension and nursery schemes

  • Annual team retreat—a fully-funded off-site to recharge, bond, and build.

Our interview process:
We can move quickly through these stages, so let us know if you have any timelines we need to meet.

  • Initial call (30 mins): this first step is an opportunity for you to hear more about Magentic and the role, and for us to learn more about how your experience aligns with the role.

  • Paired programming interview (45-60 mins): we'll give you an exercise to demonstrate the key skills for the role.

  • In-person interview: for the final step, we invite you to come meet the team in-person and work alongside us! We find this is the best way for candidates to get a sense of what working at Magentic is like. This will include a culture interview, a founder interview and skills-based interview(s) with the team.

 

Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement

At Magentic, our mission is to build AI that helps solve some of the world's most complex real world problems. We believe building a diverse workforce will be the key to solving this for our customers.

 

Magentic is committed to creating a truly inclusive team and we’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. As we grow, we're intentional about building teams with a broad range of backgrounds, experiences and viewpoints, recognising that this leads to better ideas, stronger collaboration and better outcomes for our customers therefore we strongly encourage applications from all backgrounds and cultures to apply.

 

We recognise that some groups remain underrepresented within the industry and are committed to creating an environment that celebrates and supports everyone.

 

Everyone works differently, and we want to ensure our interview process gives you the best chance to show us what you can do. If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let us know and we'll work with you to make the process accessible.

 

Responsible AI Statement
At Magentic, we are committed to developing artificial intelligence that benefits humanity. We push the limits of AI's capabilities and are dedicated to its responsible and safe deployment. Recognising the profound impact of AI, we ensure that its development is centred around human needs and safety, incorporating a wide array of perspectives to fulfil our mission.

jobs.title: Head of Territory Management
jobs.description:
Head of Territory Management

London

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.

We’re looking for a Head of Territory Management to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us lead and develop a team of Territory Managers to drive commercial performance, build deep relationships with London's best local restaurant partners, and elevate local market strategy.

Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Central London team. Central London is Deliveroo's heartland, spanning a diverse restaurant scene. You will lead a team of Territory Managers, working cross-functionally to refine localized commercial strategies and elevate partner performance.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Lead and develop a field team: Line manage and coach a team of up to six Territory Managers, setting territory-level strategies to retain and grow the best local selection.

  • Drive regional commercial performance: Set macro and micro territory KPIs, boosting partner performance through advertising sales, local visibility, and co-marketing initiatives.

  • Optimise partner operational health: Ensure your team actively tracks and improves restaurant operational metrics to enhance marketplace supply and customer experience.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with Sales Managers and Client Partners to identify cuisine gaps, win key accounts, and build long-term commercial relationships.

  • Provide strategic market insights: Serve as the internal voice of the London territory, delivering on-the-ground context and market intelligence to senior leadership.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Proven commercial leadership: Demonstrated line management experience, with a track record of leading, coaching, and developing commercial or account management teams.

  • Commercial and strategic capability: Strong problem-solving ability with experience interpreting data to devise, implement, and track territory growth strategies.

  • Senior stakeholder influence: Excellent presentation and communication skills across face-to-face, virtual, and written channels, with the ability to influence internal and external leaders.

  • Agility and problem-solving: Ability to take initiative, adapt quickly in dynamic environments, and proactively mitigate commercial or operational risks.

  • CRM and software proficiency: Hands-on experience using CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar platforms to oversee pipeline and team performance.

Nice to Have

  • Field sales management: Direct line management experience overseeing field sales, field account management, or territory-based teams.

  • Multilingual capabilities: Proficiency in additional languages, particularly Arabic, Spanish, Portuguese, Swahili, Mandarin, Cantonese, Urdu, Korean, Vietnamese, Thai, Japanese, or Bahasa/Malay.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

Trust is foundational to an on-demand marketplace. Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt are converging European capabilities into one platform and one global product capability to prevent fraud and abuse. The marketplace is expanding rapidly beyond just restaurants as we become “your door to more." As we add new products, geographies, ways for Consumers, Merchants and Couriers to engage, we’re expanding and enhancing our fraud capabilities to be best in the industry at keeping our platform safe and trustworthy. We strongly believe that trust is the most important attribute of an online marketplace, and the team ensures that we maintain this trust.

We are looking to hire for a few roles, so you’ll either lead a vertical fraud team protecting Consumers, Couriers or Merchants, or lead a horizontal fraud platform team focused on building our Risk Engine, Data Signals Intelligence and Automation / Anomaly Detection capabilities or leading compliance and authenticity efforts involving Identity Verification and Right to Work. The Fraud team is in hyper growth in terms of its size and impact and offers a unique opportunity to set and execute on a vision that will shape the future of Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt globally.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Partner with Finance and Business Leaders to manage the impact on the profitability of the overall business.

  • Establish success metrics and executive reviews covering fraud trends and P&L impact.

We’re excited about you because you have…

  • Experience defining strategic vision and roadmap execution in a given product area.

  • Demonstrated experience shipping AI-enabled or automation-heavy products, with sound judgment about where models can accelerate decisions and where human expertise, safeguards, and accountability must remain central.

  • Experience in technology, fraud, privacy, security, data governance, trust & safety, risk or an enthusiasm to learn and keep customers and the ecosystem fraud-free and protected

  • Strong ability to translate ambiguous policy, legal, or regulatory requirements into practical, scalable product solutions and clear engineering priorities.

  • Fluency in modern AI product development, including evaluating model quality, designing human-in-the-loop experiences, and translating emerging capabilities into practical, measurable customer and business value.

  • Extreme customer centricity with a focus on ensuring low-friction experiences for good customers.

  • An analytical, structured approach to ambiguity and risk, with the ability to frame tradeoffs, define controls, and set measurable outcomes.

  • Experience partnering effectively with Legal, Compliance, Public Policy, Security, Privacy, Operations, Data Science, Design, and Engineering.

  • An interest in applying AI and data-driven systems to improve fraud detection, triage, escalation, and prevention, with sound judgment about safeguards and human oversight.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to align senior leaders around urgent, high-stakes decisions.

  • Direct experience applying AI/ML to prevent, prevent, detect and mitigate harm, plus AI fluency — you can build a feature with AI – not just write PRDs.Why Join Us?

jobs.title: Head of Business Development - Mobile Power Solutions
jobs.description:
What you will do

As Head of Business Development - Mobile Power Solutions, you will lead the commercial development agenda across our global Sales and Service Market organization.



Our business provides mobile power solutions across both combustion engine and electrified applications, serving customers in segments such as mining, agriculture, material handling, forestry, special vehicles, on-road and construction. In this role, you will take a holistic view of the customer and business lifecycle, from winning new business and supporting market introduction to creating long-term value from the installed base.



You will translate market trends, customer insights, demand development and competitive intelligence into clear commercial priorities and growth opportunities. This includes developing commercial plans across markets and segments, identifying new applications, partnerships and aftermarket opportunities, and ensuring that the voice of the market is represented in our product and service development.



A key part of your responsibility will be to understand how changing technologies and customer needs, including the transition from combustion engines to electrified solutions, impact our business. You will establish relevant commercial KPIs, develop market outlooks and ensure that analysis leads to concrete actions that strengthen sales, profitability and customer value.



You will also facilitate alignment between global and regional organizations, challenging us with a strong outside-in perspective on what we need to do to win – today and throughout the lifecycle of our products.



Your future team

You will be part of the Global Sales & Service Market organization and work across a broad international network of commercial, product and market functions.



The role involves close collaboration with regional organizations and colleagues across Sales, Service Market, Product Management and other key functions. You will operate across diverse customer segments, markets and technologies, creating alignment around commercial priorities and long-term growth opportunities.



You will join an environment characterized by collaboration, high ambitions and a shared focus on creating customer value and profitable growth.



Who are you?

You are a strategic and commercially driven leader who combines a strong market perspective with analytical capability and a clear focus on execution. You are equally comfortable developing long-term direction, working with detailed business analysis and turning insights into action.



We believe you have:

    Proven experience in business development, commercial strategy, sales, service market or market development, preferably in a global B2B environment
    Strong commercial and analytical capabilities, including experience with profitability, pricing, forecasting and business cases
    Experience working across multiple markets, customer segments and functions in an international organization
    Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to create alignment across organizational and geographical boundaries
    A proactive and entrepreneurial mindset with a strong customer focus and the ability to translate market insights into business opportunities



Experience from mobile power, engines, off-highway equipment, mining, agriculture, forestry, material handling, automotive, electrification or industrial technology is highly valuable.



What’s in it for you?

This is an opportunity to influence the direction of a global business during a significant transformation of the mobile power industry.



You will have broad exposure across markets, customer segments and technologies, with the opportunity to shape commercial strategy, new business development, aftermarket growth and long-term customer value.



The role combines strategic influence with tangible business impact and gives you the opportunity to contribute to how we position and grow our business as technology and customer requirements continue to evolve.



Ready for the next move

If you are motivated by complex commercial challenges, global collaboration and turning market opportunities into profitable growth across the entire customer lifecycle, we look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Bovärd
jobs.description:
Willhem söker bovärd till Halmstad

Är du händig och genuint intresserad av att hjälpa människor? Trivs du dessutom med ett praktiskt jobb med en liten del administration? Då är detta tjänsten för dig! Nu söker vi en engagerad och serviceinriktad bovärd till vårt kontor i Halmstad.

Hos Willhem välkomnas du till ett nyskapande bostadsbolag som kännetecknas av en framåtsträvande och hjälpsam kultur. Du kommer att ingå i ett team med engagerade kollegor, där vi hjälps åt och där vi tillsammans jobbar för att nå våra mål.

Willhem Halmstad äger och förvaltar ca 3000 lägenheter placerade i Andersberg, Nyhem, Linehed och i Centrum. Som bovärd hos oss är du den som har ögonen ute i fastigheten och den som säkerställer att våra hyresgäster får en fortsatt riktigt bra service. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att felsöka, reparera och avhjälpa fel som uppstår i våra kunders lägenheter. Under ledning av fastighetsförvaltaren ansvarar du för fastigheterna samt vårdar och utvecklar relationen med våra hyresgäster.

I dina arbetsuppgifter ingår:

    planera och utföra reparationer och löpande underhåll
    hantera och dokumentera serviceanmälan, synpunkter och reklamationer
    utföra rondering i ditt fastighetsområde
    utföra lägenhetsbesiktningar
    beställningar samt attest av fakturor
    utföra tillsyn av ventilation och värme i våra fastigheter
    skapa och upprätthålla en bra relation till hyresgäster och rapportera hyresgästsynpunkter

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som har gymnasieutbildning, gärna med inriktning mot, eller påbyggnad inom, teknik och/eller fastighet. Du är en händig problemlösare med kunskap och erfarenhet inom minst några av områdena, VVS, lägenhetsbesiktning, SBA, ronderingsarbete eller el. Vidare har du erfarenhet av kundnära fastighetsarbeten. Du bör ha god vana av att arbeta i datasystem och B-körkort är ett krav.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. Som bovärd styr du mycket över din tid så vi söker dig som är ansvarsfull och som kan planera din arbetsdag. Du har ett stort driv och får gärna komma med idéer om hur vi kan förbättra våra områden. Din förmåga att arbeta självständigt är god men du fungerar lika bra i grupp då vi lägger stor vikt vid att samarbeta och hjälpas åt. Som bovärd arbetar du i nära samarbete med våra biträdande förvaltare. Vårt mål är att leverera den bästa servicen till våra hyresgäster och där kommer du att ha en nyckelroll, så en förutsättning för att trivas är att du är servicemedveten och tycker om kundkontakt.

Willhems erbjudande

Du kommer att välkomnas av ett gäng på ca 20 kollegor i en grupp som präglas av engagemang, hjälpsamhet och bra ledarskap, där dina idéer uppskattas! Hos Willhem blir du en del av ett utvecklingsorienterat företag med engagerade medarbetare som har ett stort fokus på trivsel på arbetet. Vi erbjuder förmåner som friskvårdstimme, ett generöst friskvårdsbidrag, kompetensutveckling och regelbundna trivselaktiviteter.



Ansökan:

Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 17 september via: http://jobb.willhem.se/. Urval kommer att ske löpande och tillsättning kan komma att ske innan sista ansökningsdatum, så vänta inte med att söka! Har du några frågor om tjänsten ber vi dig kontakta fastighetsförvaltare Lukas Engkvist via mail: lukas.engkvist@willhem.se eller telefon 035-280 42 68

Innan erbjudande om anställning genomförs en bakgrundskontroll innehållande rättslig och ekonomisk bakgrund.

På Willhem jobbar vi för att både hus och människor ska må bra. Som ett av de ledande bostadsbolagen i Sverige är vår vision att skapa hyresbostäder där människor trivs och kan känna sig stolta över sitt boende. Huvudkontoret ligger i Göteborg och ca 310 personer arbetar idag hos Willhem. Marknadsvärdet på fastigheterna uppgår till 62 miljarder och ägare är Tredje och Fjärde AP-fonden. Läs mer om oss, vår historia och våra värderingar på story.willhem.se

I 2024 vedtok kommunestyret planen «Saman om EIN god oppvekst» – ein førebyggande plan for barn og unge som legg føringar for tverrfagleg samarbeid og heilskaplege tenester i kommunen.

jobs.title: Database Engineer
jobs.description:
PostgreSQL Database Engineer with Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration experience – this opportunity is for you. Join a large-scale, business-critical database migration where you will take a key hands-on role in moving database services from Oracle to PostgreSQL. You will combine deep technical expertise with ownership and close collaboration with development teams in a large international technology environment.

Job description

As a Database Engineer, you will play a central role in the end-to-end migration of database services from Oracle to PostgreSQL. The assignment is highly technical and hands-on, while giving you the opportunity to take technical ownership and act as an important link between development teams and the database environment.

Working closely with developers and database specialists, you will translate application requirements into reliable and practical PostgreSQL solutions. You will review and validate database schemas, configurations and application changes to ensure accuracy, compatibility and performance throughout the migration.

A key objective is to ensure a smooth transition with minimal disruption to business-critical services. The applications do not contain PL/SQL code, meaning no PL/SQL conversion is required as part of the assignment.

Key responsibilities

    Lead and provide hands-on technical support throughout the Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration
    Work closely with development teams and database specialists throughout the migration journey
    Translate application requirements into practical and reliable PostgreSQL solutions
    Review and validate database schemas, configurations and application code changes
    Ensure database performance, compatibility and accuracy throughout the migration
    Troubleshoot PostgreSQL-related issues and contribute to technical decision-making
    Work with Liquibase for database schema versioning and migration
    Contribute to a migration approach that minimizes downtime and disruption to business-critical services
    Document technical findings, learnings and best practices for future database migrations

We are looking for someone who

    Has extensive professional experience as a PostgreSQL DBA, Database Engineer or PostgreSQL Developer
    Has deep technical knowledge of PostgreSQL and is comfortable working hands-on with databases
    Has previous experience with Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration projects
    Has a good understanding of Oracle databases and Oracle-to-PostgreSQL datatype mappings
    Has experience working with database schemas, SQL, configurations and database performance
    Has experience with or a good understanding of Liquibase and database schema versioning
    Is comfortable working independently within an established migration framework
    Is proactive, structured and able to take technical ownership of complex migration activities
    Has strong communication and collaboration skills and enjoys working closely with software development teams
    Is fluent in English, both spoken and written, as this is the primary working language

Nice to have

It is considered an advantage if you have experience with:

    Java applications connected to PostgreSQL
    Distributed systems and event-driven architectures
    Kafka and/or Solace
    Migrating high-traffic or business-critical services with minimal downtime
    AI-assisted development workflows and tools such as Cursor, Claude or similar agent-based solutions

Great emphasis will be placed on your ability to combine deep technical expertise with a collaborative mindset. We believe you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, taking initiative and helping development teams move forward throughout the migration.

About the client

Our client is a large international company within the gaming and digital entertainment industry, operating high-traffic digital services across multiple markets. Technology is at the core of the organization, with a strong focus on developing and modernizing scalable, reliable and business-critical platforms.

In this assignment, you will become part of a technically complex environment where database reliability, performance and availability are essential to the business.

Due to the confidential nature of the recruitment process, further information about the company will be shared at a later stage.

About the employment

This is a 12-month consulting assignment, where you will be employed by Friday and work as a consultant for our client.

Other information

    Scope: Full-time
    Start: As soon as possible, with consideration to any notice period
    Location: Central Stockholm
    Contact: Axel Stubbing, axel.stubbing@friday.se

About Friday

At Friday, we are passionate about helping tech talent find opportunities where they can grow, develop and look forward to going to work. By understanding what motivates you, we match you with companies and assignments that fit both your skills and ambitions.

We value potential and ambition and actively work towards an unbiased recruitment process where everyone is given the same opportunity to succeed.

jobs.title: Business Solution Architect, Lund
jobs.description:
As our Business Solution Architect, you'll play a key role in connecting business needs with impactful system solutions-driving transformation across our global Operations. In this role, you'll balance strategic thinking with hands-on analysis to secure long-term value and operational excellence.
Based in Lund, Sweden, you will be a vital link between business, systems, and our future digital landscape

Who is your future team?
You will join the Cross Functional Projects & Systems team, an team within the Operations organization. We drive impactful change by managing cross-functional initiatives, overseeing the Operations project portfolio, and ensuring strong business system product ownership and solutions.

Our work strengthens Operations in delivering on its mission and long-term strategy while contributing directly to Axis' global efficiency and success.
The team is part of Operations Development, a diverse group of 20+ specialists with expertise in Supply Chain & Operations Management, Digital Transformation, Project Management, Innovation, Contract Management and Analytics.

What you'll do as a Business Solution Architect
As a Business Solution Architect, your mission is to bridge operational challenges with the right technical opportunities and scalable solutions. You will move between strategic thinking and hands-on, detailed analysis-connecting business needs, system capabilities, and long-term development paths.

You will work closely with operational teams to understand processes, improvement opportunities, and future ambitions. Together, you will shape solutions that solve current challenges while strengthening Axis for tomorrow.

You will also collaborate deeply with Business Systems Product Owners (BPOs), other Business Solution Architects, and our IT organization. This role truly requires one foot in business and one in systems, with a broad and strong supply chain & operations domain perspective and the ability to navigate between architecture, product development, and operational realities.

Your time will be split between:

    Contributing as a key resource in transformative projects
    Driving and supporting improvement initiatives
    Participating in system product development, roadmap work, and architecture alignment

Strong ERP knowledge is essential, and experience with IFS and/or MS Dynamics 365 is a strong plus.

Your main responsibilities include:

    Lead the end-to-end solution process - from need intake and requirements to use cases, documentation, testing (scenarios & execution), and validation of outcomes
    Define clear goals and deliverables for initiatives - including measurable targets, expected results, and supporting business cases (ROI, cost-benefit)
    Design and document solution concepts-including process flows, integration maps, and architectural diagrams-that align with our system landscape and long-term strategy
    Collaborate closely with business functions, BPOs, IT, vendors, and consultants to ensure solutions are feasible, scalable, and aligned across the organization
    Evaluate and investigate development potential in our ERP platform, and its interaction with surrounding best of breed systems supporting Demand & Supply Planning, Transportation Management, Supplier Collaboration, to name a few
    Assess ERP change requests together with requesters, IT, and BPOs, and propose the best way forward
    Contribute to our digital roadmap by ensuring that tools, processes, and data models evolve in line with future needs
    Support analytics development by providing domain insights and input for BI solutions and data management
    Provide solution expertise from a product/business requirements perspective regarding integrations, system features, and data structures-while also stepping up to provide tactical and strategic direction
    Contribute actively in agile product (ERP) development: backlog refinement, prioritization, roadmap planning, and solution validation
    Translate business needs into clear requirements and solution proposals that keep the end user and required business capabilities in focus
    Act as a project resource or workstream lead in major initiatives within Operations

Who are we looking for?
You are an analytical, curious, and positive person who thrives in a dynamic environment where change is constant and opportunities are abundant. You can shift comfortably between detailed system exploration and higher-level strategic thinking-connecting dots and helping others see the bigger picture.

You enjoy solving complex problems, collaborating across organizational boundaries, and influencing stakeholders at all levels. You are self-driven, structured, and confident in planning your own activities to deliver high-quality results.

You bring experience from business systems product ownership (BPO), system development, and/or ERP-driven transformation initiatives. You understand integrations, data flows, and processes-and you enjoy working at the intersection of Operations, Supply Chain, and IT. Strong communication skills in both Swedish and English are essential.

We expect you to have:

    A relevant university degree (minimum B.Sc.) or equivalent experience
    At least 5 years' experience in system and process development
    Experience working in or closely with Supply Chain in a global environment
    Hands-on experience with supply chain platforms/systems
    Strong ERP experience (IFS or Dynamics 365 is a plus)
    Proven experience with product ownership, agile delivery, backlog and roadmap work
    Experience with solution blueprinting (process diagrams, architecture artifacts, requirements documentation)
    Understanding of system integrations and data flows
    Advantageous: experience from ERP implementations or major enhancement programs

Ready to Act?
We look forward to receiving your application!
If you have questions, please contact
Fredrik Schlyter, Manager Cross Functional Projects and Systems
+46 46 287 98 89

jobs.title: Socialsekreterare till Barn-Unga-Familj
jobs.description:
Är du socionom med erfarenheter inom den sociala barn och ungdomsvården?  Vill du arbeta i processen med att utreda och följa upp barns behov av skydd och stöd i någon av våra grupper för utredning, uppföljning av placerade barn och unga samt öppenvårdsinsatser? Vi söker nu tre socialsekreterare. En till varje grupp.

Division Social omsorg har det yttersta ansvaret för barn, ungdomar, vuxna och äldre som behöver stöd. Vårt arbete spelar en stor roll i många människors liv. Våra arbetsinsatser gör att samhället fungerar. Vi arbetar för att ha en helhetssyn där vi tar hänsyn till människors hela livssituation och i all verksamhet ska individens perspektiv beaktas. Vi arbetar utifrån MI, Motiverande Samtal, och vill att vår arbetsplats ska präglas av ”MI-anda”, en atmosfär och ett bemötande präglat av empati, acceptans, samarbete och respekt för autonomi och självbestämmande både i mötet med familjerna och med varandra.

Inom myndighetsdelen av området Barn-Unga-Familj finns tre enheter med cirka 40 medarbetare; Barn och Ungdomsenheten, Familjehemsenheten samt Familjerättsenheten. Grupperna har ett nära ledarskap av gruppledare och enheterna arbetar nära och tillsammans med varandra.  Vi tillhör verksamhetsområdet Individ- och familjeomsorg, IFO, som består av ytterligare enheter som jobbar med förebyggande och stödjande insatser för barn och unga, Barnahus samt vuxna med behov av stöd gällande beroende, våld i nära relation, försörjning, kompetens och arbetsmarknad. Vi vill se oss som en socialtjänst som samverkar för barnet/individens och familjens bästa.

3 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Tillsammans med kollegor kommer du att arbeta i processen där du utreder, bedömer, beslutar och följer upp barn och ungdomars livssituation i öppenvård och/eller placeringar. Som socialsekreterare i utredningsgruppen är fokus på att utreda och bedöma behov av stöd och skydd. I insatsgruppen följer du som socialsekreterare upp beviljade öppenvårdsinsatser. I ditt uppdrag som socialsekreterare kommer du genom samtal med barnet/ungdomen och dess viktiga vuxna sträva efter att få en helhetsbild av barnets situation och tillsammans med familjen och kollegor bedöma om det behövs stöd/skydd och motivera till detta. Att skapa tillitsfulla relationer och motivera samt följa upp och ge stöd över tid är en viktig del av ditt uppdrag som socialsekreterare.

Som socialsekreterare i familjehemsenheten kommer du följa placerade barn och ungdomar. Som barnets/ungdomens socialsekreterare har du ett särskilt uppdrag i att göra barnet/ungdomen delaktig och se till att hen får information och får komma till tals. Din uppgift är att verka för att det placerade barnet/ungdomen har det tryggt, har bästa möjliga umgänge med sina föräldrar och andra viktiga personer i nätverket. Du arbetar nära familjehemssekreterare som stödjer och följer det familjehem som barnet/ungdomen är placerad i.



Du kommer att ha många samverkande kontakter med exempelvis skola/förskola, polis, BUP och annan hälso- och sjukvård samt med andra enheter inom IFO och speciellt nära den Förebyggande enheten och deras familjebehandlare, behandlare inom öppenvården och Familjefridsmottagning samt Barnahus.

Vår verksamhet är i ständig utveckling och vi räknar med att du vill vara med och finna nya former för det goda sociala arbetet. Omställning inom ramen för nya socialtjänstlagen pågår och vi vill utifrån behov forma våra verksamheter så att de på bästa sätt möter de utmaningar som barn, ungdomar och deras familjer har.



Vi värnar om en gemensam grundsyn som präglas av barns rätt till delaktighet. Vi ser föräldrar som barns viktigaste vuxna och vi försöker hitta och stärka resurser i familjens nätverk och på hemmaplan så långt som möjligt.

Vi erbjuder ett intressant arbete i utveckling med många familjer och professionella i olika sammanhang.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som:

·         Är utbildad socionom - krav

·         Har erfarenhet av socialt arbete med barn, unga och familjer inom ramen för socialtjänstlagen och LVU.

·         Har ett gott och professionellt bemötande.

·         Är kommunikativ och uttrycker dig väl i skrift

·         Ser metodutveckling som en naturlig del i vardagsarbetet

·         Har körkort B



Som person har du givetvis en inkluderande människosyn, engagemang och ett genuint intresse för sociala frågor. Du inger förtroende, samarbetar bra med andra och har förmåga att tänka kreativt vad gäller metodutveckling. Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet. Före anställning krävs uppvisande av utdrag ur polisens misstanke- och belastningsregister.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare.

•Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas.

•Inom Nyköpings kommun används individuell och differentierad lönesättning.

•Denna tjänst kan komma att krigsplaceras i kommunens krigsorganisation vilket innebär att kommunen säkerställer tjänsten vid höjd beredskap.

•Tester i tidigt urval kan komma att användas i denna rekrytering.

•När du söker jobb hos oss vill vi att du använder vårt e-rekryteringssystem. På så sätt blir hanteringen av din ansökan effektiv, snabb och säker.

•Vi undanber oss alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons.

•Vi begär utdrag i belastnings- och misstankeregistret vid tillsättning av denna tjänst enligt lagen (SF 2026:43). Ytterligare information ges i samband med eventuellt anställningserbjudande.

•Tjänsten tillsätts under förutsättning att den inte behöver tas i anspråk för redan anställd personal.

Are you a senior developer who enjoys balancing hands-on development with technical leadership? Do you thrive in environments where technology has a direct impact on customer experience, business growth and digital innovation?

 

NutraQ is an international, technology-driven company operating across 15 European markets and the US. As our business continues to grow, we are strengthening our eCommerce team and establishing a new key role: Tech Lead eCommerce.

 

This is a unique opportunity to take technical and professional lead within the eCommerce team and shape the development of our platforms. You will play a central role in shaping our technical direction, guiding a distributed development team and ensuring our ecosystem continues to support growth, scalability and great customer experiences.

 

Alongside Head of eCommerce and UX, you will drive the development and continuous improvement of our platform, translating business needs into robust technical solutions that drive conversion and customer satisfaction.

You will report to the Head of eCommerce and be part of a professional and experienced tech-team of developers and UX designers. Together with the team you will be a key contributor to NutraQ's continued investment in technology and digital development.

 

What you will be responsible for

  • Ensure high-quality delivery by coaching and supporting in-house tech team and external developers, promoting knowledge sharing and building strong technical capabilities across the team.
  • Provide technical guidance on architecture, technology choices and implementation.
  • Actively contribute to hands-on development, including coding and implementation, while promoting coding standards, technical best practices and high-quality solutions.
  • Drive engineering efficiency and team output by integrating modern AI tools, automated processes, and optimized workflows into daily practices.
  • Drive improvements across our web ecosystem, including CMS, performance, integrations, customer journeys and functionality.

What you bring

We believe the right candidate combines strong technical capabilities with a pragmatic mindset and the ability to create direction and engagement among developers.

 

You likely bring:

  • Strong experience in web development, ideally within D2C e-commerce or subscription-based businesses.
  • Strong full-stack skills across modern frontend frameworks, backend systems, APIs and CMS platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with technology used for modern web applications. We use React, Next and .NET as of now.
  • Experience across the full development lifecycle, from architecture and technical direction to implementation and optimisation
  • Experience mentoring, coaching or technically guiding developers.
  • Experience working with CMS platforms and modern web technologies.
  • Excellent communication skills in English; Scandinavian languages are a plus.
  • Exceptional drive and proactive approach.
  • Curiosity and a strong interest in keeping up with technological developments.

Why join NutraQ?

At NutraQ, technology is a critical driver of business success. As Tech Lead eCommerce, you will have the opportunity to influence both technology and business outcomes in a highly visible role.

 

We offer:

  • The opportunity to combine technical lead with hands-on development.
  • Being part of a highly experienced and stable international development environment.
  • A dynamic and entrepreneurial culture with short decision-making paths and high trust.
  • The opportunity to work with modern technology, eCommerce and AI in an international company with ambitious growth plans.
  • Competitive employee benefits.
  • Modern offices at Skøyen in Oslo.
  • A unique and strong culture where our people focus on having fun, collaboration and development.

If this sounds like the right next step for you, we look forward to receiving your application.

Please contact Christina Waale Salomaa (+47 909 769 86 / cws@greatpeople.no) or Elisabeth Hagen (+47 924 12 119 / eh@greatpeople.no) for a conversation about this exciting opportunity.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NutraQ group is a leading international company within the health and beauty industry, owned by Orkla. We develop, produce and distribute a broad range of products directly to consumers through a digital non-binding subscription business model, with a turnover around 1,4 billion NOK.

 

Founded in 2002, by two Norwegian entrepreneurs, the company is today part of Orkla; one of the most influential investment companies in Norway.

With more than 230 employees, broad international presence across 15 European markets and the US, NutraQ holds a strong commercial standing with high standards and a culture that embraces entrepreneurship, integrity and diversity. The NutraQ headquarter is located in central Oslo, at Skøyen.

jobs.title: Ploegbaas hogedrukreiniging beton
jobs.description:
Ploegbaas hogedrukreiniging beton

Wat ga je doen?

Stuur de werken op de werf aan en werk zelf mee met ultrahogedrukinstallaties tot 2500 bar. Jij combineert vakmanschap met verantwoordelijkheid.

Je gaat aan de slag bij Renotec, specialist in renovatie en restauratie van gebouwen en infrastructuur. Vakmanschap, innovatie en veiligheid staan centraal. Je werkt binnen een groeiende organisatie waar samenwerking, kwaliteit en ontwikkeling belangrijk zijn.

Als ploegbaas neem je de leiding over een ploeg van twee en werk je zelf actief mee. Met ultrahoge druk reinigen en bewerken jullie betonconstructies op uiteenlopende werven. Jij bewaakt de planning, veiligheid en kwaliteit en zorgt dat het werk vlot en correct verloopt.

-Je stuurt je collega aan en verdeelt de werkzaamheden op de werf.
-Je werkt zelf actief mee en bedient hogedrukinstallaties met een druk tot 2500 bar.
-Je reinigt beton en verwijdert beschadigde of versleten betondelen.
-Je bereidt betonconstructies voor op verdere renovatie- en herstelwerken.
-Je organiseert de opbouw en afbraak van de installaties op de werf.
-Je zorgt ervoor dat materiaal en machines correct en veilig worden gebruikt.
-Je volgt de veiligheids- en kwaliteitsvoorschriften nauwgezet op en ziet erop toe dat je collega hetzelfde doet.
-Je bewaakt de voortgang van de werkzaamheden en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor een correcte uitvoering.
-Je werkt op infrastructuurprojecten zoals bruggen, tunnels, parkings, gebouwen en grote rioleringen.
-Je verplaatst je naar verschillende werven in functie van de geplande projecten.

Klaar om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen én zelf de handen uit de mouwen te steken? Solliciteer vandaag nog – we leren je graag kennen! - Vaardigheden:
Wie ben jij?

Je hebt bij voorkeur relevante ervaring in de bouwsector.

Ervaring met hogedrukreiniging of betonherstel is een sterke troef.

Je beschikt over een rijbewijs B.

Je hebt technisch inzicht en kan veilig met machines en materiaal omgaan.

Je kan een collega aansturen, duidelijke afspraken maken en het overzicht op de werf bewaren.

Je bent fysiek in staat om actief en intensief werk uit te voeren.

Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit en veiligheid van de werkzaamheden.

Je werkt graag buiten en bent flexibel om op verschillende werven aan de slag te gaan.

Je werkt zelfstandig, maar hecht tegelijk veel belang aan een goede samenwerking.

Je denkt praktisch, neemt initiatief en zoekt naar oplossingen wanneer de situatie daarom vraagt.

Je bent in het bezit van een VCA-attest of je bent bereidt dit voor opstart te behalen

- Attesten:
: Je beschikt over een rijbewijs B.

Een VCA-attest is een plus. Heb je dit nog niet, dan ben je bereid dit vóór opstart via Asap te behalen.

- Opleidingsvereisten:
Een opleiding in de bouw is een plus. Relevante ervaring is belangrijker.

- Vakkennis:
Vakkennis: Je hebt ervaring in de bouwsector. Ervaring met ultrahogedrukreiniging of betonherstel, zandstralen is een sterke troef, maar geen vereiste.

- Talenkennis:
Goede kennis van het Nederlands.

jobs.title: Regioverantwoordelijke thuisverpleegkundige Home Care Bornem
jobs.description:
Als regioverantwoordelijke thuisverpleging bij Korian krijg je de ruimte om jouw expertise in te zetten binnen een multidisciplinair team. je coördineert en stuurt een team van zelfstandige thuisverplegers aan vanuit het Homecare hoofdkantoor en gaat indien nodig mee op ronde.

Je dagelijkse bezigheden bestaan uit:

  • je voert verpleegkundige handelingen uit volgens de geldende richtlijnen;

  • je bent aanspreekpunt voor bewoners, familie en artsen;

Samen met je collega’s zorg jij voor persoonsgerichte, kwalitatieve zorg en een sterke band met bewoners en familie. Daarnaast staan de kwaliteiten klinisch inzicht, communicatie en verantwoordelijkheid centraal. Die heb je nodig omdat je coördineert, observeert, beslissingen onderbouwt en als aanspreekpunt fungeert.
