jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
Location: Stockholm & Boden

Reporting to: Project Delivery Leadership

Function: Project Delivery

We are building one of the world’s most advanced greenfield steel plants; a fully integrated, low-carbon facility designed from the ground up for sustainability, efficiency, and future scalability. We are looking for an exceptional Head of Engineering to lead the engineering function within our Project Delivery team.

In this critical leadership role, you will own the end-to-end engineering delivery for the current Stegra Boden greenfield steel mill project and lay the foundation for replicating and scaling similar projects globally. You will build and lead a high-performing, multi-disciplinary engineering organisation while ensuring world-class standards in safety, quality, cost, and schedule in a complex industrial environment.

Key Responsibilities

    Build, lead, and develop a strong in-house engineering organisation covering all major disciplines (process, mechanical, electrical, civil/structural, automation, environmental, etc.).
    Define and drive the overall engineering strategy, technical standards, design philosophies, and ways of working for the project and future global rollouts.
    Ensure engineering deliverables meet the highest requirements for safety, quality, cost control, and schedule across all project phases (FEED, detailed design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and start-up).
    Oversee coordination and integration of engineering partners, EPC contractors, technology providers, and equipment suppliers.
    Lead field engineering, construction technical support, and quality assurance activities on site, with a strong focus on resolving technical issues in real time.
    Establish robust engineering governance, change management processes, document control, and lessons-learned systems.
    Manage the engineering budget, drive value engineering, and continuously improve engineering performance and productivity.
    Work seamlessly with Construction, Procurement, Commissioning, Operations, HS&E, and other functions to deliver truly integrated project execution.
    Champion a strong safety culture, embedding best practices in design for operational safety.

As a fast-growing company with minimal silos, you will be expected to contribute flexibly beyond core engineering tasks when needed.

What You will Bring

You are a collaborative, curious, and decisive leader who thrives in complex, high-stakes environments. You challenge conventional thinking constructively, build trust across teams, and are passionate about delivering transformative industrial projects.

We understand that not all candidates will fulfill all the requirements listed below. However, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below:

Essential qualifications and experience:

    10–15+ years of progressive experience in engineering leadership on large-scale capital projects, preferably in steel, metals, mining, oil & gas, chemicals, or other heavy/process industries.
    Direct experience on greenfield industrial projects (ideally steel plants, DRI/HBI facilities, or similar first-of-a-kind plants) from detailed design through construction and commissioning.
    Proven track record of successfully building and developing high-performing, multi-disciplinary engineering teams (50+ people, including matrix and external resources).
    Strong hands-on understanding of full project execution - from conceptual/FEED engineering to field realities, constructability, and start-up.
    Demonstrated success in managing complex interfaces with EPC contractors, technology licensors, and major equipment suppliers.
    Deep knowledge of relevant engineering standards, quality systems, risk management, and change control in heavy industry.
    Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at all levels in a multicultural, international setting.
    A genuine and visible commitment to safety leadership and the ability to embed a strong safety culture across engineering and construction teams.
    University degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Process, Civil, or another relevant engineering discipline (Master’s or Chartered/Professional Engineer status is a plus).

Highly advantageous:

    Experience with hydrogen and steel technologies (DRI, hydrogen reduction, EAF, Hot & Cold Rolling will be beneficial).
    Previous exposure to modular construction, digital twins, advanced automation, or BIM/3D model-based project delivery.
    International project experience and comfort working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial scale-up environment.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the engineering backbone of a landmark green steel project and build capabilities that will support replication. If you are an experienced engineering leader ready to take full ownership in a high-visibility, purpose-driven project, we would love to hear from you.

UPRAVLJANJE VSAKODNEVNEGA POSLOVANJA LOKACIJE IN ZAGOTAVLJANJE NEMOTENEGA IZVAJANJA STORITEV.
VODENJE, MOTIVIRANJE IN RAZVOJ EKIP ZA KAKOVOST TER OPERATIVNEGA OSEBJA.
VZDRŽEVANJE IN RAZVOJ PROFESIONALNIH ODNOSOV Z OBSTOJEČIMI IN NOVIMI STRANKAMI.
PREDSTAVLJANJE PODJETJA TRIGO PRI STRANKAH IN MED PRESOJAMI (AUDITI).
SPREMLJANJE KAKOVOSTI STORITEV IN DOSEGANJA OPREDELJENIH KPI KAZALNIKOV.
REŠEVANJE REKLAMACIJ STRANK IN KOORDINACIJA KOREKTIVNIH UKREPOV.
ORGANIZACIJA IN KOORDINACIJA PROJEKTOV, POVEZANIH S KONTROLO KAKOVOSTI IN INDUSTRIJSKIMI STORITVAMI.
PRIPRAVA POROČIL, ANALIZ IN PREDLOGOV ZA IZBOLJŠANJE POSLOVANJA.
AKTIVNO SODELOVANJE PRI ZAPOSLOVANJU, RAZVOJU IN OCENJEVANJU ZAPOSLENIH.
DELOVNO MESTO JE V ZAGREBU.
, IŠČEMO OSEBO, KI:  
NARAVNO PREVZEMA ODGOVORNOST IN VODI EKIPO DO REZULTATOV,  
JE USMERJENA K STRANKAM IN REŠEVANJU PROBLEMOV,  
ZNA DELATI SAMOSTOJNO IN SPREJEMATI ODLOČITVE,  
MOTIVIRA LJUDI IN RAZVIJA NJIHOVE POTENCIALE,  
RAZUME POSLOVNE KAZALNIKE IN UPRAVLJANJE STROŠKOV,  
SE DOBRO ZNAJDE V DINAMIČNEM PROIZVODNEM OKOLJU.

KAJ PONUJAMO:
DELO V MEDNARODNEM PODJETJU IN SODELOVANJE Z VODILNIMI PROIZVAJALCI V AVTOMOBILSKI INDUSTRIJI.
SAMOSTOJNO IN ODGOVORNO VODSTVENO DELOVNO MESTO.
MOŽNOSTI STROKOVNEGA RAZVOJA IN NAPREDOVANJA.
KONKURENČEN IN STIMULATIVEN PAKET PLAČILA.
PRENOSNI RAČUNALNIK IN MOBILNI TELEFON.

RAZPON PLAČE JE OD 1900€ - 2300€. ODVISNO OD IZKUŠENJ KANDIDATA.                          Pričakujemo: Izkušnje v avtomobilski industriji, proizvodnji ali industrijskih storitvah.
Napredno poznavanje paketa MS Office, zlasti Excela.
Prednost imajo kandidati z:
Izkušnjami na področju kakovosti (ISO 9001, IATF 16949, VDA in podobno).
Izkušnjami pri delu z OEM ali Tier 1 proizvajalci.,

Pri nas ne boste le opravljali dela — soustvarjali boste varno, spoštljivo in srčno okolje za ljudi, ki potrebujejo pomoč, podporo in razumevanje. Vaše delo bo obsegalo: izvajanje zdravstvene nege na negovalnem oddelku, spremljanje zdravstvenega stanja pacientov, sodelovanje v strokovnem in povezanem timu, ustvarjanje občutka varnosti, zaupanja in dostojanstva. Iščemo osebo, ki: ima strokovno znanje in odgovoren pristop do dela, opravljeno pripravništvo, zna prisluhniti človeku in delati s srcem, ceni timsko sodelovanje in medsebojno pomoč, želi svoje znanje razvijati in nadgrajevati. Kaj vas čaka pri nas? Delo z namenom in občutkom, da prispevate nekaj pomembnega, podpora sodelavcev in prijetno delovno okolje, mentorstvo in pomoč pri uvajanju, možnosti dodatnih izobraževanj in strokovne rasti, stabilna zaposlitev in koriščenje bogatih ugodnosti za zaposlene družbe Thermane.,

jobs.title: Nattvikariat - Personlig assistent till sportintresserad kille utanför Varb
jobs.employer: Ny Kraft Assistans i Halland AB
jobs.description:
NyKraft är ett privatägt företag inom LSS som bedriver personlig assistans i Halland. Företaget etablerades 2012 med kontor i Falkenberg. NyKraft värdesätter trygghet och det personliga mötet, av den anledningen finns mestadels av våra kunder och medarbetare i Falkenberg.
Målet är att erbjuda en personligare personlig assistans. Som kund hos NyKraft erbjuds man en individuell assistans som tillsammans med kunden är utformad efter dennes behov. Kunden är delaktig i rekrytering och i det slutgiltiga valet av assistenter.
Vi är anslutna till Fremia och har kollektivavtal.

Om jobbet:

Vi söker nu personal till vår kund strax söder om Varberg. Vikariat under perioden 11/11 2026 - 11/1 2027 på sysselsättningsgrad 65% med möjlighet till fortsatt arbete efter vikariatet.

Arbetspassen är förlagda som vakna nätter 23-07.

Det är ett dubbelbemannat ärende vilket innebär att man alltid är två stycken som jobbar samtidigt.
Vi söker dig som är mellan 25-35 år med stor social kompetens som gillar när det är högt i tak och gärna har en skämtsam relation med din kund och dina kollegor. Kunden föredrar manliga sökanden men personlighet och matchning er emellan är det viktigaste.

Arbetsuppgifter:

Att arbeta som personlig assistent är omväxlande och kan variera mycket från dag till dag. Det innebär även att ha ett meningsfullt arbete där du hjälper en annan medmänniska med de saker i vardagen som många tar för givet. Detta kan exempelvis vara att klä sig själv, laga mat, ta en promenad eller andra saker som är primära för att överhuvudtaget få vardagen att fungera.

Som personlig assistent behöver du ha empati och respekt för den du arbetar för. Yrket ställer höga krav på flexibilitet, ansvarstagande och engagemang. Din förmåga att arbeta utifrån kundens fokus och önskemål är avgörande för din lämplighet som personlig assistent.

Då det finns ett stort omsorgsbehov ser vi gärna att man har erfarenhet av detta men det är inget krav så länge man känner sig trygg med sådana situationer då en anställnings inleds med bredvidgång i kombination med utbildning för delegerade uppgifter.

Det är meriterande om du har ett sportintresse då det är vanligt förekommande att man kollar på bland annat hockey, fotboll, MMA och andra sporter tillsammans med brukaren.

Kvalifikationer:

•    Är lugn och tydlig i ditt förhållningssätt och kommunikation
•    Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift då det ingår att få och ge instruktioner om kunden
•    B-körkort

Meriterande:

•    Erfarenhet av arbete som personlig assistent
•    Erfarenhet av vård och omsorgsarbete

Språkkrav:
Svenska (Flytande)

jobs.title: Growth Engineer (all genders) SaaS/Fintech
jobs.description:
Every company in Germany has to keep books, file VAT and produce annual accounts. It is unavoidable, unloved and far more expensive than it needs to be, and it lands hardest on the smallest businesses.

mika is the infrastructure that takes it off them. None of this work is optional, which is what makes it infrastructure rather than a product, and the point of building it is to lower the cost of doing business in Germany.

From 100 to more than 700 customers in eight months, and still a small team. Which is why this role is broad, why you own an area instead of a slice of one, and why your scope grows at the speed you do. We work in English, we are international, our market is German. y positive surprise. Choosing one is also a big decision: several steps and several touchpoints before anyone moves. One ad and one landing page do not close it.

Tasks

You run our growth experiments end to end. You bring the questions worth answering, agree the hypothesis with the founders, build the test yourself, and measure it properly.

End to end includes the measurement. Instrumentation, attribution and whatever needs fixing in HubSpot for a result to be trustworthy are part of running the experiment, not somebody else's ticket.

We are looking for a marketer who can build, not an engineer who supports marketing. Knowing which hypothesis is worth the week matters more here than the code, and you write the German variants yourself instead of waiting for copy.

what you will do

  • Shape the test agenda with the founders, and sync with the rest of growth wherever an experiment touches their area
  • Build what the test needs: landing pages, flows, tools, integrations, automations. The simplest version that will confirm or kill the hypothesis, in days (or better hours) rather than sprints.
  • Be self-sufficient
  • Make the measurement trustworthy. Tracking, attribution, the data model and the HubSpot side of it. Our pipeline data is not yet reliable enough to steer by, and getting it there is part of the job.
  • Read results honestly, including when they kill your own idea, and write down what we learned so nobody relearns it in six months

Requirements

what you bring to the table

  • AI-native, not AI-curious. Claude or an equivalent is your daily sparring partner rather than a tool you open occasionally. You augment your own output with it and you automate the parts of your job that should not need a human. Here it is a baseline, not a differentiator: you would find working without it slow.
  • You are a marketer first. Funnel, messaging, positioning, offer, what actually moves a number. We’re not looking for an engineer who “builds what marketing wants”
  • We have a strong bias towards people who have been entrepreneurs themselves. You have built and launched something of your own, or run a function as if it were your own company.
  • You have run experiments without being handed hypotheses. Talk us through a real one: what you expected, what happened, what you changed.
  • Visual and copy judgment. You can lay out a page that looks intentional, write the headline, and say precisely why a weak version is weak.
  • Ideally you have worked with Hubspot, BigQuery, Chargebee/Stripe

the level we are hiring at

  • This is a senior individual contributor role and it stays one. Your influence grows
    through the scope of what you own and what you are trusted to decide, not through people reporting to you.
  • We care about the combination more than the years. Somebody with two years who hasgenuinely run their own experiments end to end beats somebody with ten who has alwayshad the hypothesis handed to them or people who executed for them.
  • We are relaxed about what this has been called on your CV. Growth engineer, growth
    hacker, technical marketer, creative technologist, solo founder who built their own
    funnel: if the description above is you, apply.

German at C1 or above is required. You write the variants and the messaging you test, and in this market that judgment cannot be delegated. English at B2 or above, since English is our working language.

Benefits

Base 70,000 to 100,000 + EUR depending on experience, plus stock options.

Three rounds: an intro conversation, a working session with a short case, and a final round with the founders. Depending on seniority there is an optional fourth conversation with one of our investors or mentors. One meeting happens in person in Berlin, and you hear back within a week at every stage, including if the answer is no.

why mika?

  • Real influence on what we test. You shape the agenda with the founders rather than working through somebody's backlog, on a funnel with a lot of untested surface and a budget behind it.
  • Room, and the expectation that you use it. We hire people who do not need managing and then give them space to grow into more than the job they were hired for. Fully flexible hours apart from the daily standup.
  • Founders in the detail with you, and no layer between you and a decision
  • Work that matters outside the building. Every experiment that works means more small businesses spending less time and money on paperwork they never chose.

Send us your CV plus something you built and something you tested. The test matters more to us than the build.

At mika, we value diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive. Join us in building the future of small business finance!

jobs.title: Demand Generation Lead (all genders) SaaS/Fintech
jobs.description:
There are millions of small and medium businesses in Germany, and each one loses time and money to the same unavoidable work: bookkeeping, VAT returns, annual accounts. It has to be done, nobody enjoys it, and it costs more than it should.

mika takes that work off them. Compliance is not optional, which is why we think of what we build as infrastructure rather than as a product, and why the goal is to lower the cost of doing business in Germany.

We grew from 100 to over 700 customers in eight months with a small team, and that is the reason this role is as wide as it is: an entire area to own, more to build than hands to build it, and room that grows with you. English internally, international team, German market.

the market you would be marketing into

Until now a business owner in Germany believed they needed a tax advisor for their tax compliance. We built a second path. A tax advisor was simply a given, so most people are not out looking for something like us, and when they hear an alternative exists the reaction is usually positive surprise. Choosing one is also a big decision: several steps and several touchpoints before anyone moves. One ad and one landing page do not close it.

Aufgaben

Pipeline is your number, and it is the number the whole plan scales with. Today most of our customers arrive through paid channels. What has not existed so far is a single owner for the question of which campaign we run, on what topic, with what priority. That is yours from day one.

This is an end-to-end role. You own the whole path from a stranger to a customer, not only the part that carries an ad budget. Most conversions on that path are not sales: a newsletter signup, a guide download, a webinar registration, a reply. Somebody has to see those as one system, know which step is leaking, and be equally comfortable fixing a bid strategy and rewriting a nurture sequence.

On budget. You run a six-figure monthly media budget from the start, and if the results hold there is effectively no ceiling: you get as much as you can deploy at a payback we are happy with. That is the deal, and it cuts both ways.

  • Own campaign initiation and prioritisation: what we run, when, on what topic. That is the part nobody currently does.
  • Run paid acquisition hands-on across Paid Search and Paid Social
  • Own the whole conversion path, including the steps that produce no revenue on the day
  • Own the unit economics and build the model yourself: cost per qualified conversation, blended CAC, payback, cohort contribution
  • Reach people before they are searching. A growing share of our market is people founding a company or thinking about it, who are not yet looking for an accounting provider at all.
  • Give sales lead quality, not just lead volume, and take their feedback on which sources actually close
  • Set clear weekly priorities for the junior people who support paid

Where your job ends. Our growth engineer builds the pages and the tracking, our creative lead produces the assets, and lifecycle sequences belong to our CRM and lifecycle manager. You own the campaigns, the briefs and the numbers.

Qualifikation

what you bring to the table

  • AI-native, not AI-curious. Claude or an equivalent is your daily sparring partner rather than a tool you open occasionally. You augment your own output with it and you automate the parts of your job that should not need a human.
  • You have generated pipeline as your own number, not supported somebody else who did
  • We have a strong bias towards people who have been entrepreneurs themselves, whether that was your own company or a function you ran as if it were one
  • You do not rely on anyone else to manage the channels for you. At least at the start you run the full cycle hands-on, ideally across both paid search and paid social.
  • You understand the entire cycle, from first touch through the soft conversions to closed revenue, and you know what a newsletter subscriber is worth to you
  • You understand unit economics well enough to build the model yourself
  • You have marketed a complex product where the buyer has to be taught something before they can buy, and you can build demand where there is no search volume to harvest
  • You have taste and you use it. You know within seconds whether a creative will work and whether it looks like a premium brand.
  • You take direct feedback without turning it into a debate

the level we are hiring at

  • If you have been the second person in a function somewhere good and this is your step up, that is the profile we want. As the team grows, the path from here leads to Head of or VP of this area.
  • We keep the team small by giving people leverage instead of headcount. That is why the AI point above is a requirement rather than a preference.

nice to have

  • German SMB audience, fintech or another regulated category. A product-led lane running next to a sales-led one. A network of specialists you can pull on. HubSpot, GA4, GTM and a working relationship with SQL.

German at C1 or above is required. Roughly 80 to 90 percent of what we run is in German, and judging whether a piece of copy lands is part of the job rather than something you can hand off. English at B2 or above, since English is our working language.

Benefits

Base 70,000 to 95,000 EUR depending on experience, plus a variable component tied to pipeline and payback, plus stock options. We would rather put a real range here than leave you guessing.

Three rounds: an intro conversation, a working session with a short case, and a final round with the founders. There is also a conversation with one of our investors or mentors, in this case somebody who knows demand generation properly. One meeting happens in person in Berlin, and you hear back within a week at every stage, including if the answer is no.

why mika?

  • Nobody has owned this before you. No predecessor's system to inherit, no playbook to follow, and nobody above you deciding what you may test.
  • Room, and the expectation that you use it. We hire people who do not need managing and then give them space to grow into more than the job they were hired for. Fully flexible hours apart from the daily standup.
  • Founders in the detail with you, and no layer between you and a decision
  • The freedom to kill what does not work, including things we started before you arrived
  • Work that matters outside the building. Every customer we win gets back time and money that was disappearing into paperwork.

Send us your CV and one campaign you are proud of, with the numbers behind it.

At mika, we value diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive. Join us in building the future of small business finance!

jobs.title: Psykolog till BUP öppenvårdsmottagning VÄST
jobs.description:
NU-sjukvården är en del av Västra Götalandsregionen och är ett av Sveriges större länssjukhus. Vi finns på NÄL (Norra Älvsborgs Länssjukhus) i Trollhättan och Uddevalla sjukhus. Sjukhusets upptagningsområde omfattar 280 000 invånare. Tillsammans är vi cirka 5 000 medarbetare som varje dag arbetar för att ge god och säker specialistsjukvård. Vi finns på västkusten och vårt område erbjuder en varierad natur med både hav, berg, skog och sjö.

Beskrivning

Barn- och ungdomspsykiatriska kliniken i NU-sjukvården har idag cirka 150 årsarbetare. Dessa består av behandlingsassistenter, fritidspedagoger, läkare, sjuksköterskor, kuratorer, psykologer, psykoterapeuter, teamsekreterare, dietister, specialpedagog, logoped och arbetsterapeuter.

Just nu är BUP-kliniken inne i ett stort utvecklings- och organisationsarbete för att utveckla verksamheten i relation till patienter och vårdgrannar. Det handlar om tillgänglighet, aktuella riktlinjer och vårdprogram och om hur vi ska organisera BUP-kliniken för att möta förväntningarna så som de ser ut idag. Vi behöver utmana våra invanda mönster och upptäcka nya möjligheter samtidigt som vi värnar om den erfarenhet som finns och om det som vi vet fungerar. Som medarbetare har du möjlighet att vara med och påverka hur framtidens BUP ska se ut.

BUP VÄST har sitt huvudcentrum på Uddevalla sjukhus samt utbudspunkter i Lysekil och Strömstad. Vi eftersträvar en god arbetsmiljö där våra medarbetare kan känna arbetsglädje, trygghet och stöttning i sin vardag. Tillsammans värnar vi om varandras hälsa och mående, har högt i tak och nära till skratt. För att trivas hos oss bör du tycka om att arbeta i team likväl som du är trygg i det självständiga arbetet.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som psykolog arbetar du med att göra barnpsykiatriska bedömningar, utredningar och behandlingar. Till stöd vid bedömningar och utredningar finns gemensamt framarbetade mallar, stöddokument och riktlinjer. Behandling kan ges individuellt till barn/ungdom, i familj eller i grupp. Vi arbetar utifrån olika metoder beroende på ärendets art och vad som bedöms lämpligast i det enskilda fallet, med utgångspunkt i Socialstyrelsens och våra regionala medicinska riktlinjer (RMR).

I arbetet ingår även att samverka med skola, socialtjänst, habilitering, barnmedicin samt andra instanser runt barn och familjer.

Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med övrig personal, teamledare och chef. Kvalificerad handledning finns inom mottagningen inom behandlings- och utredningsarbete. Mottagningen har en psykologiskt ledningsansvarig (PLA) som är del av ledningsgruppen. Psykologerna på mottagningen har återkommande möten för att lyfta professionsgemensamma frågor och ett tvärprofessionellt forum för reflektion återkommer under terminen.

Kvalifikationer

Legitimerad psykolog enligt svenska förutskrifter. PTP-tjänst är ej aktuellt för denna tjänst. Vi förutsätter att du har intresse för barn- och ungdomspsykiatri, att du är strukturerad, tydlig, ordningsam och flexibel samt har en vilja att arbeta och ingå i ett team.

Vi värdesätter egenskaper som god social kompetens där humor, framåtanda och positivt tänkande är en klar merit. Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet och vid egenskaper som en god samarbetsförmåga samt förmåga att arbeta självständigt.

Övrigt

Vid tillsättning av tjänst inom psykiatrin begär vi alltid utdrag ur misstanke- och belastningsregistret. Denna förfrågan sköts av arbetsgivaren.

Intervjuer kommer ske fortlöpande under hela ansökningstiden.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Om Västra Götalandsregionen

Hos oss blir du en del av en större helhet. Vi är 56 000 medarbetare i över 200 yrken som varje dag gör skillnad i människors liv i hela Västra Götaland.

Du bidrar till en trygg och jämlik vård samt till ett hållbart samhälle där miljö, kultur och goda kommunikationer skapar livskvalitet.

Vi är mitt i en digital utveckling där du får vara med och forma framtidens arbetssätt för att förbättra och förenkla vardagen för invånare och verksamheter.

Som tillsvidareanställd blir du krigsplacerad som en del av vårt gemensamma ansvar för att samhällsviktiga funktioner ska fungera även i kris.

Vill du veta mer om oss? På vår webb kan du läsa mer om våra förmåner och möta medarbetare som varje dag gör skillnad och utvecklas i sina yrken. https://www.vgregion.se/jobba-i-vgr/sa-ar-det-att-jobba-hos-oss/

Ansökan

Västra Götalandsregionen ser helst att du registrerar din ansökan via rekryteringssystemet. Om du som sökande har frågor om den utannonserade tjänsten eller av särskilda och speciella skäl inte kan registrera dina uppgifter i ett offentligt system - kontakta kontaktperson för respektive annons.

Till bemannings-, förmedlings- och rekryteringsföretag och till dig som är försäljare:

Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings-, förmedlings- och rekryteringsföretag samt andra externa aktörer och försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser. Västra Götalandsregionen har upphandlade avtal.

Jag är en tjej på 15 år som tycker om att umgås med min familj och hitta på roliga saker. För mig är det viktigt att få möjlighet att leva mitt liv på mitt sätt, vara delaktig i det som händer omkring mig och göra sådant som jag tycker om.
Som min personliga assistent finns du vid min sida och ger mig det stöd jag behöver i min vardag. Det kan handla om allt från att vara med mig hemma och umgås med familjen till att följa med på aktiviteter och andra saker jag vill hitta på. Jag söker nu en personlig assistent som vill lära känna mig och bli en trygg och uppskattad person i min vardag.

Om dig

Jag söker en kvinnlig assistent mellan 18-50 år. RÖKFRI.

Du är omtänksam, lyhörd och trygg i dig själv. Du förstår att personlig assistans handlar om att assistera mig i mitt liv och att ditt arbete därför behöver utgå från mig, mina behov och hur jag vill ha det.
Du behöver kunna vara närvarande och uppmärksam samtidigt som du har en god känsla för när du ska finnas nära och när du ska ta ett steg tillbaka. Jag uppskattar också om du är positiv, ansvarstagande och tycker om att hitta på saker.
Eftersom jag är 15 år är det viktigt att du trivs med att arbeta med ungdomar och kan skapa en trygg relation samtidigt som du respekterar min integritet och mitt självbestämmande.
Personlig omvårdnad och stöd i olika delar av min vardag ingår i arbetet, lyft förekommer så det är bra om du har en god fysik. Du får självklart en ordentlig introduktion så att du känner dig trygg i din roll.

Känner du att det här skulle kunna passa dig? Då hoppas jag att vi ses!

Tjänsten

Tjänsten är på deltid och innebär arbete några pass i månaden. Det finns även möjlighet att arbeta mer vid behov, exempelvis när ordinarie assistenter är frånvarande.
Arbetstiderna kan variera och förläggas till dagar, kvällar och främst helger.

För att anställas måste du uppvisa giltig ID-handling, eventuella dokument som styrker rätten till arbete inom Sverige samt utdrag ur polisregistret. Detta beställs på www.polisen.se 
**Välj det utdrag som heter **Arbete med barn med funktionsnedsättning.

Om Assistans i Balans:

Assistans i Balans anordnar - med lång och egen erfarenhet - högkvalitativ personlig assistans till personer med omfattande funktionsnedsättning i enlighet med LSS och Independent Living-rörelsen. Vi vill bidra till en jämlikare värld där alla oavsett funktionsnedsättning ges en möjlighet att leva ett självständigt liv med självbestämmande och självrespekt i fokus. Vår service är nära, personlig och kontinuerlig och vår ambitionsnivå är hög. Alla medarbetare får grundlig introduktion, fortlöpande utbildning, ta del av vårt värderingsarbete, friskvårdsbidrag och trygghet genom kollektivavtal (Fremia - Kommunal).

Läs mer på www.assistansibalans.se

jobs.title: Enhetschef upplysningstjänst
jobs.description:
Är du jurist och har erfarenhet av en kvalificerad ledarroll inom en statlig myndighet eller annan politiskt styrd organisation? Ta då ta chansen att söka jobb som vikarierande chef för Upplysningstjänst, vårt ansikte utåt. Var med och bidra till skolans framtid!

Om jobbet

Vi söker tillförordnade enhetschefer till de två enheterna för upplysningstjänst. Den chef som har lett båda enheterna ska vikariera som rättschef och avdelningschef under en period.

Du leder en av de två enheterna inom Upplysningstjänst. Upplysningstjänsten besvarar frågor och ger vägledning om skolans regelverk genom olika kanaler som telefon, e-post och sociala medier. De som hör av sig är huvudmän, skolledare och annan skolpersonal, föräldrar, medier och andra som har frågor om skolan. Upplysningstjänsten medverkar också som experter på mässor och konferenser samt ansvarar för sakinnehållet på sidorna om ansvar i skolfrågor på skolverket.se. Genom vår kunskap om bemötande av målgrupperna bidrar vi till Skolverkets övriga arbete. Enheterna för upplysningstjänst har 15 respektive 16 medarbetare, och arbetar tillsammans som en funktion.

Du ansvarar för enhetens budget, resultat, verksamhetsplanering och för enhetens kompetensförsörjning på kort och lång sikt. Tillsammans med dina medarbetare, den andra enheten för upplysningstjänst och med stöd av Skolverkets processer utvecklar du verksamheten så att enhetens uppdrag utförs på mest ändamålsenliga och effektiva sätt. Du följer regelbundet upp resultatet av enhetens arbete. I dina arbetsuppgifter ingår också att representera Skolverket externt och i media för ditt område.

Du är en del av ledningsgruppen för Rättsavdelningen, där du tillsammans med avdelningschefen och de fyra andra enhetscheferna bidrar till avdelningens och hela Skolverkets utveckling.

Att vara ledare på Skolverket innebär att leda med helhetsperspektiv, i partnerskap och i relation till omvärlden. Du skapar förutsättningar för utveckling och engagemang samt sätter tydliga ramar och förväntningar på dina medarbetare. Du är en bärare av Skolverkets kultur, värderingar och fattade beslut.

* * * * *

” Välkommen till en verksamhet som är en viktig del av Skolverkets arbete med att vägleda och stödja skolväsendet. Du leder kunniga och engagerade medarbetare och tillsammans bidrar ni till att alla barn och elever ska få en utbildning som är likvärdig och av god kvalitet i en trygg miljö”

Cecilia Höglund, vikarierande avdelningschef

* * * * *

Du arbetar på vårt moderna och rymliga kontor i Solna Business Park. Du kan också ha möjlighet att arbeta upp till 50 procent på distans.

Om dig

För att göra ett bra jobb och trivas hos oss behöver du stå för och leva upp till den statliga värdegrunden och till våra kärnvärden för medarbetarskap: förebild, tillit, ansvar, samarbete och utveckling. Läs mer på www.skolverket.se/jobb

För det här jobbet ska du ha

    juris kandidat-/juristexamen,
    aktuell erfarenhet som teamledare, samordnare, uppdragsledare eller liknande i någon form av kvalificerat arbete inom statlig myndighet eller annan politiskt styrd verksamhet,
    kunskap om det svenska skolväsendet,
    mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska.

Det är meriterande om du har chefserfarenhet, erfarenhet av att leda utvecklingsarbete och har erfarenhet av att svara på frågor från externa målgrupper.

Som person behöver du

    vara flexibel, kunna anpassa dig till nya förutsättningar och ha god förmåga att samarbeta,
    ha god självkännedom, kunna ge och ta feedback, vara bra på att lyssna och att kommunicera på ett tydligt sätt,
    ha ett gott omdöme och kunna fatta väl avvägda beslut där hänsyn tas till olika perspektiv.
    ha god förmåga att ta egna initiativ, kunna driva arbetet framåt och vara lösningsorienterad.

Viktigt att veta

Sista ansökningsdag ärden 9 september. Vi söker två enhetschefer, en till upplysningstjänst 1 och en till upplysningstjänst 2. Anställningarna är vikariat med start omgående och i ca 8 månader dock längst till och med att en ordinarie avdelningschef för Rättsavdelningen är i tjänst.

När du registrerar din ansökan får du svara på några frågor i stället för att bifoga ett personligt brev. Läs gärna igenom ansökningsformuläret och förbered dina svar innan du gör ansökan.

Läs mer om hur vår rekryteringsprocess går till under Att söka jobb hos oss på www.skolverket.se/lediga-jobb.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Skolverket arbetar för att alla barn och elever ska få en bra och likvärdig utbildning i en trygg miljö. Vi stödjer på olika sätt den svenska förskolan, skolan och komvux. Som medarbetare på Skolverket är du med och bidrar till att skapa goda förutsättningar för barns och elevers utveckling och lärande. Lär känna oss bättre genom att besöka vår webbplats www.skolverket.se/jobb. Vårt uppdrag – skolans framtid.

jobs.title: PhD position at the Department of Geography
jobs.description:
UiB - Knowledge that shapes society

UiB shall be among Europe's leading universities, internationally recognized for high quality in research and education. As a societal institution, we shall contribute to sustainable and democratic development and be an attractive and inclusive place to study and work.

Video: https://youtu.be/i4SDcLir6OcPhD position

There is a vacancy for a PhD position in System Dynamics at the Department of Geography. The position is within the project INTEGRATOR and for a fixed-term period of 3 years. Starting date is latest 1 April 2027.

System Dynamics Group at the Department of Geography

The System Dynamics group carries out research in several areas. The most important areas are: sustainability transitions, natural resources management, water-energy-food-ecosystems (WEFE) nexus, and model-based learning and communication. The group makes use of a variety of tools and techniques: stakeholder mapping, governance analysis, participatory modeling, non-linear feedback modeling, computer simulation, non-linear model analysis, interactive learning environments and decision-laboratory experiments.


About the project/work tasks:

Description of the INTEGRATOR project

The position is within the EU Horizon Europe project ‘Integrated Innovation Ecosystems for Transformative Nexus Governance towards Enhanced Water Resilience (INTEGRATOR)’. The overarching project objective is to strengthen Europe’s climate-resilient and fair water management by enabling anticipatory, evidence-based decision making at river basin scale under changing climatic and socio-economic conditions, directly supporting the implementation of the EU water strategy. Specific objectives of INTEGRATOR pertaining to this call include: (1) promoting system-wide transformation in water governance and management to strengthen resilience, preparedness, and fair allocation; (2) establishing site-specific, stakeholder-led strategies; (3) creating seasonal and long-term foresight by developing and coupling a suite of models, including data-driven, process-based, and system-dynamics approaches; (4) delivering a digital water intelligence system orchestrated by a prompt compiler translating human language into executable simulations.

INTEGRATOR is built on six case studies in Germany, Greece, Italy, Latvia, Spain and Türkiye with various socio-economic, sectoral development, land use, water quality and water quantity challenges. Among these case studies, two of them are particularly relevant to this call: (1) Ergene River Basin (Türkiye), a 17K km2 watershed and a major industrial and agricultural hub with 2M inhabitants, facing severe pressure on groundwater resources, water quality and allocation. (2) Jucar River Basin – Albufera system in Spain, a highly interconnected river-water-coastal continuum centered on the 210 km2 Albufera Natural Park with high ecological value, facing pressures from intensive irrigated agriculture, and urban and industrial development.

Responsibilities following the position:

The research fellow will use participatory system dynamics modelling and computer simulations to support INTEGRATOR in all work packages (abbreviated as WP), with a concentrated focus on two WPs: WP3 (Participatory Co-Design for Resilient and Equitable Water Solutions using a Decision Theatre Approach) is going to strengthen inclusive and transformational governance through structured participatory process in the INTEGRATOR’s Decision Theatres (DTs). More specifically, WP3 will deal with stakeholder mapping, problem co-definition, participatory scenario analysis and policy exploration embedded in INTEGRATOR’s Decision Theatres Approach (DTA). WP6 (Digital Water Intelligence System and the HydroFellow) is going to provide a Digital Water Intelligence System (DWIS) and a prompt compiler, integrating multisource information, including models and model generated data. More specifically, WP6 will work on integrated hydrological and system dynamics modeling, site-specific digital twin development and integration, and the prompt compiler HydroFellow development through interaction with the DTs. The research fellow will be working on the Ergene and Albufera case studies to fundamentally support the activities under WP3 and WP6 through systems thinking, dynamic systems modeling and computer simulations.


Qualifications and personal qualities:
  • The applicant must hold a master’s degree in System Dynamics or another discipline with a strong system, modeling and simulation focus. The master’s degree must have been completed by the application deadline.
  • The requirements are generally a grade B or better on the Master thesis and for the master’s degree in total.
  • Applicants must demonstrate a strong interest in socio-economic-hydrological scenario building; experience in participatory model-building is desirable.
  • Applicants must have strong quantitative and computational foundations.
  • Teaching assistance experience in the field of System Dynamics will be considered an advantage.
  • The applicant must be proficient in both written and oral English. Proficiency in Spanish and/or Turkish languages will be considered an advantage.
  • Applicants must be able to work independently and in a structured manner.
  • Applicants should have experience of working as a member of a multidisciplinary and multicultural research team and demonstrate good collaborative skills.
  • Experience in interdisciplinary working, linking social/economic and environmental sciences, is desirable.
  • Personal and relational qualities will be emphasized. Ambitions and potential will also count when evaluating the candidates.
  • The place of work for this position is Bergen, and the work requires that you are physically present at the Department of Geography on a daily basis.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview. 


About the PhD position:

The duration of the PhD position is 3 years. 

About the PhD training:

As a PhD research fellow, you will take part in the PhD programme at the Faculty of Social Sciences, UiB. The programme corresponds to a period of three years and leads to the PhD degree. To be eligible for admission you must normally have an educational background corresponding to a master’s degree with a scope of 120 ECTS credits, which builds on a bachelor’s degree with a scope of 180 ECTS credits (normally 2 + 3 years), or an integrated master’s degree with a scope of 300 ECTS credits (5 years). Master’s degrees must normally include an independent work of a minimum of 30 ECTS credits. It is expected that the topic of the master’s degree is connected to the academic field to which you are seeking admission.


We can offer:
  • Salary as PhD (code 1017) NOK 593 700,- per year. Automatic salary increases for up to 3 years with a 3% annual increase 
  • A good and professionally challenging working environment
  • Enrolment in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Good welfare benefits

Project proposal:

A research proposal of maximum 2500 words (excluding reference list) must accompany the application. The project description should present the topic, the research questions(s) and choice of theory and methods. It should also include a progress plan for the different parts of the project. The research proposal must also include a short description of how the applicant envisions a fit with the INTEGRATOR project. Admittance to the PhD programme will be based on the research proposal. The faculty has prepared a guide for writing project descriptions.


Your application must include:
  • A cover letter including a brief account of your research interests and motivation for applying for the position
  • The names and contact information for two reference persons. One of them must be the main advisor for the master's thesis or equivalent thesis
  • Project proposal
  • CV
  • Transcripts and diplomas showing completion of the bachelor's and master's degrees.
  • Relevant certificates/references
  • A list of academic publications
  • Academic publications that you want to submit for assessment (including your master’s thesis or equivalent)
  • If you have a master's degree from an institution outside of the Nordic countries, or a 2-year discipline- based master's degree (or the equivalent) in a subject area other than the one associated with the application, you may later in the application process be asked to submit an overview of the syllabus for the degree you have completed

The application and appendices with certified translations into English or a Scandinavian language must be uploaded at Jobbnorge following the link on this page marked “Apply for this job”.

Closing date: November 1, 2026.

Applications submitted without a project proposal or applications sent as e-mails will not be considered. Only submitted documents will be subjected to an expert assessment.


General information:

Detailed information about the position can be obtained by contacting Professor Ali K. Saysel, ali.saysel@uib.no.

Practical questions regarding the application procedures, please contact the HR section at: personal.svfa@uib.no. 

Appointed research fellows will be admitted to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Social Sciences. Questions about the programme may be directed to Adviser Elina Troscenko, elina.troscenko@uib.no

Diversity is a strength that enables us to solve our tasks even better. UiB therefore needs qualified employees regardless of gender, ethnicity, religion, worldview, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, and age.

The University of Bergen applies the principle of public access to information when recruiting staff for academic positions.

Information about applicants may be made public even if the applicant has asked not to be named on the list of persons who have applied. The applicant must be notified if the request to be omitted is not met.

The successful applicant must comply with the guidelines that apply to the position at all times.

We encourage applicants with disabilities, immigrant backgrounds, or gaps in their CV to apply. By indicating such circumstances in your application, you may receive favourable consideration. We ensure that at least one qualified applicant from each of these groups is invited for an interview as part of our commitment to inclusivity and equal opportunity. For further information about the recruitment process, click here.


Life as a PhD candidate at UiB

Marion Claireaux tells about life and work as a PhD candidate at UiB.

The University of Bergen is a renowned educational and research institution, organised into seven faculties and approximately 54 institutes and academic centres. Campus is located in the centre of Bergen with university areas at Nygårdshøyden, Haukeland, Marineholmen, Møllendalsveien and Årstad.

jobs.title: Er du en trygg og tålmodig veileder?
jobs.description:
Vil du gjøre en forskjell for mennesker som trenger støtte for å beholde eller komme i jobb?

Vi søker etter deg som er trygg i møte med mennesker i sårbare situasjoner, og som evner å være raus, tålmodig og tydelig. Du brenner for å skape muligheter i arbeidslivet, og er ikke er redd for å ta kontakt med arbeidsgivere for å åpne dører for dem vi følger opp.

Nav Eiganes og Tasta har ledig en fast stilling som veileder i vårt team for oppfølging av unge under 30 år som står helt eller delvis utenfor arbeidslivet.
I denne rollen vil du kartlegge den enkeltes muligheter, ressurser og behov, og bidra til at flere kommer nærmere arbeid eller utdanning. En viktig del av jobben er å motivere og støtte mennesker gjennom endringsprosesser, styrke troen på egne muligheter og bidra til mestring på veien mot arbeid og aktivitet.

Du vil samarbeide tett med lokalt næringsliv og andre samarbeidspartnere for å finne gode løsninger, samtidig som du forvalter Nav sitt regelverk og saksbehandler i henhold til gjeldende lover og retningslinjer.

Kontoret er lokalisert i Byfjordparken 15 på Tasta. Vi har cellekontor, små lukkede landskap med 2 til 4 medarbeidere og et større åpent landskap. Kontoret disponerer biler som brukes til ekstern møtevirksomhet.

Hvis du ønsker en givende og meningsfull jobb med gode kolleger, faglige utfordringer og utviklingsmuligheter, håper vi at du søker på stillingen som veileder hos oss!

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Følge opp personer som står helt eller delvis utenfor arbeidslivet, med mål om arbeid eller utdanning.
  • Kartlegge den enkeltes ressurser, muligheter og utfordringer, og utarbeide mål og planer i samarbeid med personen som mottar oppfølging.
  • Bygge gode relasjoner og gi tett, helhetlig og arbeidsrettet oppfølging til mennesker i ulike livssituasjoner.
  • Motivere, støtte og utfordre mennesker i endringsprosesser, og bidra til mestring, utvikling og tro på egne muligheter.
  • Gjennomføre oppfølgingssamtaler og veilede om rettigheter, plikter, ytelser og aktuelle tiltak.
  • Samarbeide aktivt med arbeidsgivere, utdanningsinstitusjoner og andre samarbeidspartnere for å skape muligheter for arbeid og inkludering.
  • Veilede i bruk av Nav sine digitale tjenester og bidra til økt digital mestring.
  • Forvalte Nav sine virkemidler og regelverk, samt saksbehandle i tråd med gjeldende lover, forskrifter og retningslinjer.
  • Dokumentere oppfølging og sikre god kvalitet i veilednings- og forvaltningsarbeidet.

Nav er i stadig utvikling og endring. Det må derfor påregnes at andre oppgaver og ansvarsområder kan bli lagt til stillingen ved behov, herunder tilknytning til annen avdeling eller annet team

Kvalifikasjoner

Du må ha:

  • Fullført utdanning tilsvarende bachelorgrad fra universitet eller høyskole, gjerne innen sosialfag, samfunnsfag, pedagogikk, arbeids- og velferdsfag, psykologi eller andre relevante fagområder. Relevant erfaring og/eller utdanning kan kompensere for utdanningskravet.
  • God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevner med gode norskkunnskaper. Ved annet morsmål enn norsk, må språknivået tilsvare B2-nivå.
  • God digital kompetanse og evne til å ta i bruk nye systemer og arbeidsverktøy. Vi ønsker at du også har erfaring med Microsoft 365.
  • Erfaring med veiledning- og motiveringsarbeid, fortrinnsvis mot arbeid eller aktivitet.

Det er også en fordel om du har:

  • Erfaring fra saksbehandling og lovanvendelse.
  • Erfaring fra å kontakte bedrifter og organisasjoner.

Vitnemål, attester og tilsvarende må legges ved søknaden elektronisk på søknadstidspunktet. Utenlandske utdanningsgrader må være godkjent av NOKUT eller Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse.

Vi er mer opptatt av hva du kan, dine erfaringer og kompetanse, enn hvor flink du er til å skrive en jobbsøknad. Derfor ber vi deg om å levere en god og beskrivende CV hvor du får frem hva du har gjort og oppnådd som gjør deg kvalifisert for stillingen du søker på. I tillegg kommer vi til å be deg svare på noen korte spørsmål, som en del av søknadsprosessen. Du trenger altså ikke å skrive eller legge ved et søknadsbrev.

Personlige egenskaper

For at du skal kunne oppleve mestring og trives i jobben over tid, ser vi det som svært viktig at du innehar disse personlige egenskapene:

  • Samarbeider med andre: Du bygger gode relasjoner og samarbeider godt med både kolleger, arbeidsgivere og andre samarbeidspartnere.
  • Problemløsende: Du ser muligheter, finner løsninger og evner å håndtere komplekse problemstillinger i samarbeid med den enkelte.
  • Påvirker og inspirerer: Du motiverer og engasjerer mennesker i endringsprosesser, og bidrar til tro på egne muligheter og mestring.
  • Planlegger og strukturerer: Du arbeider systematisk, håndterer flere saker samtidig og sikrer kvalitet i oppfølging og saksbehandling.
  • Motstandsdyktig: Du står trygt i krevende situasjoner, håndterer motgang på en konstruktiv måte og bevarer ro og fokus i en hektisk arbeidshverdag.

Personlige egenskaper vektlegges sterkt og det vil bli benyttet DNV-GL-sertifisert personlighetstest i rekrutteringsprosessen.

Vi tilbyr
  • En spennende arbeidshverdag med varierte og givende arbeidsoppgaver.
  • Dyktige medarbeidere og et godt arbeidsmiljø.
  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter, blant annet gjennom relevante kurs og  mulighet for videreutdanning innen eksempelvis Forvaltningsrett og kollegaveiledning.
  • Fleksibel arbeidstid.
  • God forsikring- og pensjonsordning gjennom Statens Pensjonskasse.
  • Fast stilling som veileder i stillingskode 1434 Rådgiver, med lønn 640.000-680.000.

Les mer om Nav som arbeidsgiver på www.nav.no

Kontaktinformasjon

Cecilie Westergaard, Avdelingsleder, 993 70 935

Arbeidssted

Byfjordparken 15
4007 Stavanger

Referansenr.: 5171832118
Stillingsprosent: 100%

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nav søker ansatte med hjerte for mennesker og våre fagområder. Vår visjon er å gi mennesker muligheter, og dette gjør vi ved å utvikle Norges beste arbeids- og velferdstjenester.

Nav består av 22 000 kompetente og engasjerte medarbeidere. Vi jobber tverrfaglig i sterke fagmiljøer. Hos oss skal arbeidsmiljøet preges av involvering, åpenhet og tillit.

Mangfold er viktig i Nav. Mangfold bidrar til bedre problemløsing, økt kreativitet, større fleksibilitet og styrker kulturen og arbeidsmiljøet på arbeidsplassen. Vi oppfordrer derfor kandidater med ulik bakgrunn til å søke på stillinger hos oss, spesielt om du har hull i CV-en, innvandrerbakgrunn eller nedsatt funksjonsevne.

Når du søker jobb hos oss, vil navnet ditt stå på en offentlig søkerliste. Ønsker du å bli unntatt fra offentlig søkerliste må du begrunne dette. Del gjerne ditt vitnemål eller karakterutskrift via vitnemålsportalen.no.

jobs.title: Cloud Architect - Alibaba Cloud (H/F)
jobs.description:
About the position

As part of the global modernization of its infrastructure, our client is migrating its workloads currently hosted on end-of-life physical RKE servers in China to managed services from a Chinese cloud provider. This strategic project, estimated to last 12 months, aims to design a modern, automated, and highly available target architecture.



Contrat : Project-based permanent contract (CDI) or Freelance contract, project with an initial duration of one year (completion scheduled for summer 2027).

Location : Montbéliard area, an on-site presence of at least 2 days/week will be required for the first 2 or 3 weeks during the scoping phase.









Your responsibilities:

Reporting to the IT department's technical team, your responsibilities will be as follows:

Scoping and Estimation: Conduct the technical feasibility study, define the target architecture, and present the detailed estimation to the CIO in September.

Architecture Build: Design and build the infrastructure on a Chinese cloud provider (such as Alibaba Cloud), focusing on managed services.

Automation & Deployment: Replicate the existing automation mechanisms on GCP using Terraform and deploy the new clusters via Helm.

Friction Point Resolution: Design network architectures (SD-WAN, cross-border line) to maintain API connectivity with Google, manage authentication interoperability (Google Identity), and define security policies equivalent to Cloud Armor.









Profile sought

Experience : Proven and mandatory track record on a Chinese cloud provider (ideally Alibaba Cloud). We are looking for a profile with at least 5 years of experience as a Senior Cloud Consultant or Cloud Architect, who has already participated in scoping and estimation phases.

Technical Skills

Mastery of the managed Kubernetes ecosystem, managed databases, and object storage.

Expertise in Terraform and Helm.

Strong skills in international network architecture and cross-border connectivity.

GCP skills.

Knowledge of security solutions (WAF/Cloud Armor) and identity management (SSO/Google Cloud Identity).

Daily use of AI.

Soft Skills :

Analytical mindset and pragmatism to design solutions that are simple to operate daily.

Autonomy and proactive approach to guide the client in their strategic choices (e.g., alternatives to PubSub).

Ability to communicate easily with cross-functional teams.

Languages : Fluent English (international context), French or Mandarin would be a major asset.









Recruitment process :

- Initial interview with our recruiter and the head of the structure, who is an IT engineer.
- Presentation of your application to our client (following mutual agreement).
- Meeting with the client and their teams to discuss the position and expectations.

Would you like to know more? We invite you to apply and/or contact us!

jobs.title: Expert technique détection incendie (h/f/x) (H/F)
jobs.description: Le cabinet de recrutement de Manpower Luxembourg recrute un Expert Technique Détection Incendie (H/F/X)  pour l'un de ses clients, un acteur international majeur spécialisé dans les solutions énergétiques, environnementales et techniques. Dans le cadre du développement de ses activités au Luxembourg, notre client recherche un professionnel expérimenté capable d'intervenir comme référent technique sur les systèmes de détection incendie et les installations de courant faible. Vos missions En tant qu'Expert Technique, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la fiabilité et la performance des installations : Assurer la maintenance préventive et corrective des systèmes de détection incendie. Diagnostiquer et résoudre les pannes techniques complexes sur les installations de courant faible. Intervenir sur différents équipements techniques : réseaux informatiques, téléphonie, vidéosurveillance, contrôle d'accès et systèmes d'alarme. Garantir la continuité de service grâce à des interventions rapides et efficaces. Accompagner les techniciens dans la résolution des problématiques techniques et partager votre expertise. Assurer un rôle de référent technique auprès des équipes terrain. Participer à l'amélioration continue des installations et des processus de maintenance. Développer et maintenir une relation de confiance avec les clients. Veiller au respect des normes de sécurité, de qualité et des réglementations en vigueur. Votre profil Formation technique en électricité, électrotechnique, automatisme ou équivalent. Expérience significative dans la maintenance et le dépannage de systèmes de détection incendie. Excellentes connaissances des technologies de courant faible. Solides capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes techniques. Aptitude à accompagner, conseiller et former les équipes opérationnelles. Esprit d'initiative, autonomie et sens des responsabilités. Orientation client et excellente communication. Maîtrise du français indispensable. Toute autre langue (anglais, allemand ou luxembourgeois) constitue un atout. Ce que notre client vous offre Un contrat à durée indéterminée au sein d'un groupe international reconnu. Un package salarial attractif avec e mois. Un  de service. Des chèques-repas et des avantages extra-légaux compétitifs. Un parcours d'intégration structuré et un plan de formation continue. De réelles opportunités d'évolution et de développement professionnel. Un environnement de travail dynamique favorisant l'autonomie et la prise d'initiative. La stabilité et la solidité d'un acteur engagé dans la transition énergétique et les technologies durables. Intéressé(e) ? Vous souhaitez rejoindre une entreprise reconnue pour son expertise technique et bénéficier d'un accompagnement personnalisé dans votre démarche ? Postulez dès maintenant en toute confidentialité. Votre candidature sera traitée avec la plus grande discrétion par le cabinet de recrutement Manpower Luxembourg.

jobs.title: Gestionnaire bureau des examens (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? Institut national des langues Luxembourg (INLL) Missions Préinformation/information des candidats aux examens/tests nationaux et internationaux via téléphone, e-mails et à l'accueil; Gestion des dossiers: inscriptions, saisie des données, mise à jour et gestion des bases de données, suivi des paiements, diffusion des résultats/certificats/diplômes, préparation des remboursements, encodage et vérification des résultats des examens/tests nationaux et internationaux; Gestion des salles via Outlook (conseils pédagogique et examens/tests nationaux et internationaux), préparation des salles; Assistance et surveillance aux examens/tests nationaux et internationaux; Réception/préparation/vérification et sécurisation du matériel d'examen; Gestion du calendrier (site internet) des examens/tests nationaux et internationaux. Profil Compétences techniques Connaître l'organisation administrative et procédurale de l'INLL; Maîtriser les techniques de rédaction dans les 3 langues officielles du pays et de la langue anglaise; Maîtriser les technologies d'information et de communication; Maîtriser les logiciels bureautiques, y inclus Access et les plateformes online mises à disposition par les institutions partenaires. Compétences comportementales Analyser : Vous évaluez les informations, données et contenus de manier/ière critique, le cas échéant dans un environnement digital, vous identifiez les liens logiques et restituez l'information dans une synthèse complète et cohérente; S'organiser : Vous vous organisez en fixant les priorités, vous planifiez le travail et gérez les imprévus, vous travaillez de façon autonome en utilisant les moyens disponibles; Partager son savoir-faire : Vous montrez, transmettez et partagez vos connaissances, expériences et vos méthodes de travail; Servir le client-usager : Vous accompagnez le client-usager de manier/ière personnalisée, vous entretenez des contacts réguliers et constructifs, vous appliquez les lignes de bonne conduite administrative; Faire preuve d'ouverture : Vous êtes ouvert au changement et à l'innovation, vous vous ouvrez à la diversité et vous vous intéressez à d'autres disciplines que les vôtres; Gérer le stress : Vous gardez votre calme face à la pression, vous restez constructif face à la critique et vous agissez de façon constant/ante malgré les difficultés; S'autodévelopper : Vous vous remettez en question de façon régulier/ière, vous apprenez de vos erreurs et vous apprenez continuellement; S'impliquer : Vous vous engagez pour générer des résultats, vous assumez la responsabilité et la qualité des actions entreprises, vous vous engagez pour le bien commun. Conditions d'admission Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut du fonctionnaire de l'État ou de l'employé de l'État. Il est ouvert au changement d'administration des fonctionnaires. Obtenez plus de détails sur les conditions d'admission : Pour devenir fonctionnaire de l'État Pour changer d'administration en tant que fonctionnaire Pour devenir employé de l'État. Diplômes Vous avez: Soit accompli avec succès 5 années d'études dans l'enseignement secondaire (classique ou général) ou dans le régime de formation du technicien, ou vous présentez un certificat reconnu comme équivalent; Soit obtenu un diplôme DAP. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 3 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. Langues Applicable à l'employé et au fonctionnaire (hors changement d'administration) : Vous répondez aux exigences de connaissances des 3 langues administratives pour le groupe C1.  Vous êtes ressortissant d'un État membre de l'Union européenne.

jobs.title: Servitør 100% stilling
jobs.description:
Vollan Gjestestue søker en serviceinnstilt og engasjert servitør i fast 100% stilling.

Hva vi ser etter

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Erfaring fra tilsvarende arbeid er ønskelig, men ikke et krav

  • Gode engelskkunnskaper; andre språk er et pluss

  • Må kunne snakke, lese, skrive og forstå norsk

  • Løsningsorientert og bidrar til entusiasme og godt arbeidsmiljø

  • God fysisk helse

  • Kommunikativ, motiverende og positiv

  • Må ha fylt 18 år (servering av alkohol)

Arbeidsoppgaver

Sentrale arbeidsoppgaver

  • Kundebehandling og gjestebevertning

  • Kassebetjening

  • Renhold og ydding av bord og vedlikehold av serveringsområdet

  • Klargjøring av mat til disk

  • Dekking og betjening av selskap

  • Oppvask

Vi tilbyr

Vi tilbyr

  • Et hyggelig og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

  • Varierte arbeidsoppgaver og god opplæring

  • Lønn etter tariff. Lokal avtale: OTP 6%, utvidet kvelds tillegg fra 16.00, treningsavgift, generelt tillegg 2,- pr time. Etter 1 år: Dobbelt helge tillegg, dobbel skogodtgjørelse. Bonusavlønning.

  • Mulighet for ekstra vakter ved behov.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vollan Gjestestue har siden 1948 vært en viktig møteplass i Nordkjosbotn -- kjent for hjemmelaget tradisjonsmat, gode opplevelser og personlig service. I dag har vi 42 hotellrom, moderne kurs- og konferansefasiliteter, kafé og restaurant, samt catering og selskapslokaler. Rundt årsskiftet 2026/2027 åpner vi spa. Vi sysselsetter over 50 ansatte og er stolte av å være en inkluderende og mangfoldig arbeidsplass.

Er du vernepleier med engasjement for fagutvikling og ønsker å være med å forme fremtidens aktivitetstilbud for mennesker med utviklingshemming?

Som fagutviklingsvernepleier hos oss får du en sentral rolle i utviklingen av våre dagaktivitetssentre. Vi er i en spennende fase der vi utforsker nye arbeidsmetoder og utvikler aktivitetstilbud som fremmer mestring, deltakelse og livskvalitet. Vi søker en fagutviklingsvernepleier som ønsker å gjøre en forskjell – ikke bare for den enkelte deltaker, men også for hvordan aktivitetstilbud for mennesker med utviklingshemming utformes i fremtiden.

Hos oss får du en unik mulighet til å kombinere klinisk vernepleierfaglig kompetanse med utviklingsarbeid. Vi tenker nytt om aktivitet, arbeid, samfunnsdeltakelse og samarbeid, og vi trenger en fagperson som ønsker å være en drivkraft i dette arbeidet. Vi er opptatt av å bygge sterkt samarbeid med pårørende, ansatte i boligene, frivillige organisasjoner og lokalsamfunnet for å skape enda flere muligheter for våre deltakere.

Dette er en stilling for deg som liker å tenke nytt, omsette fagkunnskap til praksis og engasjere andre i utviklingsarbeid. Hos oss får du arbeide tett sammen med dyktige kollegaer i et miljø preget av høy faglig kvalitet, nysgjerrighet og et sterkt ønske om å skape gode dager for menneskene vi er til for. jobs.title: Senior Product Desiner (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our design team. You'll take features end to end, from research and flows through to the finished interface, for an analytics platform that mobile gaming studios use every day to decide where their marketing money goes. You'll also own our design system: the components, patterns and documentation that everything else is built from. This is a broad role. You'll do research, interaction design, visual design and system work, and you'll do it in a small team where your decisions ship.

At justtrack, we build a SaaS business that provides app and game publishers with an attractive toolset to manage their entire global growth marketing process. Starting from managing, analyzing, and automating marketing processes, justtrack enables gathering deep mobile product insights. As part of the Applike Group (financially backed by media powerhouse Bertelsmann), justtrack has access to industry experts and funding with a long-term growth mindset.

What you will do:

  • Work AI-First: Use AI tools as a standard part of your design process, research synthesis, copy, design generation and iteration, with the judgement to know where the output needs your correction.

  • Own Features End to End: Take features from problem statement through research, flows and interface to shipped result, without handing off between layers.

  • Own the Design System: Build, document, and evolve our design system, components, variants, states, tokens, and decide how it changes as the product grows.

  • Design for Data Density: Design charts and data-heavy screens where information hierarchy and readability matter more than decoration.

  • Design AI-Assisted Surfaces: Shape how our AI features present their output, transparency, confidence, review steps, and what happens when the model gets it wrong.

  • Work Closely with Engineering: Specify components so frontend can build them directly, and review the built result against the design.

  • Talk to Users: Run research and usability tests with gaming studios and internal stakeholders, and turn what you learn into design decisions.

Who you are:

  • Experience: You have 5+ years in product design or a comparable end-to-end design role, ideally on a complex SaaS product.

  • Background: A degree in design, HCI, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • AI Fluency: You already work with AI tools day to day and have a clear view of where they help and where they don't.

  • End-to-End Craft: You're strong across the whole range: research, flows, interaction and visual design, rather than deep in one and dependent on others for the rest.

  • Design System Expertise: You've built and maintained a design system in production, including documentation and the governance decisions that keep it coherent.

  • Tools: Expert in Figma. It's where our final designs live, and where our design system is built and maintained.

  • Portfolio: You have a strong portfolio showing end-to-end work, the problem, your decisions, the finished interface, and what it changed.

  • Collaboration: You work well with product owners and engineers, articulate your rationale clearly, and can hold a position without stalling the work.

  • Optional: Experience designing for analytics, data visualization, or another data-dense environment.

  • Optional: Familiarity with front-end frameworks (e.g. React) and component development tools (e.g. Storybook).

Fuel for the Journey: Benefits to Support Your Ambitions

  • Invest in Your Future: Regular feedback and our development program support your growth, helping you expand your skill set and achieve your career goals.

  • Easy Arrival to justtrack: From signing to settling in Hamburg, we’ve got you covered. Need a visa? No problem. Ready to build your new life and career at applike in Hamburg? We support every ambition - from learning German to a relocation bonus that helps you settle in and make Hamburg feel like home.

  • Live Your Best Life, at Work and Beyond: We work in a hybrid setup with 3 core office days, plus flexible working hours. Enjoy 30 vacation days, 3 weeks of remote work per year, and free access to an in-house gym with lots of different fitness classes and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

  • Thrive Where You Work: Enjoy the Alster Lake view from our central office with top-notch equipment, fun open spaces, and a large variety of snacks and drinks.

  • Join the Community! Participate in regular team and company events, including hackathons and social gatherings. We work together, and we celebrate together, too.

The Interview Process:

  • 1st: Interview with TA

  • 2nd: Interview with the Lead UX/UI Designer

  • 3rd: On-site day in our Hamburg office, a case study, followed by an interview with the design team and our Director of Product

  • 4th: Team fit call with our Managing Director

Our mission is to create an inspiring work environment for amazing people to achieve extraordinary things. Be part of it!

Skip writing cover letters. Tell us about your most passionate personal project, your desired salary, and your earliest possible start date. We are looking forward to your application!

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

jobs.title: Sales Lead (all genders) SaaS/Fintech
jobs.description:
Germany runs on its small and medium businesses, and far too much of their money and attention goes into staying compliant. Bookkeeping, VAT returns, annual accounts: unavoidable work that nobody wants and everybody overpays for.

We take it off them. Because none of it is optional, what we are building is infrastructure rather than software, and the purpose is simple: make it cheaper to run a company in Germany.

100 to more than 700 customers in eight months, and still a small team. So these roles are broad by design. You own an area, not a slice of one, there is more to build than there are people, and the scope grows as fast as you do. We work in English internally, as the team is international, but the market is German.

Aufgaben

You own our sales engine: the team, the numbers and the motions we sell through.

What you inherit on day one. Two sales people, one freelance closer, and everything our COO and CFO has been carrying alongside his actual job. So you are a playing coach for the first months: you carry your own book, you coach two people, and you hire the next ones yourself rather than being handed a team.

Our pipeline today is almost entirely inbound. Outbound is a motion we expect to build, and we do not yet know how large a part of the mix it becomes. We need somebody who has run both, because the answer depends on what you find.

We have deliberately not decided what the sales team should look like. There are too many sensible ways to build one, and the right shape depends on which motions prove out. You design that structure with us and then you hire it, which is why hiring experience is not negotiable in this role.

what you will do

  • Own win rate, cycle time and average contract value as your numbers, per motion rather than in aggregate
  • Own sales operations and bring structure to a team that has grown without much of it: process, cadence, forecasting, routing rules, quota and commission design, a CRM somebody can trust
  • Design the shape of the sales team with us, then hire it. Which roles, which split, in which order.
  • Hire, onboard and coach the reps. You are accountable for who joins the team, not only for what they do afterwards.
  • Run inbound properly and build outbound from close to nothing, then be honest about which one deserves the next hire
  • Build the consultative motion for larger contract values. Our subscription tiers are small, and a meaningful part of first-year revenue comes from one-off work such as prior-year closings, which is where the larger deals sit.
  • Use the deadlines the business already has. VAT returns, annual accounts, the notice period on an existing advisor contract: there is always a clock, and finding it and using it is a large part of closing here.
  • Keep selling. You should be closing enough yourself to know what the reps are hearing.

Where your job ends. Our partnerships manager closes the partner agreements, including grey label. You own the routing of those leads and their conversion into revenue.

Qualifikation

what you bring to the table

  • AI-native, not AI-curious. Claude or an equivalent is your daily sparring partner rather than a tool you open occasionally. You augment your own output with it and you automate the parts of your job that should not need a human. In this role that means call analysis and objection patterns, follow-up drafting, research before a conversation, and the reporting you would otherwise ask somebody else to build for you.
  • You have hired sales people before, and some of them worked out. You can describe what you screen for and what you got wrong.
  • We have a strong bias towards people who have been entrepreneurs themselves, whether that was your own company or a function you ran as if it were one
  • You have run both inbound and outbound yourself, not managed one and read about the other
  • You have led a small B2B sales team in a high-volume environment and carried the number yourself before that
  • You build structure without building bureaucracy. Playbooks and process that reps actually use.
  • You can tell the difference between a rep who processes what arrives and a rep who goes and gets it, in an interview rather than in month four
  • You are commercially literate. You can hold a conversation about pricing, structure and what a deal can afford without escalating every question.
  • You coach directly and you are honest about who is not working out
  • You are honest in the CRM even when the number is ugly

the level we are hiring at

If you have been the second person in a function somewhere good and this is your step up, that is the profile we want. As the team grows, the path from here is Head of Sales.

We keep the team small by giving people leverage instead of headcount. That is why the AI point above is a requirement rather than a preference, and why we expect everyone here to get visibly better at it every month.

nice to have

  • Tax, accounting, SME-stack or fintech background
  • Franchise systems, multi-entity groups or holding structures
  • Partner-led or channel sales
  • Experience in a company that grew fast around you

German at native or C2 level is required. Every sales conversation, every negotiation and every coaching session on a live call happens in German. English at B2 or above, since English is our team language.

Benefits

Base 75,000 to 100,000 EUR depending on experience, plus a variable component. It starts weighted to what you close yourself and shifts toward team performance as the team grows. On-target earnings 95,000 to 150,000 EUR+, plus stock options.

Three rounds: an intro conversation, a working session with a short case, and a final round with the founders. For a role at this level there is a fourth conversation with one of our investors or mentors. One meeting happens in person in Berlin, and you hear back within a week at every stage, including if the answer is no.
