jobs.title: Helsefagarbeidere - miljøarbeidertjenesten
jobs.description:
Hadsel kommune i nært samarbeid med Sentral fagenhet for tvungen omsorg, etablerer nå eget botiltak for omsorgsdømt som skal gjennomføre særreaksjonen tvungen omsorg utenfor fagenhetens lokaler. Sentral fagenhet for tvungen omsorg er en nasjonal enhet med ansvar for sikkerhet, omsorg og behandling i gjennomføring av alle dommer til tvungen omsorg i Norge.
Stillingene tilsettes av Hadsel kommune i tråd med gjeldende tilsettingsreglement og vilkår. Botiltaket er plassert på Stokmarknes. I den forbindelse søker vi:

1 fast helsefagarbeiderstilling 69,01%, for tiden natt, ledig fra 15.10.26
1 fast helsefagarbeiderstilling 64,08%, for tiden natt, ledig fra 15.10.26

Stillingene er i ordinær turnus med arbeid hver tredje helg.


Om stillingene
Som helsefagarbeidere jobber du nært med, og forholder seg til stedlig leder som har et omfattende faglig ansvar, og som gjør viktige sikkerhetsvurderinger til enhver tid.

Høy grad av personlig egnethet og skikkethet til å ivareta stillingens faglige og relasjonelle kompleksitet.


Kompetanse
Off. godkjent helsefagarbeider/hjelpepleier
Det åpnes for at personer med annen relevant kompetanse og/eller med erfaring fra denne type arbeid, kan bli vurdert for stilling.
God digital kompetanse
Førerkort kl. B


Ønsket kompetanse
Relevant erfaring med målgruppen: personer med kognitive vansker, atferdsproblematikk og/ eller grupper omfattet av Riksadvokatens rundskriv 2/2020-om utilregnelighetsregler og særreaksjoner.
Relevant videreutdanning, gjerne innen veiledning.

Personlige egenskaper

  • Er engasjert og selvgående, og har evne til å utøve selvstendig, strukturert og ansvarsbevisst arbeid. Jobber systematisk og målrettet og følger avdelingens rutiner
  • Har gode ferdigheter i kommunikasjon og samhandling, og kommuniserer tydelig. Du skaper et miljø der beboer føler seg sett, trygg og ivaretatt og ser etter mulighetene og ressursene som bor i det enkelte mennesket. Du tror på relasjonens kraft og vet at de beste løsningene finnes sammen med andre.
  • Er lyttende og handlekraftig: Du tar informerte beslutninger og vet når det er tid for å lytte og når det er tid for å handle
  • Er lærevillig og nysgjerrig: Du holder deg faglig oppdatert og inspirerer teamet til å utvikle seg.
  • Er tilpasningsdyktig og ser muligheter der andre ser utfordringer.
  • Har en løsningsrettet og konfliktdempende tilnærming til arbeidets utfordringer
  • Samarbeider godt med leder, kolleger, beboer og dennes pårørende
  • Er fleksibel og liker å jobbe i et spennende miljø der ingen dager er like

Vi tilbyr

Konkurransedyktige betingelser
Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
Flyttegodtgjørelse etter kommunens reglement
Et tverrfaglig kompetansemiljø

I denne stillingen har du rett på en av Norges sikreste pensjonsordninger: offentlig tjenestepensjon. Der de fleste tjenestepensjoner kun utbetales i 10 år, er offentlig tjenestepensjon en utbetaling som varer fra den dagen du slutter å jobbe og livet ut. Pensjonen inkluderer også uføre- og etterlattepensjon hvis noe uventet skulle skje. Med pensjonsrett i KLP får du medlemspris og gunstige betingelser på en rekke bank, forsikring og spareprodukter.

Les mer her:https://www.klp.no/pensjon/offentlig-tjenestepensjon-kort-fortalt

Hadsel kommune skal preges av mangfold, og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile kommunens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. Hadsel kommune legger vekt på å tilrettelegge arbeidsforholdene dersom du har behov for det.

Regjeringen har vedtatt nedskriving av studielån med kr 25.000,- pr. år innføres for enkelte kommuner i Norge. Hadsel kommune er omfattet av dette, under forutsetning av at en bor i kommunen.

Les mer mer: https://www.regjeringen.no/no/aktuelt/ny-ordning-for-sletting-av-utdanningsgjeld-slik-vil-det-fungere/id3058902/

Språkkunnskaper
Norsk er arbeidsspråk i Hadsel kommune og som søker må du kunne snakke, lese og skrive så godt norsk at du både kan samarbeide med andre og utføre arbeidsoppgavene dine selvstendig. 

Intervju
Kvalifiserte søkere vil bli innkalt til intervju

Ansettelse

  • Tilsettingen skjer i henhold til gjeldende lover, reglementer og avtaleverk
  • Lønn etter avtale i forhold til utdanning og praksis. 
  • Politiattest må leveres i henhold til Helsepersonelloven §20a, andre ledd, jmfr. Straffeloven §§63 og 64 om gjennomføringen av dom til tvungen omsorg. Politiattest skal ikke legges ved søknad, men fremskaffes etter at tilbud blir gitt og før signering av arbeidsavtale, jf. politiregisterforskriften § 36-1 nummer 3

Offentlighet
Opplysninger om søker kan bli offentlige selv om søkeren har bedt om ikke å bli oppført på søkerlisten, jf. Offentlighetslovens § 25.

Søknaden

Søknaden må inneholde søknadsbrev og CV, legg gjerne ved attester og vitnemål. 

Referanser skal oppgis i søknaden.

Søknader sendes elektronisk ved bruk av "Søk her". 

Velkommen som søker til Hadsel kommune - Et hav av muligheter! Vi ser frem til en søknad fra akkurat deg! Så hiv deg over tastaturet og søk jobb hos oss. 


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Miljøarbeidertjenesten gir opplæringstjenester og praktisk bistand til personer med ulike funksjonshemminger og personer med psykisk utviklingshemming. Tjenesten består av følgende avdelinger: Miljøarbeidertjenesten Stokmarknes avd. 1 (inkludert avlastningsbolig) Miljøarbeidertjenesten Stokmarknes avd. 2 Miljøarbeidertjenesten Melbu avdeling 1 Miljøarbeidertjenesten Melbu avdeling 2 (inkludert Seljeveien aktivitetssenter)

Våre avdelinger i Tromsø søker avdelingsleder til et området i vekst!

Hver dag gjør våre ansatte en innsats som betyr alt for menneskene vi er her for. I Humana omsorg og assistanse tror vi på visjonen vår om at alle har rett til et godt liv. Ja, alle. Som en av Norges største private aktører er vi en helt nødvendig bærebjelke og en uunnværlig partner for det offentlige. Ved å kombinere menneskelig nærhet med høy kompetanse, bygger vi morgendagens omsorg. Nå søker vi en robust og selvgående avdelingsleder til Tromsø, som vil være en helt avgjørende del av denne løsningen.

Vår målgruppe er mennesker med sammensatte bistandsbehov. Vi søker deg som ikke bare forstår faget, men som også har forretningsmessig forståelse og evner å inspirere medarbeiderne dine til å levere kvalitet i hvert eneste møte.

Dine ansvarsområder

Faglig ledelse: Overordnet ansvar for blant annet implementering av PAS (Positiv Atferdsstøtte) i avdelingen.

Juridisk compliance: Ansvarlig for saksbehandling og oppfølging av vedtak etter Helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven.

Personalansvar: Motivere, utvikle og samle personalgruppen mot felles mål for kundetilfredshet.

Operativ drift: Sikre at avdelingen leverer i henhold til oppdragsgivers forventninger på rammeavtale og enkeltkjøp.

Kvalifikasjoner og profil

Vi ser etter en leder som er både robust og pålitelig, og som kjenner seg igjen i våre verdier: Engasjement, Ansvar og Glede.

I tillegg har du:

  • Bachelor i helsefag og gjerne videreutdanning i ledelse.

  • 2-5 års erfaring som leder/saksbehandler innenfor samme bransje.

  • Erfaring med økonomistyring og forståelse for oppdragsgivers rammebetingelser.

Vi tilbyr

Hos oss får du mulighet til påvirkning og utvikling av en region i vekst, samt skape og utvikle nye team. Du blir en del av ledergruppe i Region Nord, der vi har stort fokus på å støtte og løfte hverandre.

Vi tilbyr strukturert onboarding og oppfølging av nyansatte.

Vi har gjennomarbeidede HMS-rutiner og intern HR-avdeling

Du får et fordelsprogram som gir rabatter i mer enn 50 butikker hvor du kan velge mellom alt fra klær, sportsutstyr, reise og mat i tillegg til en rekke

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

jobs.title: Partner Manager
jobs.description:
Summary

We are seeking a Partner Manager to join our growing global connected services team in Stockholm, Sweden. In this role, you will act as the central point of contact for managing key partner relationships, monitoring performance, and ensuring governance. You will balance strategic oversight with hands-on management to drive operational excellence, contract alignment, and partner satisfaction.

The role also includes shaping partner management strategies, optimizing costs, and proactively identifying and mitigating operational risks.

You will play a critical role in fostering strong partner collaboration, ensuring strict SLA adherence, and driving continuous improvement across all partner engagements.

About KDDI

We are a global Top 10 telecommunications pioneer and a Global Fortune 500 company providing our international customer base with data centers, networks, content delivery, system integration, and more. We connect vehicles from several of the world's largest Automotive OEMs, as well as mobility and IoT programs across the globe. Our industry-leading Telehouse data center provides colocation at over 40 sites in 23 cities across 12 countries, including London, New York, Frankfurt, and Shanghai. Leveraging our strengths as a telecom provider, we combine IT and network expertise to deliver secure, scalable, and stress-free connectivity for our customers.

Responsibilities

    KPI Management: Develop, track, and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) related to partner performance, such as on-time delivery, quality metrics, and service level adherence.
    Governance and Compliance: Establish and maintain partner governance structures, including managing Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and ensuring compliance with industry standards and company policies.
    Relationship Management: Foster strong relationships with partners, ensuring open communication channels for discussing performance, addressing issues, and exploring opportunities for collaboration and improvement.
    Contract Management: Negotiate contract terms with partners.
    Performance Reviews: Conduct regular reviews with partners to provide feedback, discuss improvement plans, and align on strategic goals.
    Risk Management: Identify and address potential risks within the partner base and implement effective mitigation strategies.

Knowledge and Skills

Technical Skills

    Understanding of Wireless/Cellular technologies (4G/5G, eSIM, Packet Core)
    Familiarity with IoT services and platforms
    Strong understanding of KPI tracking, analytics, and performance measurement frameworks.
    Experience with SLA management, vendor governance, and compliance standards..
    Familiarity with risk management frameworks and mitigation planning.

Soft Skills

    Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English is mandatory.
    Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities.
    Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic, and ambiguous environment.
    Strong collaboration, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills.
    Proactive approach to problem-solving, including gap analysis and implementation of corrective action plans.
    Ability to work effectively both as a team player and an independent contributor.

Requirements

    Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
    3+ years of experience in Partner Management, Vendor Management, Procurement, or Service Delivery management.
    Proven track record of managing, evaluating, and growing vendor or partner relationships.
    Strong business acumen with experience managing budgets and negotiating flexible contract terms.
    Experience in Telecom, IT, IoT, or fast-paced technology environments is preferred.

jobs.title: Process Developer
jobs.description:
Job Title: Process Developer

Scania Credit Group (SCA), one of the captive Scania Financial Services entities, offers financing and insurance in the Middle East, Central Asia, and West Africa. SCA has become a leader in factoring solutions for non-captive dealers and body-builders, supporting Scania's goal to reduce CCC and offload its balance sheet. We have partnered with external credit insurers to mitigate commercial and political risks in certain transactions. SCA is expanding into new markets, particularly in the AMC region.

Based in Södertälje, the SCA Head Office and Market Support Centre provides governance, strategic development, credit risk management, contract administration, and IT support. With 50 employees, including 30 in Södertälje, we manage around 250 MEUR of assets across 10+ markets.

At SCA we value team spirit, diversity and respect. We believe that every employee should be able to be themselves at work. Our corporate culture is characterized by respect for the individual, continuous improvement and always putting the customer first.  

Role Summary

As a Process Developer, you will play a key role in ensuring our business applications remain reliable, efficient, and aligned with evolving business needs. Working within our Process & IT team, you will combine operational support with project work, helping to maintain critical business systems while contributing to new initiatives and digital improvements.

Reporting to the IT Manager, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across IT, Finance, Credit Risk, Risk & Compliance, Business Development, and external partners. You will be the link between business and technology, ensuring our applications continue to meet business needs while identifying opportunities to simplify processes and enhance the user experience.

This is a hands-on role where no two days are the same. One day you may be troubleshooting application issues, managing service requests, or supporting users; the next you could be coordinating testing, implementing system enhancements, participating in projects, or driving process improvements. If you enjoy solving problems, working closely with stakeholders, and making a tangible impact on how the business operates, this role offers an excellent opportunity to develop your skills within an international financial services organisation.

Job Responsibilities

    Provide first- and second-line support for business applications, troubleshooting issues and ensuring timely resolution of incidents and service requests.
    Support and administer View21 and Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, including system configuration, maintenance, and enhancements.
    Coordinate application configurations and support the implementation of new products and business initiatives.
    Lead and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), working closely with business stakeholders to validate system changes and enhancements.
    Manage user access to business applications, ensuring compliance with internal policies and supporting IT audit activities related to access, change, and incident management.
    Collaborate with business users and vendors to analyze requirements, prioritize change requests, and implement system improvements.
    Develop and maintain user guides, process documentation, and training materials to support knowledge sharing and user adoption.
    Identify opportunities to improve business processes and workflows, driving efficiency through system enhancements and process optimisation.
    Support user onboarding and offboarding by ensuring timely application provisioning, access management, and user enablement.
    Contribute to projects and improvement initiatives across the Process & IT function, balancing operational support with the delivery of new capabilities.



Who You Are

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, improving processes, and working closely with both business and IT stakeholders. You are curious, eager to learn, and comfortable taking ownership of tasks, whether it's resolving a support issue, coordinating testing, or driving a process improvement initiative.

You are structured and organised in your approach, able to balance operational responsibilities with project work while managing competing priorities. As a strong communicator, you build positive relationships across teams and are confident working in a collaborative environment.

Most importantly, you have a continuous improvement mindset, enjoy learning new systems and technologies, and are motivated by making a tangible impact on how the business operates.

For this position, we imagine that you will have:

    A relevant university degree or equivalent practical experience.
    3+ years of experience in application support, service management, process development, or a related IT/business systems role.
    Experience working with incident management, change management, service requests, and user support.
    Experience participating in system implementations, enhancements, testing (UAT), or continuous improvement initiatives.
    Experience with user access management, IT controls, compliance, or audit-related activities.
    Experience in financing, financial services, or a regulated business environment is highly preferred.
    Professional proficiency in English; Swedish is an advantage.
    Familiarity with View21 and/or Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM is an advantage.
    Knowledge of Lean methodologies or the Scania Way is beneficial.
    Experience working in an international or cross-functional environment is an advantage.



This Is Us

Our Process & IT team consists of six dedicated professionals with diverse backgrounds and expertise. We are responsible for the technology and processes that enable our business to operate efficiently - from application support and infrastructure to reporting, AI and analytics, business systems, and process optimisation. Working closely with business stakeholders, we deliver practical digital solutions that create value across the organisation and support our continued growth.

At Scania Credit, we value teamwork, diversity, and respect. We believe everyone should feel empowered to be themselves at work. Our culture is built on respect for the individual, continuous improvement, and always putting the customer first.

Are you passionate about improving business processes through technology? Do you enjoy solving problems, collaborating with stakeholders, and delivering solutions that make a real business impact? If so, we'd love to hear from you. Join Scania Credit as a Process Developer and help shape the future of our business systems and digital transformation!

Scania Credit Offers

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-09-17. We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible. The posting may close before the application deadline if a high volume of applications is received. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Hästkille på 19 år söker en ledsagare som vill hänga i stallet - gärna en k

jobs.description:

Att värna om våra medarbetare och förenkla tillvaron för våra kunder är kärnan i vår verksamhet som kännetecknas av personligt bemötande, hög tillgänglighet och snabb service. Läs gärna mer om oss på vår hemsida: www.godomsorg.se

Om uppdraget:

Därför söker vi dig som kan vara ett stöd och en kompis i stallet. Vi söker främst en kille och du som söker behöver inte ha hästvana, men du måste vara sugen på att vilja lära dig mer om hästar och du får såklart inte vara hästrädd.

Dina kvalifikationer:

    Trygg, lugn och öppen.
    Gärna intresserad av hästar

Vi tror att uppdraget passar särskilt bra för en yngre vuxen som kan fungera som en avslappnad förebild, där fokus ligger på att skapa en god relation och göra timmarna i stallet roliga tillsammans!
Personlig lämplighet och personkemi är avgörande.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer within Telecom & 5G
jobs.description:
Are you a software engineer with a background in embedded development and telecom? At Tieto, you'll work with cutting-edge 5G and future 6G technology, solving complex technical challenges in close collaboration with international development teams. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys problem-solving, takes ownership of their work, and wants to contribute to technology used by millions around the world.

About the job

This is a consulting assignment of at least 12 months with strong long-term opportunities. You will initially be employed by Bravura, with the ambition that the assignment may transition into a permanent position with Tieto over time. This gives both you and Tieto a good opportunity to get to know each other and evaluate how you feel about your collaboration.

About the company

Tieto is a trusted technology partner within the telecom industry, delivering advanced software development services for large-scale communication systems. The company works closely with leading customers and contributes to the development of next-generation network infrastructure and radio technologies.

In this role, you will become part of a large engineering organization working with full-scale software development projects. Rather than supporting a single isolated function, teams are involved throughout the entire development lifecycle, from concept and design to implementation, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement.

The environment is highly international, with collaboration across teams located in Sweden, Poland, India, Canada, and other global locations. Engineers work in close-knit teams where knowledge sharing, technical excellence, and teamwork are central to daily operations.

Tasks and responsibilities

As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will be involved in the design, development, and improvement of software used in telecom infrastructure. The role combines hands-on development with technical problem-solving and close collaboration with colleagues across multiple disciplines.

You will work throughout the development lifecycle, from analysis and design to implementation, testing, and optimization. Depending on your background and interests, you may also be involved in architecture discussions and technical investigations.

Your responsibilities will include:

    

Developing and maintaining software for telecom and radio communication systems

    

Working with embedded software development in C and C++

    

Contributing to system design, implementation, and troubleshooting

    

Collaborating with international development teams and stakeholders

    

Participating in the development of cloud-native and distributed solutions

Education, experience and personal characteristics

    

Experience in embedded software development.

    

Strong programming skills in C and/or C++.

    

Experience working in Linux-based development environments.

    

Experience within the telecom industry, communication systems, networking infrastructure, or related technical domains.

    

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, or similiar.

    

Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

    

Knowledge of Radio Access Networks (RAN), radio base stations, broadband communication, or telecom protocols is meritorious.

    

Experience with Kubernetes, microservices, containerized applications, or cloud-native development is meritorious.

We are looking for someone who enjoys breaking down complex technical challenges and finding practical solutions together with others. You are proactive, curious, and comfortable navigating unfamiliar problems. Rather than waiting for answers, you actively seek information, ask questions, and drive your work forward.

You appreciate collaboration and thrive in team-based environments where knowledge sharing and communication are key to success. To succeed in this role, you should be analytical, engaged, and motivated by continuous learning and technical development

Other information

Start: Upon agreement

Location: Karlstad or Luleå

Salary: Upon agreement

-Viikoittaisesta työajasta on käytettävissä 1-2 tuntia työtehtävien kannalta oleellisen fyysisen kunnon ylläpitoon ja kehittämiseen.

Olet etsimämme henkilö, jos:

-Sinulla on kokemusta liikunnanohjauksesta eri kohderyhmille.
-Osaat työskennellä itsenäisesti, mutta arvostat myös tiimityötä ja muiden työyhteisön jäsenten ammattitaitoa.
-Sopeudut helposti muuttuviin tilanteisiin ja olet valmis tukemaan tiimiäsi sijaistamalla tarvittaessa eri liikuntaryhmissä.

Pätevyysvaatimukset:

-Tehtävään soveltuva liikunta-alan tutkinto.
-Uinninvalvojan testiuinnin hyväksytty suorittaminen. Kirkkonummen uimahallin ison altaan syvin kohta on neljä metriä. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden testiuinnin harjoitteluun etukäteen.
-Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä hyväksyttävä rikosrekisteriote (laki lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä 504/2002).

Eduksi katsomme:

-Molempien kotimaisten kielten hyvän hallinnan.
-Aiempi kokemus vastaavista tehtävistä.

Työaika ja palkkaus:

-Yleistyöaika 38 tuntia ja 15 minuuttia viikossa, sisältäen aamu-, ilta- ja viikonlopputyötä.
-Tasopalkka 2 677,42 euroa kuukaudessa (KVTES).
-Tehtävää täytettäessä koeaika on puolet määräaikaisuuden kestosta.

Hakemukset toimitetaan Kirkkonummen kunnan nuoriso- ja liikuntapalveluihin torstaihin 17.9.2026 klo 12:00 mennessä sähköisesti osoitteessa www.kuntarekry.fi (työavain KIR-03-294-26).

jobs.title: Operations Manager of a mountain outdoor base in Norway.
jobs.description:
Starting in September 2026, we are looking for a long-term employee for the position of Operations Manager of a mountain outdoor base in Norway.

BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF THE COMPANY

During the summer season, we operate an outdoor activity base offering rafting, canyoning and mountain carts. In summer 2026, we welcomed 3,621 guests. The summer season runs from mid-May to mid-September.

During the winter season, we operate a small ski centre with the longest toboggan run in Norway and a ski rental service. In winter 2026, we welcomed 4,774 guests. The winter season runs from mid-December to mid-April.

During both seasons, guests can stay in our apartment or lavvo camp (maximum capacity of 49 people), and enjoy the facilities (sauna, hot tub, party lavvo and gas grill).

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Management of the employee team:

    • Summer season: reception, booking, service (cleaning, café, shopping), guide team for rafting, canyoning and mountain carts, head guide (responsible for the operation of activities), drivers and maintenance -- approximately 15 people in total

    • Winter season: reception, booking, service (cleaning, café, shopping), ski lift operators, snow groomer and maintenance -- approximately 5 people in total

  • Manual and administrative management, development and maintenance of the base

  • Practical day-to-day operation of the base and its activities

  • Administration and preparation of materials for accounting

  • Management of company assets (buildings, vehicles and activity equipment)

  • Cooperation with the Finance Director, Booking and Marketing departments

EMPLOYMENT DETAILS

Start: September 2026

Location: Dagali Fjellpark, Perstulvegen 100, 3588 Dagali, Norway

Working hours & remuneration

  • Number of working days during the winter season (mid-December -- mid-April): approximately 101

  • Number of working days during the summer season (mid-May -- mid-September): approximately 107

  • To be adjusted according to the candidate's abilities and mutual agreement.

Compensation: approximately NOK 220/hour, or alternatively a fixed salary based on the expected number of working hours, subject to agreement.

In the case of a long-term cooperation (after the trial period and with the agreement of both parties), we can discuss a fixed salary and performance-based bonus.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

  • Management skills

  • Assertive attitude and advanced communication skills

  • Experience working in tourism

  • Positive attitude towards outdoor activities

  • Good knowledge of English

  • Willingness to stay in Dagali (Geilo) long-term and continuously from mid-December to mid-April and from mid-May to mid-September

  • Good computer skills and ability to handle administrative tasks

  • Ability to work outdoors in all weather conditions when necessary (snow, frost, wind, rain)

  • Responsibility, independence and attention to detail

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Long-term cooperation

  • Varied and interesting work

  • Working in the mountains and in a natural environment

  • Opportunity to participate in the development of the company

  • Benefits:

    • Free accommodation at the workplace during the first season; accommodation for future seasons by agreement.

    • Assistance with obtaining an ID number and tax card

    • Free rental of winter equipment for personal leisure activities

    • Free participation in our activities, subject to availability.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Dagali Fjellpark is a professional outdoor center that offers summer activities (rafting, canyoning, mountain carts) and winter activities (ski center, toboggan run). The place has accommodation for about 40 people, and a small cafe.

jobs.title: Säljare - Account Manager till Hitta.se Helsingborg

Säljare - Account Manager

Hitta.se är förmodligen Sveriges äldsta & coolaste start-up! Vill du vara med och utveckla vår relation med företag runt om i Sverige? ⭐

Sluta leta - Börja på Hitta.

- Arbeta med kunder över hela Sverige 🇸🇪 - Nå uppsatt budget, både individuellt och tillsammans med teamet 🚀 - Arbeta i huvudsak med telefonen som arbetsredskap 📲 - Lägga grunden för långsiktiga relationer mellan Hitta.se & företag runt om i Sverige 🤝 - Bidra till lagkänslan på kontoret 🎉

Vem är du?

För att lyckas hos oss på Hitta.se så är det viktigaste att du har rätt personligt driv, triggas av att jobba mot högt uppsatta mål och att du har bestämt dig för att bli en riktig vass säljare🥇 Kanske har du tidigare arbetat med försäljning eller har en bakgrund inom idrott.

Du är en relationsbyggare med en stark kommunikativ ådra. Försäljningen bygger på att skapa nya relationer och vi söker dig som är duktig på att fånga vad kunden har för önskemål och behov.

Du har även mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift. Ett stort plus är om du har tidigare erfarenhet av att jobba med försäljning och/eller erfarenhet av media och marknadsföring.

Att jobba med Hitta.se

Hos oss strävar vi alltid efter att ta hand om varandra och vi sätter vår kultur och våra värdering i centrum i allt vi gör. På Hitta är samarbete, innovation och kundfokus våra allra viktigaste ledord.

Vi erbjuder dig:

- En arbetsplats i Helsingborg med fantastiska kollegor - Daglig coachning och regelbunden säljträning - Ett utmanande jobb med stor möjlighet till personlig utveckling - Tillsvidaretjänst med en fast månadslön och väl tilltagen provision - Hitta Awards gala där vi firar årets fina prestationer och hyllar varandra - Fredags-AW, gemensamma frukostar, fester och massa annat roligt!

Lär känna Marina, en av våra säljare

Vad tycker du är roligast med att jobba på Hitta.se?

"Mest av allt gillar jag det personliga mötet, att vara ute och träffa kunder inom olika branscher. Tydliga mål, fantastiska kollegor och vetskapen om att jag jobbar på ett företag som alltid vill framåt."

Hur ser en vanlig arbetsvecka ut?

"Livet på Hitta bjuder aldrig på en ”vanlig” arbetsvecka då ingen vecka är den andra lik. Det gör jobbet utmanande och spännande. Jag behandlar både nya och befintliga kunder i min roll på Hitta."

Om tjänsten  Tjänsten är en heltidstjänst på vårt Helsingborgskontor. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!   Om Hitta.se

Hitta.se är en plattform som gör det enkelt för företagare att hitta och bygga relationer med lokala kunder genom självkörande marknadsföring. Vi är Sveriges lokala marknadsplats som erbjuder tjänster för att smidigt och snabbt hitta relevant information om företag, personer och platser. Samtidigt tillhandahåller vi våra företagskunder en bred portfölj av innovativa tjänster och produkter som förenklar vardagen, attraherar kunder och ökar försäljningen.

jobs.title: Toma søger Servicemedarbejder til kunde i Aalborg Øst
jobs.description:
Er du serviceminded, fleksibel og god til at arbejde selvstændigt? Så er det måske dig, vi søger.

Vi søger en servicemedarbejder til en alsidig stilling hos en af vores kunder i Aalborg Øst, hvor du får en kombination af faste rengøringsopgaver og forskellige service- og ad hoc-opgaver på tværs af kundens bygninger.

Du arbejder 5 timer dagligt, mandag til fredag, kl. 06.00–11.00, svarende til 25 timer om ugen.

Din arbejdsdag består af:

  • 3 timers fast rengøring i et område, som du får ansvaret for

  • 2 timer til service- og ad hoc-opgaver på tværs af kundens bygninger

Ad hoc-opgaverne kan blandt andet være ekstra rengøringsopgaver, udbedring af mangler og andre praktiske opgaver, der opstår i løbet af dagen.

Du skal derfor trives med en arbejdsdag, hvor nogle opgaver er faste, mens andre opstår løbende og kræver, at du er fleksibel og kan omstille dig.

Du får stillet en mobiltelefon til rådighed, så du kan modtage de løbende opgaver.

Vi søger dig, der

  • Er fleksibel og trives med forskellige typer opgaver

  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret

  • tager ansvar for de opgaver, du får tildelt

  • har øje for kvalitet og den gode service

Erfaring med rengøring eller facility service er en fordel, men det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling og tager ansvar for dit arbejde.

Vi tilbyder

En alsidig arbejdsdag med en god kombination af faste opgaver og variation. Du får frihed under ansvar og bliver en vigtig del af den daglige service hos vores kunde.

  • Grundig oplæring

  • Gode og ordnede arbejdsforhold

  • Løn i henhold til overenskomst

  • Sundheds- og pensionsordning

Arbejdstid: Mandag–fredag kl. 06.00–11.00
Ugentligt timetal: 25 timer
Arbejdssted: Tomas kunde i Aalborg Øst
Tiltrædelse: 1. oktober 2026

Send din ansøgning med billede og CV hurtigst muligt, da vi løbende inviterer kvalificerede ansøgere til samtale.

Ansøgning sendes til: job@toma-as.dk

Toma er landsdækkende i Danmark, og vi har 750 dygtige medarbejdere.

Vi stiller krav til kvalitet, bæredygtighed, uddannelse, og arbejder seriøst med miljø og arbejdsmiljø.

Vi er medlem af Servicenormen, er ISO 9001, 14001 og 45001 certificeret, samt har certifikat på Svanemærket rengøring.

Vi investerer i vores medarbejdere både socialt og udviklingsmæssigt, og tilbyder spændende karrieremuligheder for de rette kandidater.

Vi lever for vores serviceløfte om at skabe gode service-oplevelser og give folk en bedre arbejdsdag.

As Resource & Training Manager at NKT, you will be responsible for workforce planning, capacity management and training strategies, ensuring the organisation has the right competence and resources available to meet both current and future needs. Working closely with managers, trainers and key stakeholders, you will contribute to the development of people and support the green transition within a global company.







Are you ready to help prepare the workforce of tomorrow?







Develop workforce planning and learning strategies



As Resource & Training Manager, you will oversee resource planning and competence development activities across the organisation. The role combines strategic planning with operational follow-up, ensuring effective capacity management, resource allocation and training initiatives. You will work closely with managers and stakeholders to identify competence needs, coordinate development activities and ensure compliance with certification and training requirements. Through data analysis, workforce planning and continuous improvement, you will support long-term organisational capability and resource availability.







Your responsibility will be to:



• Lead resource planning, capacity management and resource allocation activities• Develop and maintain training and competence development strategies• Identify competence gaps and establish long-term training plans• Coordinate internal and external training activities and certification requirements• Monitor key metrics related to resources, competence and training initiatives







The role involves close collaboration with resource managers, planners, trainers and business stakeholders.



The position is based in Sweden and may include travel depending on business requirements.







Collaborative people manager with analytical mindset



You are organised and enjoy balancing long-term planning with day-to-day activities. You communicate clearly, build positive working relationships and work effectively with stakeholders at different levels of the organisation. You approach challenges with a practical mindset and enjoy identifying opportunities for improvement. In addition, you are comfortable working with data, following up activities and supporting others in achieving common objectives. Your collaborative approach helps create alignment across teams and supports a positive and inclusive working environment.







You also have:



• Relevant university degree or equivalent professional experience• Experience in resource planning, capacity management or workforce management• Experience managing training and competence development initiatives• Good knowledge of Swedish and English, written and spoken• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and relevant planning or HR systems• Experience from project-intensive or technical organisations is an advantage

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Want to be part of transforming road freight – for good? Einride is showing the world a new way to move, based on the latest digital, electric and autonomous technologies. Through freight capacity as a service, we enable businesses around the world to accelerate towards their sustainability goals.

Founded in 2016, Einride became the first company in the world to deploy a cab-less autonomous electric vehicle on a public road (Sweden, 2019). In 2022, we were the first to successfully operate such a vehicle on a US public road. Today our award-winning technology has been launched across 8 countries (and counting). Our clients are some of the world’s biggest shippers, including Fortune 500 companies. We are also operating Sweden’s largest truck dedicated public charging network and counting.

We are now looking for a Security Engineer to join our security team!

You will:

    Build, integrate and operate our security monitoring platforms that ensure we can detect and respond to security incidents in all our environments, including user endpoints, SaaS applications, cloud infrastructure, our web platforms as well as our vehicles and charging stations.
    Be involved in security incident response when required, coordinating containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident analysis.
    Build, manage and mature the vulnerability management program (including workstations, network perimeter, containers, source code, cloud configuration, etc) and build the appropriate security metrics to help drive risk-based decisions and investments.
    Build out our application security program that allows engineers to be self-empowered when appropriate and able to get assistance when required. Participate in threat modeling sessions and provide security advice in design of new and existing features.
    Collaborate with software engineers to help them improve our products’ security posture: help patch vulnerabilities, run security audits, explain complex IAM topics, brainstorm monitoring use-cases, etc

We expect you to:

    5+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity or security engineering roles.
    Working experience in securing and monitoring public cloud infrastructure (e.g., ideally GCP, but any major cloud providers such as AWS or Azure work).
    Working experience in vulnerability management on multiple layers of the modern IT and software stack
    Experience with security incident management (preferably in a SOC, CDC or similar)
    Ability to code/script and automate repetitive tasks. We primarily use Go but if you have a general knack for coding, that matters more than having previous experience with a specific language.
    Great collaboration and communication skills, since you’ll be part of driving initiatives that span across the entire company.

This is a full-time position based in Stockholm or Gothenburg. You will be part of a truly diverse, high performing team with a common passion for sustainability and making things happen in an innovative way. We recommend that you submit your application as soon as possible since selection and interviews are held continually.

Please note that as part of our standard recruitment process, we conduct a background control on the final candidate for this role. This may include verification of education, employment history, any relevant professional certifications or other information that may be of our interest.

At Einride, we are innovators, building solutions the world has never seen before – but urgently needs. That’s why we take action, and it’s why we are always eager to be challenged. We know that our best innovations come from having a diverse mix of people, including those of different experiences, career paths, and walks of life. By coming together and sharing our perspectives openly – by disagreeing, discussing, and committing – we deliver greater impact.

Born autonomous. Born electric.

Since 2016, our technology has connected global communities with the things they need – and all without the emissions. We’re made up of experts in multiple fields and that’s how we’ve developed a new way to move goods. This is technology purpose-built for the industry. This is safer, cleaner, and more reliable movement.

We are Einride and this is how we build a better future.

jobs.description:
_UHANDA Oy on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen majoitusalan pioneeri. Ei vain puheissa, vaan aidosti käytännössä ja arjen toimissa._

_Keväällä 2026 UHANDA täytti kuusi vuotta. Tänään matkaa jatketaan kuuden hotellin ja yli 800 kalustetun asunnon voimin 15 eri paikkakunnalla. Toimintansa alusta lähtien UHANDA on avannut alalla eniten uusia hotelleja Suomeen ja kasvattanut kalustettujen asuntojen liiketoimintaansa alan ripeintä tahtia._

**UHANDA ETSII OPERATIIVISTA PÄÄLLIKKÖÄ.**

**(Asiakas- & myyntipalvelu + siivous- ja laatuyhteistyö, 6 hotellin hotellipäällikkö)**

**Rooli lyhyesti**

**Titteli:** Operatiivinen päällikkö

**Vastuualue:** UHANDA:n hotelliportfolio: asiakas- & myyntipalvelu, kohteiden palvelullinen toimivuus ja ylläpito sekä siivous- ja laatuyhteistyö

**Onnistumisen mitta:** vieraiden ja asiakkaiden tyytyväisyys koko portfoliossa

**Tiimi:** 5 hengen asiakas- & myyntipalvelutiimi

**Raportoit:** Toimitusjohtajalle osana tulevaa johtoryhmää

**Sijainti:** Pääkonttori Tampere. Työ vaatii n. 2–3 reissupäivää kuukaudessa, ja ne ovat tyypillisesti yhdessä putkessa.

**TYÖ**

**Tiimin johtaminen**

Sinulla on täysi vastuu viiden hengen asiakas- ja myyntipalvelutiimistä: sen arjesta, ihmisistä, osaamisesta ja kehittymisestä. Resursointi, työvuorosuunnittelu, perehdytys, valmentaminen ja palvelutason varmistaminen ovat sinun käsissäsi. Onnistumista mitataan sillä, miten tiimi onnistuu, ei sillä, miten paljon itse ehdit tehdä.

**Asiakas- ja myyntipalvelun arki**

Vastaat siitä, että vieraiden ja asiakkaiden yhteydenotot hoidetaan nopeasti, laadukkaasti ja kaupallisesti järkevästi vuorokauden ja viikon jokaisessa kohdassa. Tähän kuuluvat palvelutaso ja vasteajat, tarjous- ja varauspyynnöt, poikkeustilanteet sekä palautteiden käsittely niin, että niistä myös opitaan.

Hands-on-tyylimme tarkoittaa, että iso osa työstä, arjen päällä olosta ja kehityksen suunnittelusta tapahtuu käytännön ohessa. Tarkoittaen, että kehittävää ja edistävää työtä tehdään myös asiakaspalveluvuoroissa.

**Siivous- ja laatuyhteistyö**

Vastaat siivous- ja laatuyhteistyöstä kumppaniverkostomme kanssa: yhteisistä standardeista, niiden seurannasta ja siitä, että laatu on tasalaatuista jokaisessa kohteessa. Käytännössä tämä on kumppanisuhteiden johtamista, laadun mittaamista ja poikkeamiin tarttumista siten, että ne ovat huomioituna ja ratkottuna ennen kuin nämä välittyvät vieraille.

**Systemaattinen kehittäminen**

Hyödynnämme vahvasti nykyaikaisia työkaluja ja niiden mahdollistamia toimintamalleja, ja implementoimme järjestelmäkehitystä uusien ominaisuuksien kautta arkeen systemaattisesti. Se tarkoittaa, että muutos ja kehitys ovat meillä vakio.

Tässä roolissa olet oman vastuualueesi prosessien omistaja: tunnistat kehityskohdat, määrittelet tarpeet yhdessä tiimin kanssa, jalkautat uudet ominaisuudet arkeen ja koulutat tiimin niiden käyttöön. Ylläpito ja kehitys eivät ole toistensa vastakohtia, vaan molemmat kuuluvat samaan ruutuun, josta vastaat yhdessä tiimisi kanssa.

**Odotamme sinulta**

Kokemusta ihmisten ja arjen johtamisesta ja halua kehittyä siinä edelleen

Operatiivista otetta dynaamisessa ympäristössä, ja kykyä nauttia jatkuvasti elävästä arjesta ja sen rytmistä

Kaupallista ja liiketoiminnallista ajattelutapaa. Asiakaskokemukset ovat aina keskiössä ja toimivat linkkinä jokaiseen liiketoiminnan osa-alueeseen

Aitoa kiinnostusta ohjata arkea ja päätöksiä datan kautta, johon yhdistyy inhimillinen ihmisten ymmärrys

Rohkeutta tarttua asioihin, joita kukaan ei ole vielä pyytänyt sinua tarttumaan

Emme edellytä tiettyä koulutusta tai vuosimäärää alalta. Olemme rekrytoineet monesta eri profiilista ja taustasta, ja ensisijaisen kriittistä meille on asenne ja draivi. On paljon asioita, joissa voimme tukea ja sparrata, mutta uskomme, että kaikki lähtee aina ensin yksilön omasta motivaatiosta ja tahtotilasta onnistua asiakkaidemme puolesta.

**Tarjoamme**

Tarjoamme toimenkuvan ja työpaikan, jossa pääset johtamaan valmiiksi rakennettuja, toimivaksi todettuja malleja ja kehittämään niitä eteenpäin siten, että pääset konkreettisesti näkemään oman kädenjälkesi. Sinulla on tukena organisaatio, jossa on prosesseja, toimintoja ja rooleja, jotka tarkoittavat, ettei kaikkea tarvitse itse tehdä.

Tämä on työympäristö, jossa vastuu on kaksisuuntainen ja se mahdollistaa sen, että tunnet ja näet oman työsi arvon ja olet päättämässä ja vaikuttamassa, miltä UHANDA:n seuraavat kasvuvaiheet näyttävät.

**UHANDA lukuina – vuoden 2026 näkymä**

Hotelleja: 6

Kalustettuja asuntoja: yli 800

Asiakasarviot: 8,6 / 10

Liikevaihto: n. 18 miljoonaa euroa

Kasvu: n. 90 %

**Toimitusjohtajalta**

_"Loistavan porukan ja työyhteisön lisäksi yksi arvokkaimmista asioista, joita tunnistan meidän voivan tarjota, on eväitä tulevaisuuden työelämään ja arkeen. Arjen ohjaaminen ja liiketoiminnan johtaminen ovat suuren murroksen äärellä, ja olen henkilökohtaisesti innoissani siitä, että tapa, jolla lähestymme asioita ja haastamme omaa tekemistämme, kasvattaa samalla jokaista meistä ammattilaisena._

_Jos uteliaisuus heräsi ja mietit, että vitsit kuinka mielenkiintoinen paikka voisi olla, mutta kun just nyt on kaikki kivasti. Niin muista, että joskus pitää olla valmis luopumaan hyvästä, jotta voi saavuttaa jotain loistavaa. Toivottavasti tämä voisi olla sinulle jotain loistavaa. "_

**Micke, toimitusjohtaja** **Uhanda Oy**

Vi søger to engagerede og dygtige bioanalytikere til faste stillinger på 37 timer i Nuklearmedicinsk Klinik på Regionshospitalet Gødstrup. 

Stillingerne er ledige fra 1. januar 2027 eller efter aftale. 

 

Hvad tilbyder vi? 

Hos os bliver du en del af en højteknologisk afdeling, hvor vi arbejder med avanceret billeddiagnostik og komplekse patientforløb. 

Vi prioriterer faglig udvikling, læring og tæt tværfagligt samarbejde højt – både individuelt og i fællesskab. Vi tror på, at høj faglighed og et godt arbejdsmiljø går hånd i hånd. 

Når du starter hos os, får du en grundig oplæring, der tager udgangspunkt i dine kompetencer og erfaringer. Du bliver samtidig en del af et stærkt hold af kolleger, som værdsætter både faglig sparring, hjælpsomhed og et godt grin i hverdagen. 

 

Hvem er du? 

Vi leder efter en fagligt velfunderet og ansvarlig kollega, der: 

har interesse for nuklearmedicin 

tager ansvar for egne undersøgelser og har blik for den gode patientoplevelse 

trives i et tværfagligt miljø og bidrager aktivt til det gode samarbejde 

er reflekterende i sin praksis og nysgerrig på at finde de bedste løsninger 

har lyst til længerevarende patientkontakt – gerne med erfaring inden for specialet 

 

Hvad kan du forvente? 

Spændende og alsidige arbejdsopgaver, hovedsageligt inden for PET/CT, DBT (distal blodtryksmåling) og BMD (knoglemineralmåling). Med tiden kan andre modaliteter komme i spil. 

Fri i weekender og på helligdage. Vores åbningstid er mandag til torsdag kl. 08.00-15.30 og fredag kl. 08.00-15.00. 

Indflydelse på din egen faglige udvikling og mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer. 

Et stærkt fagligt miljø, hvor vi prioriterer videreuddannelse, videndeling og faglig sparring. 

Kollegaer, der både tager deres faglighed alvorligt – og som synes, at det er helt okay at have det sjovt, mens vi er på arbejde. 

 

Om afdelingen 

Nuklearmedicinsk Klinik råder over moderne udstyr, herunder tre SPECT/CT-scannere, to PET/CT-scannere samt flere organspecifikke modaliteter. 

Vi er en tværfaglig gruppe bestående af erfarne bioanalytikere, sygeplejerske, sekretærer, speciallæger inden for både nuklearmedicin og radiologi, hospitalsfysikere, radiokemikere, bioanalytikerunderviser og en IT-medarbejder. 

Vi arbejder tæt sammen på tværs af faggrupper og har et fælles mål om at sikre hurtig, præcis og patientcentreret diagnostik. 

 

Er du vores nye kollega? 

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig! 

 

Send din ansøgning senest 8. november 2026. 

Der afholdes samtaler 26. november 2026. 

 

Vil du høre mere? 

Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte: 

TR Stine Taudahl Søndergaard 
Tlf. 78 43 73 21 

Chefbioanalytiker Anette Riis 
Tlf. 78 43 08 39 

Stillings- og funktionsbeskrivelse 

Du kan se mere om afdelingen: 

https://www.regionshospitalet-goedstrup.dk/afdelinger/nuklearmedicin/ 

Ansættelse er betinget af en tilfredsstillende børneattest. 

Du kan søge online ved at klikke på ”Send ansøgning”. Vedhæft din ansøgning og dit CV (i pdf- eller Word-format).  


Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

jobs.title: Research technician – Molecular Biology and Genomics
jobs.description:
Department of Plant Biology

The TRIGEN research team at the Department of Plant Biology, SLU, is looking for a motivated research technician to support a set of ongoing experiments involving DNA and RNA extraction and genomic sequencing.

This is an opportunity to become an important part of a research project, working alongside scientists in a dynamic and collaborative environment at Biocentrum, Ultuna. If you enjoy practical laboratory work and want to contribute directly to generating high-quality genomic data, we would be very happy to hear from you.

About the position

We are looking for a research technician to support the TRIGEN research team with a defined set of molecular biology experiments. The position will focus primarily on the processing of cereal samples and preparation of material for downstream sequencing.

You will be responsible for:

    Extracting DNA and RNA from plant samples using established protocols.
    Assessing the concentration and quality of extracted DNA and RNA.
    Organizing and tracking a large number of samples throughout the experimental workflow.
    Preparing Genotyping-by-Sequencing (GBS) libraries, including the relevant enzymatic digestion, adapter ligation, amplification and purification steps.
    Performing quality control of sequencing libraries.
    Preparing and pooling libraries for submission to an external sequencing facility.
    Maintaining accurate laboratory records and sample documentation.
    Following established protocols and ensuring high-quality and reproducible laboratory work.

The work will involve a relatively large number of samples, making careful sample handling, organization and attention to detail particularly important. You will work independently on the laboratory tasks while being part of the broader TRIGEN research team and interacting closely with researchers involved in the experiments.

Your profile

We are looking for a person with practical experience in molecular biology who is comfortable working independently in a research laboratory.

Requirements

    Masters degree or equivalent experience in molecular biology, biotechnology, plant biology or a related field  that the employer considers equivalent.
    Practical experience with DNA and/or RNA extraction.
    Experience with molecular biology techniques such as PCR, DNA purification and nucleic acid quantification.
    Good laboratory organization and documentation skills.
    Ability to work carefully and systematically with large numbers of samples.
    Ability to follow established protocols accurately and independently.
    Good communication and collaboration skills.

Meritorious

    Previous experience with Genotyping-by-Sequencing (GBS), RAD-seq or other NGS library preparation methods.
    Experience with high-throughput sample processing.
    Experience preparing sequencing libraries for submission to an external sequencing facility.
    Experience working with plant material.
    Experience with quality control of DNA, RNA or sequencing libraries.

We particularly value a candidate who is meticulous, reliable, well organized and enjoys hands-on experimental work.

About us

The successful candidate will join the TRIGEN research team at the Department of Plant Biology, Biocentrum, SLU Ultuna.

At the Department of Plant Biology, we conduct research and education in plant biology, addressing fundamental and applied questions using approaches ranging from molecular and cellular biology to genetics, genomics and plant–environment interactions. The department is part of the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU), a leading university in life and environmental sciences.

For more information about the Department of Plant Biology, visit https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/department-of-plant-biology/

About TRIGEN: https://www.slu.se/en/research/research-catalogue/projekt/t/trigen/

Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

Location:

Uppsala, Biocentrum.

Form of employment:

Fixed-term employment 2 months, with the possibility of extension.

Scope:

100%.

Start date:

October 2026, or as agreed.

Application:

Please submit your application before deadline 17 September 2026. You can submit your application by clicking the button below.

We welcome your application consisting of:

    A CV describing your education, laboratory experience and relevant technical skills.
    A short motivation letter describing your interest in the position and relevant experience.
    Contact information for at least one reference.

Union representatives:

https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/





The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

Forestil dig en by, hvor du kan starte din arbejdsdag med en cappuccino på en solrig terrasse, og afslutte den med en vandretur i bjergene — uden at forlade hovedstaden. Sofia er ikke bare smuk og prisvenlig. Den er også Europas mest undervurderede tech-hub.

Her finder du et blomstrende IT- og service-miljø, hvor internationale virksomheder tilbyder karrierer inden for kundeservice, softwareudvikling, AI og digital transformation. Med over 500 aktive tech-virksomheder og en vækst på 15% om året, er Sofia blevet en magnet for unge talenter og erfarne specialister fra hele verden.

Og sproget? Engelsk er det uofficielle arbejdssprog. Du kan tale med kolleger, naboer og cafépersonale uden at skifte gear. Det gør integrationen nem og naturlig — også for dig, der kommer fra Danmark.

Med en flad skat på kun 10%, lave leveomkostninger og en livsstil, der balancerer arbejde og fritid, får du mere ud af både din løn og din tid. Her er der plads til ambitioner, men også til at leve.

Sofia er byen, hvor du kan bygge en international karriere uden at give afkald på livskvalitet. Og det bedste? Du behøver ikke vælge mellem bjergluft og byliv — du får begge dele.

jobs.title: Fellowship in reconstructive microsurgery
jobs.description:
Verksamhetsområde plastik- och käkkirurgi

Vi är Akademiska sjukhuset – ett av Sveriges ledande universitetssjukhus. Som länssjukhus och leverantör av högspecialiserad vård erbjuder vi vård till två miljoner människor i Mellansverige. Här händer det ständigt något – ett nytt liv föds, en mormor opereras, en kollega hyllas som hjälte. Hos oss får du uppleva både hårda prövningar och fantastiska händelser, i en stark gemenskap med kollegor. Välkommen med din ansökan!

Program Description
The department of Plastic and Maxillofacial surgery offers a 6-month fellowship in reconstructive microsurgery. Uppsala is one of the more active units in reconstructive microsurgery in northern Europe with a case load consisting of more than 120 free flaps, 50 complex non microvascular cases in the areas of head and neck reconstruction, breast reconstruction, facial paralysis, lower extremity and complex wound care and more than 50 lymphaticovenous operations per year. The free flap service includes head and neck reconstructions, lower extremity, facial palsy, breast and lymphoedema. The fellowship program is endorsed by the Swedish Society for Reconstructive Microsurgery.

Fellowship Responsibilities
The fellow will work in a team of specialists and residents and will participate in the planning and execution of the reconstructive cases performed by the team. The fellow will participate in all teaching activities in the department and will be responsible for around one monthly presentation.
The fellow is required to undertake one research project within microsurgery and is expected to finish one publication.

Salary
Competitive salary and possibility for accommodation in Uppsala.

Requirements
The candidate must be specialist in plastic surgery or finish a training program in plastic surgery and have an ambition to pursue a career in reconstructive microsurgery and be able to work in a team.

How to apply
Submit your CV and two letters of recommendation.

Contact
Andres Rodriguez, andres.rodriguez.lorenzo@akademiska.se (andres.rodriguez.lorenzo@akademiska.se)

Facklig kontaktperson nås via Upplands Allmänna Läkarförening, kansli 018-611 34 95

Vill du jobba med oss?
Välkommen med din ansökan via länken nedan.

Läs om anställningsvillkor och lönesättning inom Region Uppsala här: Bli vår nya kollega (https://regionuppsala.se/jobb-och-utbildning/bli-var-nya-kollega/)

Region Uppsala värdesätter de kvaliteter som jämn könsfördelning och mångfald tillför verksamheten och ser gärna sökande av alla kön och med olika födelsebakgrund, funktionalitet och livserfarenhet.

Region Uppsala krigsplacerar all tillsvidareanställd personal utifrån totalförsvarets behov. Detta innebär för den enskilda medarbetaren inga förpliktelser i fredstid utan är enkom en planeringsåtgärd.

Inför beslut om anställning, sker kontroll av misstanke- och belastningsregister avseende samtliga arbetssökanden som i den sökta anställningen kan komma att arbeta inom psykiatrisk sjukvård, habilitering, vård av barn och ungdom eller tvångsvård av missbrukare, områden som omfattas av fakultativa registerutdrag. Detta gäller således alla som kommer att arbeta patientnära, även om arbetsuppgifterna i nuläget inte är tänkta att huvudsakligen innehålla arbete med ovan nämnda patientgrupper.

Denna rekrytering sker helt genom Region Uppsalas försorg och vi undanber oss telefonsamtal från rekryteringsföretag och annonsförsäljare.

jobs.title: Machine Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Join Our Team as a Machine Automation Engineer!

We're currently seeking a talented Machine Automation Engineer to join our Semiconductor ALD Business Unit. In this role, you'll design the software and automation that brings our atomic layer deposition (ALD) equipment to life - building control solutions for fully automated system clusters used in semiconductor manufacturing around the world.

Your Role and Responsibilities:

As a Machine Automation Engineer you will design, develop and maintain the automation software for Beneq ALD equipment. Alongside project deliveries, your work will drive the continuous development and maintenance of our existing automation systems — from the first line of code in our development laboratory all the way to commissioning at customer sites.

Key Responsibilities include:

* Design, develop and maintain software solutions that meet high safety and reliability standards for controlling machines in a fully automated system cluster

* Design and improve HMI applications and user interfaces for machine operations

* Conduct and participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to best practices

* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyse requirements, translating them into technical specifications

* Create and maintain technical documentation for the software systems

* Conduct testing activities during tool delivery, including simulation testing in our development laboratory

* Commission equipment at customer premises

* Support our Software Application Support Engineers with questions coming from the field



What We're Looking For:

To excel in this role, you should have:

* A strong engineering background with 4+ years of experience, typically a BSc or MSc degree in automation engineering.

* Experience with automation instrumentation and electrical drawings.

* Experience with structured text coding (IEC 61131-3) in a PLC environment.

* Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases (Postgres, MSSQL).

* Familiarity with UML and other modelling methods.

* Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD tools.

* Knowledge of HTML5 and JS-based HMI design tools.

* A solid understanding of software development methodologies and software quality assurance principles.

* Solid problem-solving skills, a self-guided and customer-oriented mindset, and a can-do attitude.

* A technical mindset with great attention to detail, a structured way of working and strong documentation skills.

* Excellent communication skills in English.

* Willingness to travel approximately 50–60 days per year to customer premises worldwide.

Bonus Skills (Not Required but Nice to Have):

* Knowledge of Beckhoff TwinCAT 3 or Codesys environments.

* Experience with C#.

* Experience from the semiconductor industry or other high-tech equipment manufacturing.

What We Offer:

At Beneq, you'll have the unique chance to work in a global high-tech environment that blends the dynamic energy of a fast-growing company with the stability and resources of a larger enterprise. You'll work on our own product development, with global operations and services in Japan, Taiwan, China, the USA and the EU - so your work reaches customers on nearly every continent.

We value diversity and support personal and professional development, offering a collaborative workspace where you can thrive alongside colleagues from over 20 different nationalities. The role is mainly office-based in Espoo, with remote work possible up to 40% when work activities allow it, and occasional clean room activities to support testing or to upgrade and troubleshoot our equipment.

Working at Beneq means being part of a supportive team that values curiosity and innovation. You'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while advancing your career in a truly global industry.

Interested? Here's What to Do Next:

If you're excited about joining our team in Espoo, we'd love to hear from you! Please submit your application, including your CV and cover letter, via the apply link to our recruitment portal by 30 September. We encourage you to apply early - we may start the interview process during the application period.

For more information about the role, please contact Joonas Taipalus, Lead Automation Software Development Engineer, at +358 50 491 6424. He will be available for inquiries during the application period on Mondays and Wednesdays between 12.30 - 15.00 EET. Please note that applications are only accepted through our recruitment portal.




Beneq is the home of atomic layer deposition. Our mission is to be dedicated to the success of the More-than-Moore device makers by delivering best in class, innovative, and flexible ALD equipment and service solutions. In 1984, we established the worlds first industrial production using ALD. Today, we lead the market with products for semiconductor device fabrication, R&D, and varied ALD solutions. We operate globally and employ 170+ people on three continents. We are a unique employer that combines the hands-on, dynamic mindset of a fast-growth startup with the solid funding and resources of a larger enterprise. Beneqs team of engineers and experts are committed to delivering world class ALD solutions and enabling technology mega trends through advanced solutions. Beneq is headquartered in Finland with legal entities in the USA and Japan.

About Avincis

Avincis is one of the world’s leading operators in emergency aviation services and the largest in Europe. We operate more than 180 bases across Spain, Portugal, Italy, Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Greece, Mozambique, and Chile.

Our fleet consists of approximately 205 aircraft — 165 helicopters and 40 fixed-wing aircraft — used in critical missions every day. We save lives, protect communities, and support essential services, from air ambulance and search & rescue to wildfire suppression and government operations.

With over 3,000 employees across Europe, we combine the precision and speed of aviation with a strong sense of purpose: making a difference when it truly matters.

Come and join Avincis and help keep air ambulance services safe and efficient across the Nordic region!

jobs.title: Haemme useita myyjiä Eepeen Ruokatoreille, S-market Kivistöön ja Seinäjoen Prismaan
jobs.description:
Primary location:
SEINÄJOKI

Haemme useita myyjiä Eepeen Ruokatoreille, S-market Kivistöön ja Seinäjoen Prismaan
Etsimme nyt Ruokatorin myyjiä määräaikaisiin ja vakituisiin työsuhteisiin, joissa työtunteja on 20-35h/vko. Ruokatorimme tekevät tiivistä yhteistyötä keskenään, joten työvuoroja voidaan tehdä joustavasti sekä S-market Kivistön että Prisman Ruokatorilla. Aiempi kokemus asiakaspalvelusta, ruokatuotteiden käsittelystä, valmistuksesta tai myynnistä sekä alan koulutus katsotaan eduksi, mutta tärkeintä on halu oppia ja kehittää omaa osaamista ruokatorin monipuolisissa tehtävissä.


Millaista työ ruokatorilla on?
Ruokatorin työssä yhdistyvät vaihtelevat ruokatorin tehtävät sekä marketin myyjän työ. Päivän aikana palvelet asiakkaita, suosittelet tuotteita ja autat löytämään sopivia ratkaisuja niin arkeen kuin juhlaan sekä pidät huolta tuotteiden houkuttelevasta esillepanosta. Lisäksi työhön kuuluu myös salaattien, valmisruokien ja muiden herkkujen valmistamista, tilausten tekemistä sekä hävikin hallintaa sekä myyjän yleisiä tehtäviä. Työ tarjoaa mahdollisuuden hyödyntää osaamistasi laajasti ja oppia jatkuvasti uutta ruoan, asiakaspalvelun ja kaupan alan tehtävien parissa.


Odotamme sinulta

Edellytämme halua työskennellä vuorotyössä kaupan aukioloaikoina.

Myyjän työssä tarvitaan aitoa halua tehdä asiakaspalvelu- ja myyntityötä sekä reipasta oma-aloitteisuutta.

Työ kaupassa on tänä päivänä yhä digitaalisempaa, ja siksi odotamme sinulta myös halua oppia käyttämään erilaisia järjestelmiä ja myymälän teknisiä työvälineitä.

Teemme työtä tiiminä, joten arvostamme hyvää työkaveruutta, yhteistyötaitoja ja halua työskennellä markettien erilaisissa työtehtävissä.

Ruokatorin tehtävissä menestyy parhaiten henkilö, jolla on aito kiinnostus ruokaan. Tuotteiden suosittelu ja ruoanlaitosta keskustelu on osa työtehtäviä.

Täysi-ikäisyyttä.



Me Eepeellä sanomme olevamme Ihan tavallisissatöissä. Työtä kuvaillaan usein erilaisin korulausein, jotka toivottavasti ovat myös totta, mutta meidän mielestämme ihan tavallinen työ on mahtavaa. Meillä on myös poikkeuksellisen kivoja työkavereita, erinomaisia henkilöstöetuja ja harvinaisen paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia.


Tarjoamme sinulle:
Miltä kuulostaisi -25 % alennus S-ryhmän ravintoloista? Tai henksuhintainen hotellihuone viikonlopuksi? Suomen parhaimmiksikin kutsutuista S-ryhmän ja Eepeen henkilöstöeduista voit lukea esimakuatäältä.

Koko henkilöstöämme koskevatulospalkkiojärjestelmä

Kattavat työterveyspalvelut sekä liikunnan, kulttuurin ja hyvinvoinninEpassi-edut

Poikkeuksellisen paljon mahdollisuuksia! Voit vaihtaa ammattia, toimialaa tai ottaa lisätyötä oman osaamisesi ja toiveidesi mukaan


Haku on avoinna 20.9.2026 saakka - käsittelemme hakemuksia ja teemme valintoja jo hakuaikana, joten laita hakemusta reippaasti tulemaan.
Työt alkaa sopimuksen mukaan syksyn aikana. Mainitse hakemuksellasi haetko ensisijaisesti S-market Kivistöön vai Prismaan.

Lisätietoja: Olli Isoniemi, Eepeen ruokatorien projektipäällikkösp. olli.isoniemi@sok.fi / p. 010 7646296

******************************************************************
Etelä-Pohjanmaan Osuuskauppa on monipuolinen työpaikka!
Eepee on osuuskauppa,jonka omistavat sen yli 95 000 asiakasomistajaa. Tarjoamme toimialueellamme työpaikan 1300 palvelualan ammattilaiselle 71 toimipaikassamme.
Eepeellä teemme ihan tavallisia töitä. Tavallisuus on voima, joka erottaa meidät muista. Meillä työ ei ole vain peruspesti, mutta samalla se on juuri sitä. Tavallinen työ on sitä, mitä pitääkin olla – tehokasta, arvokasta ja tärkeää. Ihan tavallisen työn lisäksi, meillä on epätavallisen hyvät edut ja poikkeuksellisen mahtavat työkaverit. Tutustu meihin paremmin ja kurkkaa, mitä tulevat työkaverisi kertovat työstään – ehkä seuraava tarina on sinun.

jobs.title: Scaled Customer Success Manager, EMEA
jobs.description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

The Scaled Customer Success Manager joins Harvey's Scaled Customer Success team to drive retention, renewal, and expansion outcomes across a high-volume book of business. The team's mission is to deliver strategic, efficient value at scale—ensuring customers adopt Harvey's AI solutions deeply and renew with confidence. This role owns the full commercial lifecycle for a portfolio of accounts, blending consultative customer engagement with a data-driven renewals motion to maximize net revenue retention. Scaled CSMs partners closely with Sales, Legal Engineering, and Product to translate customer feedback into roadmap influence and expansion opportunity. It is a rare opportunity to shape a growing function at the intersection of AI innovation and customer value delivery.

What You'll Do

  • Own renewals and expansions across a named portfolio of accounts, driving net revenue retention and gross retention targets through proactive commercial engagement.

  • Lead scaled customer engagement motions—including QBRs, value reviews, and enablement sessions—to maximize product adoption and demonstrate ongoing ROI.

  • Monitor customer health using data and analytics, identifying churn signals early and executing structured intervention plans to protect and grow revenue.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers with a prescriptive, consultative approach, integrating Harvey into their workflows and championing the power of LLMs.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal Engineering, Product, and Sales to relay customer insights, influence the product roadmap, and align on shared goals.

  • Build and refine scalable playbooks and processes that elevate the team's approach to customer engagement, renewals, and expansion.


What You Have

  • 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a renewals-focused role within Enterprise SaaS, legal technology, or management consulting.

  • Demonstrated track record of managing a high-volume book of business and consistently meeting or exceeding retention and expansion targets.

  • Strong commercial acumen with experience owning renewals conversations and identifying upsell or expansion opportunities within existing accounts.

  • Excellent communication and strategic planning skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at multiple levels and deliver polished QBRs and value reviews.

  • Data-driven mindset with experience leveraging customer health metrics, adoption data, and CS platforms to inform strategy.

  • Collaborative, proactive disposition with a team-first mentality and comfort operating in a fast-paced, ambiguity-rich environment.
