jobs.title: Talent Partner [Technical]
jobs.description:
Attio is the CRM for agentic revenue. Designed for the most ambitious go-to-market teams, it gives companies the power to understand every customer, automate at scale, and build their go-to-market motion exactly as they need. We've raised $116M from some of the world's best investors: GV (Google Ventures), Redpoint, Balderton, Point Nine, and 01A.

We hire builders who thrive on complex technical challenges, hold themselves to a high bar, and genuinely care about delighting the people who use what they build. The team here brings sharp judgement, real craft, and the drive to do exceptional work. We're obsessed about the details and energized by the frontier.

If you want to do the best work of your career, this is the right place.

Why this role matters

We're doubling the size of Engineering, Product, and Design year-on-year, and the biggest constraint on how fast we build is how fast we hire. You'll join the Talent team as the connective tissue between EPD leadership and the best engineers in Europe — One day you’ll be running a sharp headhunting process process for a Staff Engineer and the next; pushing a high-volume inbound pipeline through with the same rigor. Both are equally important.

Attio is for people who own their role, learn quickly, are endlessly curious, and find happiness in delivering consistently brilliant outcomes that push the company forward. We love working with people who are passionate about working this way and will do whatever it takes to get things done.

We're particularly keen to hear from people with:

  • A track record of recruiting engineers into a startup or scale-up with a genuinely high bar — agency-side or in-house

  • Experience hiring software engineers who'd pass a tough technical bar, not just filling a requisition

  • Range across both ends of the funnel: targeted, hand-crafted outbound and high-volume inbound processing, without letting either slip

  • A real, hands-on AI-first approach to sourcing and screening — using modern tooling to work faster, not just talking about it

  • Time spent inside a high-growth environment where the team doubled year after year, and the process had to hold up under that pressure

Whether you've cut your teeth at a high-bar engineering recruitment agency, grown up inside a fast-scaling startup, or learned rigor at a big tech company, what matters more than your last logo is that you've done the reps — and you're ready to do a lot more of them here.

What you'll be doing

  • Build and run sourcing strategies for some of the hardest engineering roles in Europe

  • Own high-volume inbound processing without letting quality or candidate experience slip

  • Work on recruiting events, recruitment events and foster interest in Attio through your talent network and community

  • Bring an AI-first mindset to sourcing, screening, and process

  • Run processes end-to-end, from screening to offer management and admin to reporting

The attributes we're looking for

  • Resilient our bar is high. We only hire around 0.2% of the candidates that we source or review. You need to be genuinely fine with that ratio, not just tolerate it.

  • Resourceful the best people exist; our job is finding and reaching them, however unconventional the route.

  • Committed hiring managers need to trust that you're fully focused on raising the bar for the team, day in and day out.

  • Thoughtful given our trajectory, a role at Attio will be a genuinely meaningful step for the right person, but you can't assume that its right for everyone — we understand what candidates actually want before we tell them why we're a fit.

  • Hustle we're competing with the best, for the best. Your instincts, speed and innovative approach are often the difference between winning a candidate and losing them to someone else.

What does the hiring process look like?

We respond to candidates within 48 hours of every interview.

  1. Application review

  2. Hiring Manager interview - 30 minutes

  3. Case study / panel interview (two parts) - 1.5 hours

  4. Stakeholder interview with our VP of Engineering - 30 minutes

  5. Executive round with our CEO - 30 minutes

Most interviews are self-scheduled, but we're always on hand if you have questions along the way. By the offer stage, you may want to meet more of the team, see a demo, or ask us anything else.

What will an offer consist of?

  • A competitive salary

  • Equity in an early-stage company on an exceptional trajectory

  • Apple hardware and a budget for desk amenities

  • 25 days holiday plus local public holidays

  • Regular team events in London

  • Team off-sites in fun places (Barcelona, Lisbon, Malta, and Split so far)

  • Enhanced parental leave

About Yepoda

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Yepoda is a clean K-Beauty brand that actually proves it works. We make Korean skincare without any of the compromises. Everything is clinically tested, 100% vegan, and formulated above EU standards. So you get the innovation and the results that K-Beauty is known for, plus a real commitment to sustainability. And we make it genuinely fun and easy to use — skincare you actually look forward to.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a certified B Corp™ and 1% for the Planet member, based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available through our own online shop and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe — online and in over 650 stores. With a team of 140+ brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda's story every day.

The Opportunity

Yepoda is growing fast across Europe and expanding internationally, and we're building our first field team. This is your chance to be part of it from day one.

You'll be Yepoda's representative inside Sephora UK, not a Beauty Advisor, but a field based commercial role. You'll drive sell-out in your doors, train and coach Sephora's Beauty Advisor teams, own the store relationships, and keep our brand presentation flawless in store. Part account executive, part field trainer, part retail sales lead. You'll be responsible for the relationship, education, and sell-out across five Sephora doors in London.

The Details

  • Contract: Fixed-term 6-month contract, starting in October. Renewable by mutual agreement, with the possibility of becoming a permanent role based on performance.

  • Hours: Full-time, 5 days a week, including weekend coverage. Schedule is confirmed upon employment start, and seasonal adjustments will be mutually agreed.

  • Travel: Up to 20% of your time, subject to change by season and business needs. Covers your doors plus occasional support at Yepoda events. Yepoda will cover travel expenses (accommodation, transportation, and meal allowance).

  • Reports to: EU Sales & Education Manager

  • Location: London, UK. Field-based retail role (in-store at assigned Sephora location, mobile as needed)

 

Your Tasks

  • Own sell-out across your doors and deliver against monthly and quarterly targets

  • Sell side by side with Sephora Beauty Advisors to lift conversion and basket size

  • Negotiate and run dedicated brand moments including sales challenges, Beauty Hub takeovers, and fun days

  • Train Sephora Beauty Advisor teams on our products, routines, and brand story, from quick floor briefings to full breakfast sessions

  • Coach Sephora staff on selling technique, routine building, and cross-selling

  • Deliver launch education so every new product lands with a confident floor team behind it

  • Assist the EU Retail & Education Manager in large scale education events and press days

  • Be the face of Yepoda in store and own the relationship with Store Managers and BA teams

  • Keep gondolas and displays impeccable, testers stocked, and stock levels healthy on every visit

  • Provide weekly field reports covering sell-out by door, merchandising, and tester photos

  • Relay competitor activity and customer insight that shapes our commercial plans

 

Your Profile

  • 2 to 5 years in prestige cosmetic sales and education, or a senior Beauty Advisor ready to take their career to the next level, Sephora experience strongly preferred

  • A track record of driving sell-out in a retail environment

  • Confident delivering training, in-store events, and product demonstrations to a floor team

  • Commercially minded and customer centric with excellent interpersonal and communication skills

  • Genuinely self directed and highly organised, you run your doors and own your reporting

  • Passionate about skincare with real energy for the floor, K-Beauty knowledge is a big plus

  • Fluent English

  • Based in London with the right to work in the UK

 

What We Offer

  • Join a top, rapidly growing, K-Beauty brand. Fast growth across Europe, international expansion, and a brand people are excited to see in store.

  • The original field team. Be part of the original field team, with potential transition to permanent opportunity.

  • Real autonomy and opportunity to own your role. You own your market, run your doors and are trusted to make decisions in your scope.

  • Education & Development: Comprehensive onboarding, ongoing product and sales training, and direct mentorship from our EU Sales & Education Manager to develop advanced education techniques, presentation skills, and retail expertise.

  • The practical perks. Quarterly product gratis plus a generous employee discount; a performance linked bonus tied to your stores' sell-out (structure agreed separately).

 

Compensation range: Salary determined upon interview.

 

Would you like to be part of the team? Then we'd love to hear from you! 🫰✨

Make sure to apply by clicking on the “Apply for this job” button below. Please upload your CV and Cover Letter in English language. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get back to you as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Lead Pricing & Revenue Manager
jobs.description:
Why loveholidays?

At loveholidays - we trailblaze together. We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our team is the driving force behind our role as our customers’ personal holiday expert - the smart way to get away.

We’re using progressive tech to drive cutting-edge innovation and open the world to everyone. Within our Commercial and Support teams, you'll find a place to accelerate your growth by actively seeking learning opportunities and carving your own path. You'll create impact for our future by owning projects and shaping the business strategy to reach shared goals, all within our enhanced international community of collaborative and passionate teams.

 

About the team

The Revenue Management team is responsible for maximising final margin and driving sustainable growth by strategically managing key commercial levers, including pricing, payment plans, and cancellation terms.

The impact you’ll have

Reporting to the Head of Pricing and Revenue Management, you will lead the Revenue Management Centre of Excellence. You will shape the strategy, policies and capabilities that enable confident pricing, payment-plan and cancellation-term decisions across the business. Working with Platform and commercial teams, you will set the principles, guardrails and ways of working that support scalable, long-term commercial performance.

Your day-to-day:

  • Shape cross-market Revenue Management strategy, setting clear commercial principles, policies and decision guardrails.

  • Use market and operational insight to identify structural opportunities to strengthen our pricing power and long-term commercial performance

  • Lead cross-functional strategic initiatives and experiments with commercial and Platform teams from concept to delivery, navigating trade-offs.

  • Identify high-value AI use cases and apply AI tools to improve the Revenue Management team’s efficiency, capacity and quality of output.

  • Partner with Platform to shape the roadmap for new Revenue Management and AI capabilities, translating commercial needs into scalable systems and tools.

  • Develop and embed consistent methods, playbooks and operating rhythms that strengthen the Revenue Management function.

  • Act as a trusted commercial sounding board, bringing Revenue Management insight to decisions and initiatives across the business.

Your skillset:

  • Significant experience in Revenue Management, pricing strategy or a comparable commercial role, shaping direction across markets, products or customer segments.

  • Excellent commercial judgement, able to navigate ambiguity, challenge assumptions and make well-reasoned trade-offs that support long-term value and growth.

  • Advanced analytical and experimentation skills, able to set robust measurement approaches and use evidence to inform strategic choices.

  • Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional programmes, building alignment with commercial and platform stakeholders around shared outcomes.

  • Strong technical and product awareness, able to translate commercial needs into scalable capability roadmaps and identify high-value applications of AI and automation.

  • Credible, influential communication skills, able to turn complex analysis into clear, compelling narratives for senior stakeholders and cross-functional audiences

Desirable:

  • Travel-sector or marketplace experience

  • Experience using AI tools to increase team effectiveness and improve commercial decision-making.

  • Experience with SQL, Looker or comparable analytical tools.

The interview journey:

  • TA screening - 30 mins

  • 1st stage with Hiring Manager - 45 mins

  • 2nd stage with key stakeholders including a task to present, in office - 1.5 hours

  • Final stage with Chief Data Officer - 30 mins

As our Senior CRM Executive, you will play a key role in delivering and improving CRM campaigns and customer journeys across our channels. You’ll be close to the detail of campaign build, journey optimisation and performance, with the opportunity to grow your ownership over time.

You’ll work closely with the CRM Manager, Head of CRM and wider Marketing, Product and Engineering teams to turn agreed customer opportunities and briefs into well-executed campaigns and journeys. You’ll help move us away from legacy campaign cycles by building reliable, increasingly automated lifecycle activity. We are looking for a thoughtful, high-velocity operator who can turn clear direction into accurate live journeys.


Your day-to-day:

  • You’ll build and maintain multi-channel automated journeys using branching logic, API triggers, and real-time data, working from agreed briefs and priorities.

  • Identify manual bottlenecks and support the implementation of AI-assisted workflows, using tools like n8n and Claude (training will be provided).

  • Use Braze to identify optimisation opportunities within your journeys and help make delivery faster, more accurate, and more consistent.

  • Provide hands-on campaign support to the wider team in deploying campaigns. You’ll ensure accurate execution through rigorous, increasingly automated QA processes.

  • Work collaboratively with Marketing, Product and Engineering to deliver agreed workstreams and help create a frictionless experience from search to rebooking.

  • Monitor the performance of your campaigns and journeys. You’ll be comfortable using Looker to maintain reports, monitor health metrics, and surface actionable insights that support optimisation.


Your skillset:

  • You are a reliable operator who takes ownership of your assigned campaigns and journeys from brief through deployment. You ask the right questions, flag risks early, and deliver with consistency and precision.

  • You can move from a clear brief to deployment rapidly, maintaining high standards and following agreed processes.

  • You are naturally curious and look for practical ways to improve processes, reduce manual tasks, and make delivery more efficient.

  • You have experience with Looker, Tableau, or SQL, and BQ and confidence using data to monitor performance.

  • Hands-on experience with Braze or similar. You should be comfortable with Liquid logic, audience segmentation and personalisation.

  • You are comfortable working with data models and propensity scores to support relevant segmentation and measure campaign impact.

  • The ability to work well across Marketing, Product, and Engineering teams, taking direction and communicating clearly to keep delivery on track.


Desirable:

  • Experience supporting CRM activity across multiple international markets, including handling localisation, consent frameworks, and currency differences within automated journeys

  • Familiarity with n8n or similar workflow automation tools

  • Experience writing Liquid logic for content personalisation

  • Exposure to AI-assisted workflows or agentic tooling

  • Background in travel, marketplace, or another high-frequency transactional category


The interview journey:

  1. Meeting with a member of the Talent Acquisition team - 20 minutes

  2. Virtual Interview with Hiring Manager

  3. Final Stage interview in office presenting pre-determined task and a meeting a few stakeholders - 1 hour 30 mins

  • Company pension contributions at 5%.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer (100% remote)
jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job:

We are seeking a highly skilled DevOps Specialist to architect, implement, and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, with a strong focus on test-driven deployment, automated release management, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.

The ideal candidate will containerize services using Docker, manage build, compilation, and publishing workflows for JavaScript, TypeScript, and C++ packages, and design robust multi-language build pipelines leveraging CMake or similar build tools.

The role also includes automating build, tagging, and publication processes across web, desktop, and mobile platforms to ensure consistent and traceable releases. Deep expertise in Linux system administration, networking, and IaC tools is essential to deliver

scalable, secure, and highly available deployments.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, architecture, and management of CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions (and similar tools), ensuring fast, reliable, and reproducible software delivery.

  • Implement and enforce test-driven deployment systems, integrating automated testing, validation, and monitoring to maintain code quality and accelerate feedback cycles.

  • Containerize applications and microservices with Docker, optimize image builds, and manage deployment pipelines for distributed environments.

  • Oversee the build, packaging, and publishing lifecycle for JavaScript, TypeScript, and C++ packages, including versioning, semantic tagging, and NPM or internal registry publication.

  • Develop and maintain cross-platform build pipelines using CMake or equivalent tools, ensuring consistent compilation and release workflows across web, desktop, and mobile.

  • Automate end-to-end release processes, including tagging, building, signing, and distributing mobile, web, and desktop applications.

  • Define and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to provision and maintain reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure environments.

  • Collaborate closely with development, QA, and operations teams to troubleshoot deployment issues, optimize performance, and improve release reliability.

  • Continuously improve observability and feedback loops, leveraging monitoring and alerting systems to maintain operational excellence.


Mandatory:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience architecting and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent tools at scale in a production environment.

  • Strong proficiency in test-driven deployment methodologies, including writing and maintaining automated test suites for integration and end-to-end validation.

  • Expertise in containerization technologies such as Docker, including image creation, registry management, and basic orchestration patterns.

  • Experience managing package lifecycles for JavaScript and TypeScript, including versioning, compilation, semantic tagging, and publishing workflows to NPM.

  • In-depth knowledge of C++ build systems, specifically CMake, with proven experience optimizing native build and deployment pipelines.

  • Advanced Linux system administration and networking skills, including shell scripting, package management, performance troubleshooting, firewalls, and VPN configuration.

  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in globally distributed teams.

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, AWS CDK or AWS CloudFormation.

  • Experience with mobile CI/CD automation, including build, tagging, and publication for iOS and Android applications

  • Advanced knowledge of release management practices, including automated versioning, signing, and artifact distribution.

Preferred:

  • Exposure to observability and monitoring systems, leveraging tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK for deployment health tracking.

  • Experience working in high-availability, security-sensitive environments, especially in fintech, blockchain, or distributed systems contexts.

  • Experience deploying and managing blockchain-based applications.

  • Exposure to AI/ML pipelines, including automated model training, evaluation, and deployment using frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.title: Expert Meta Ads Freelance -  % Télétravail (H/F)
jobs.description: À propos de la mission Nous recherchons un(e) Freelance Meta Ads Specialist expérimenté(e) pour piloter et optimiser les campagnes d'acquisition digitale de nos clients, principalement des TPE et PME. La mission couvre l'ensemble du cycle Meta Ads, de l'audit et la définition de la stratégie jusqu'à la création, au lancement et à l'optimisation continue des campagnes sur Facebook et Instagram, avec une approche résolument orientée performance, conversions et rentabilité. Vos responsabilités Stratégie & Audit Meta Ads Auditer les comptes publicitaires existants et identifier rapidement les opportunités d'amélioration. Définir les stratégies d'acquisition en fonction des objectifs, du marché et du budget de chaque client. Structurer les comptes et campagnes afin de maximiser leur efficacité. Définir les audiences, objectifs de campagne et parcours de conversion adaptés. Création & Gestion des Campagnes Créer, paramétrer et gérer des campagnes Facebook Ads et Instagram Ads via Meta Ads Manager. Piloter des campagnes de génération de leads, trafic, conversions, ventes et retargeting. Construire et optimiser les audiences : ciblage, Custom Audiences, Lookalike Audiences et retargeting. Structurer les campagnes, ensembles de publicités et annonces. Définir les angles publicitaires et recommandations créatives adaptés aux différentes audiences. Tester différents formats, messages, visuels, vidéos et appels à l'action. Budget & Optimisation Piloter les budgets et stratégies d'enchères. Identifier les campagnes, audiences, placements et créations les plus performants. Mettre en place des A/B tests et expérimentations afin d'améliorer continuellement les résultats. Analyser la fréquence, le coût d'acquisition et la fatigue créative. Ajuster les investissements en fonction des performances et des objectifs de rentabilité. Tracking & Analytics Mettre en place, vérifier et optimiser le Meta Pixel. Maîtriser les problématiques liées à la Conversions API (CAPI) et au tracking server-side. Utiliser Google Analytics 4 et Google Tag Manager pour compléter l'analyse des performances. Vérifier la qualité et la fiabilité du tracking des événements et conversions. Comprendre les problématiques d'attribution entre Meta et les autres canaux d'acquisition. Performance & ROI Suivre les principaux KPI : CPM, CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, taux de conversion et ROAS. Analyser les performances et transformer les données en actions concrètes. Identifier les audiences, campagnes et créations générant les meilleurs résultats. Concevoir des reportings clairs orientés performance, conversions et ROI. Fournir des recommandations concrètes et priorisées pour chaque client. Assurer une veille régulier/ière sur les évolutions de Meta Ads et les nouvelles fonctionnalités de la plateforme. Profil recherché Expérience : expérience solide et démontrable dans la gestion et l'optimisation de campagnes Meta Ads, idéalement sur plusieurs secteurs d'activité. Meta Ads : excellente maîtrise de Meta Ads Manager et de la gestion de campagnes Facebook et Instagram. Acquisition : bonne compréhension des stratégies de génération de leads, conversion et retargeting. Tracking : bonne maîtrise du Meta Pixel, des événements de conversion et bonne compréhension de la Conversions API. Analytics : bonne connaissance de Google Analytics 4 et Google Tag Manager. Créatives : capacité à analyser les performances des créations et à formuler des recommandations sur les angles, messages, formats et contenus à tester. Performance : approche fortement orientée ROI et rentabilité, au-delà des simples métriques de visibilité ou d'engagement. Analyse : capacité à interpréter les données et à transformer rapidement les résultats en actions d'optimisation concrètes. Organisation : excellente capacité à gérer plusieurs comptes et projets simultanément et à travailler de manier/ière autonome. Qualités : autonomie, rigueur, proactivité et capacité à formuler des recommandations. Références : la capacité à présenter des cas concrets de campagnes gérées, budgets pilotés et résultats obtenus sera particulier/ièrement appréciée. Selon sa spécialisation, il peut exercer: En Role 1 : prise en charge visant à garantir la survie du patient dans des conditions dégradées, selon le principe du damage control resuscitation; En Role 2 : prise en charge incluant une capacité chirurgicale d'urgence, reposant sur le damage control surgery, privilégiant la rapidité et le contrôle des lésions vitales plutôt que leur réparation définitive immédiate; Pour entretenir ses compétences cliniques, le médecin militaire exerce également dans le domaine clinique civil. Profil Compétences techniques Être déployable pour toutes les missions et formations de l'Armée; Suivre les formations nécessaires; Maîtriser les outils bureautiques de base; Avoir de bonnes connaissances des opérations et missions de l'Armée luxembourgeoise; Avoir des connaissances de base en gestion des ressources humaines et logistiques. Compétences comportementales Faire preuve de sollicitude, de justice et d'impartialité; Donner l'exemple par la façon de se comporter et d'accomplir ses devoirs; Être ouvert aux relations interpersonnelles; Faire preuve de compétences de leadership; Faire preuve de professionnalisme; Adhérer aux valeurs-phares de l'Armée (engagement-droiture-fiabilité). Conditions d'admission Diplômes Vous êtes titulaire d'un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement d'enseignement supérieur reconnu par l'État du siège de l'établissement et sanctionnant l'accomplissement avec succès d'un master en Médecin spécialiste en traumatologie et médecine d'urgence ou de son équivalent. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 7 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. Vous disposez de l'autorisation d'exercer la profession. Langues Vous répondez aux exigences de connaissances des 3 langues administratives pour le groupe de traitement A1.  Vous avez la  luxembourgeoise. Être reconnu ement et psychologiquement apte pour le service militaire. Avoir une présentation compatible avec l'exercice de la fonction et le port d'uniforme.   Examen-concours: Examen-concours au Centre militaire du  au  octobre  Épreuve sportive, épreuves de langues, tests psychotechniques, épreuve de connaissances générales, évaluation psychologique et entretien de motivation. Incorporation janvier

Ce que l'ANA a à vous offrir : L'ANA investit pleinement dans votre développement professionnel. Cette formation couvre notamment : La de l'atmosphère ; La thermodynamique ; La dynamique des fluides ; Les mathématiques appliquées ; Les modèles numériques de prévision ; La météorologie aéronautique ; L'analyse scientifique des phénomènes météorologiques. La réussite de cette formation nécessite une réelle appétence pour les disciplines scientifiques ainsi qu'une forte capacité d'apprentissage et d'analyse. Le recrutement des prévisionnistes en météorologie est particulier/ièrement exigeant afin de garantir la réussite de la formation spécialisée et l'exercice d'une fonction essentielle à la sécurité aérien/ienne. Le processus de sélection comprend plusieurs étapes : Analyse des candidatures et vérification des conditions d'admission; Test d'anglais; Épreuves écrites visant notamment à évaluer : Les capacités de raisonnement scientifique et logique ; Les connaissances générales en mathématiques, et sciences ; Les aptitudes analytiques. Entretien devant une commission de sélection, permettant d'apprécier la motivation, les compétences comportementales, la capacité d'apprentissage et l'adéquation du candidat avec les exigences de la fonction. Compte tenu du niveau d'exigence de la formation et des responsabilités confiées aux prévisionnistes, seuls les candidats démontrant de solides aptitudes scientifiques, analytiques et comportementales pourront poursuivre le processus de sélection. Exercer une profession scientifique passionnant/ante ayant un impact direct sur la sécurité aérien/ienne ; Intégrer une administration moderne, dynamique et tournée vers l'innovation ; Évoluer aux côtés de spécialistes reconnus dans leur domaine ; Bénéficier d'un parcours de formation de très haut niveau reconnu à l'échelle européenne ; Développer continuellement vos compétences dans un environnement international ; Partager les valeurs de l'ANA : Intégrité, Respect, Innovation, Engagement et Excellence. Vous êtes prêt(e) à relever ce défi ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui et devenez acteur...

jobs.title: Delivery Manager / IT Project Manager SAP (H/F)
jobs.description: Harry Hope, cabinet de recrutement accompagne candidats et entreprises dans leurs recherches des meilleures opportunités en France et à l'international. Afin de mieux répondre à vos enjeux, tous nos consultants sont spécialisés par secteur d'activité et zone géographique. POSTE Notre client est un acteur reconnu au Luxembourg dans le domaine des solutions SAP et de la transformation digitale. Il accompagne des entreprises de toutes tailles dans la mise en oeuvre, l'évolution et l'optimisation de leurs systèmes d'information SAP. Dans le cadre du développement de son activité et de la conduite de projets stratégiques, notre client recherche un(e) Delivery Manager / IT Project Manager SAP afin de piloter des projets à forte valeur ajoutée et d'assurer la satisfaction de ses clients. Vous rejoindrez une équipe d'experts passionnés et évoluerez dans un environnement dynamique, innovant et international. Vos missions En tant que Delivery Manager / IT Project Manager SAP, vous serez responsable du pilotage de projets SAP, depuis leur lancement jusqu'à leur mise en production. Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivant/antes : Piloter des projets SAP (implémentation, migration, montée de version et évolution) dans le respect des délais, des coûts et des exigences qualité ; Assurer la coordination des équipes techniques, fonctionnelles et des différents partenaires du projet ; Être l'interlocuteur privilégié des clients tout au long du cycle de vie des projets ; Recueillir, analyser et challenger les besoins métiers afin de proposer des solutions adaptées ; Définir la gouvernance des projets, les plannings, les priorités et les indicateurs de suivi ; Identifier les risques, mettre en place les plans d'actions nécessaires et assurer leur suivi ; Garantir la qualité des livrables et le respect des engagements contractuels ; Superviser les phases de conception, développement, tests, recette, déploiement et accompagnement au changement ; Assurer le reporting auprès de la Direction et des parties prenant/antes ; Participer au développement de la relation client et identifier de nouvelles opportunités d'accompagnement. PROFIL Profil recherché Issu(e) d'une formation supérieure en informatique, ingénierie ou gestion de projet, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative dans la gestion de projets SAP. Compétences indispensables : Expérience confirmée en gestion de projets SAP ; Excellente connaissance de l'écosystème SAP (SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA ou solutions SAP) ; Maîtrise des méthodologies de gestion de projet (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall ou SAP Activate) ; Expérience dans la coordination d'équipes multidisciplinaires ; Bonne compréhension des processus métiers et des environnements ERP ; Excellentes capacités de communication et de gestion de la relation client. Compétences appréciées : Expérience sur des projets de migration vers SAP S/4HANA ; Connaissance de SAP BTP, SAP Fiori ou des solutions Cloud SAP ; Expérience dans des environnements internationaux ; Connaissance des bonnes pratiques ITIL ou des processus de Delivery Management. jobs.description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? Le Centre commun de la sécurité sociale (CCSS) est un établissement public en charge notamment: De l'affiliation à la sécurité sociale des salariés, travailleurs indépendants et assurés volontaires; Du calcul, de la perception et du recouvrement des cotisations sociales; De la répartition des cotisations sociales entre les différentes institutions de la sécurité sociale telles que l'AAA, la CNS, la CNAP. Le CCSS offre un cadre de travail motivant: En mettant en œuvre une mission légale essentielle pour le Luxembourg; En étant installé dans un bâtiment moderne; En étant localisé idéalement en face de la gare de Luxembourg à proximité immédiate de tous les moyens de transports, dans un quartier en renouveau et facile d'accès; En offrant la formation initiale complétée par la formation continue offerte à tous les agents du service public; En offrant une rémunération en ligne avec les conditions de la Fonction publique. Missions En tant qu'expert RH au sein du service ressources humaines du CCSS, vous rapportez directement au responsable RH. Vous l'assistez en participant activement à la gestion opérationnelle des ressources humaines du CCSS et jouez un rôle de conseiller auprès des agents et des supérieurs hiérarchiques. Vous participez aux projets RH définis dans le programme de travail et intervenez tout au long du cycle de vie RH des agents. Plus concrètement, vos missions consistent à: Accompagner et conseiller les agents dans leur évolution de carrier/ière; Fournir un support aux responsables d'unités organisationnelles dans toutes les problématiques RH et/ou organisationnelles; Organiser les examens de fin de stage, examens de promotion et de carrier/ière; Participer activement au recrutement et à l'intégration des nouveaux agents; Accompagner le développement des compétences des agents; Participer aux projets RH définis dans le programme de travail; Développer les processus RH et contribuer à l'amélioration continue des processus en place; Gérer les obligations légales et statutaires liées au domaine RH; Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les collègues du service RH et le responsable RH. Compétences comportementales Innover : penser de manier/ière innovant/ante, apporter des idées créatives pour améliorer l'existant, encourager l'innovation; Gérer les activités : gérer les activités courant/antes au travers d'objectifs clairs, gérer les ressources et suivre la mise en œuvre des activités; Soutenir : agir comme référence, accompagner les collègues, les guider et les soutenir en stimulant la coopération autour de l'objectif commun; Conseiller : fournir des conseils et développer une relation de confiance basée sur sa crédibilité, faire des recommandations dans l'intérêt de l'organisation et du client usager; Gérer les stress : Garder son calme face à la pression, rester constructif face à la critique et agir de façon constant/ante malgré les difficultés; Faire preuve d'ouverture : Être ouvert au changement et à l'innovation, s'ouvrir à la diversité et s'intéresser à d'autres disciplines que les sien/iennes; S'autodévelopper : Bien se connaître, se remettre en question de façon régulier/ière, apprendre de ses erreurs et apprendre continuellement; S'impliquer : S'engager pour générer des résultats, assumer la responsabilité et la qualité des actions entreprises, s'engager pour le bien commun. Atouts Expérience réussie dans un service RH au sein du secteur public luxembourgeois; Connaissance des outils de la fonction publique luxembourgeoise (Toolbox, MyRH, SAP). Évaluer les offres de formation: Procéder avec les publics cibles et les établissements concernés à l'évaluation des offres de formation; Mesurer les résultats obtenus surtout dans le domaine de l'amélioration des compétences des agents ayant suivi des actions de formation. Assurer un accueil auprès des participants et des formateurs: Renseigner, conseiller, orienter et clarifier selon les besoins exprimés. Contribuer à l'évolution du dispositif et à la gestion de la qualité: Veiller au respect des procédures liées à l'exercice de la fonction; Contribuer à l'évolution des procédures liées à l'exercice de la fonction. jobs.description:
Analyst Controlling & Reporting Position Summary The Analyst Controlling & Reporting supports financial planning, performance analysis, and management reporting. The role provides actionable insights through financial data analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and KPI monitoring to support business decision-making. Key Responsibilities Prepare regular financial and management reports. Analyze variances between actual results, budgets, and forecasts. Support budgeting and forecasting processes. Monitor KPIs and provide performance insights. Develop and maintain reporting tools and dashboards. Collaborate with business stakeholders on financial analyses and ad hoc reporting. Analytik controllingu a reportingu Stručná charakteristika pozície Analytik controllingu a reportingu podporuje finančné plánovanie, analýzu výkonnosti a manažérsky reporting. Prostredníctvom analýzy finančných dát, rozpočtovania, forecastingu a monitorovania KPI poskytuje dôležité podklady pre efektívne obchodné rozhodovanie. Hlavné zodpovednosti Pripravovať pravidelné finančné a manažérske reporty. Analyzovať odchýlky medzi skutočnými výsledkami, rozpočtami a forecastmi. Podporovať procesy rozpočtovania a forecastingu. Monitorovať KPI ukazovatele a poskytovať analýzy výkonnosti. Vytvárať a spravovať reportingové nástroje a dashboardy. Spolupracovať s internými stakeholdermi na finančných analýzach a ad hoc reportoch.

jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.

Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

The IT / Platform Owner acts as the central point of accountability for platform health, service quality, lifecycle management, and controlled change delivery. The position works closely with business stakeholders, Records governance, engineers, operations, and external partners to ensure reliable and sustainable delivery of Documentum services.

jobs.title: Správcovia objektov
jobs.description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

jobs.title: Správcovia systémov

Evidencia, klasifikácia a riešenie používateľských požiadaviek a incidentov prostredníctvom tiketovacieho systému HALO. Inštalácia, konfigurácia a príprava pracovných staníc, notebookov, tlačiarní, mobilných telefónov a ďalších koncových zariadení. Podpora používateľov pri práci s Microsoft 365 a štandardnými kancelárskymi aplikáciami. Správa používateľských účtov, hesiel a prístupových oprávnení podľa interných postupov. Evidencia a aktualizácia inventára IT hardvéru a softvéru. Spolupráca pri nákupe, príprave a vydávaní IT techniky novým zamestnancom. Základná správa tlačového prostredia vrátane riešenia bežných problémov s tlačiarňami a skenermi. Podpora výrobných pracovísk pri riešení základných IT problémov ovplyvňujúcich výrobnú prevádzku. Spolupráca pri aktualizáciách operačných systémov, aplikácií a bezpečnostných nástrojov. Vykonávanie pravidelných kontrol pridelených IT systémov podľa definovaných postupov. Spolupráca pri vedení a aktualizácii IT dokumentácie, interných postupov a prevádzkových záznamov. Eskalácia zložitejších technických problémov na IT špecialistu alebo IT administrátora senior. Dodržiavanie pravidiel informačnej bezpečnosti a podieľanie sa na ochrane firemných dát a IT prostriedkov. Plnenie ďalších úloh v oblasti IT podpory podľa pokynov nadriadeného alebo potrieb spoločnosti.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

jobs.description:

Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

jobs.description:
První kontakt: e-mailem
Nástup možný ihned nebo dle dohody.

Hledáme parťáka do skladu!

V AGROAD už 30 let dodáváme náhradní díly pro traktory a další zemědělské stroje. Hledáme mezi sebe někoho, kdo umí přiložit ruku k dílu, má rád ve věcech pořádek a je na něj spoleh. Chceš být součástí týmu, kde platí sliby, lidi jsou k sobě féroví, mají rovného a zároveň lidského šéfa, se kterým se dá vždy rozumně domluvit? Přijď k nám!

Co u nás budeš dělat?
- přijímat zboží, vybalovat, označovat a správně ho zaskladňovat
- vychystávat objednávky
- balit a připravovat zásilky na odeslání
- spolupracovat s kolegy z obchodního a nákupního oddělení, ať všechno šlape
- někdy i zvednout těžší krabici - svaly se ti budou hodit

Koho hledáme?
- někoho spolehlivého, pracovitého a fyzicky zdatného, součástky pro traktory nejsou zrovna brčka
- kdo umí táhnout za jeden provaz a zvládne pracovat i ve špičce, když je potřeba
- rychlého, ale pečlivého - není to závod, ale přesnost se počítá
- ideálně s nástupem co nejdříve

Výhodou, ale ne podmínkou:
- zájem o techniku, zemědělství nebo náhradní díly
- nápady, jak zefektivnit práci ve skladu - rádi nasloucháme

Co ti za to nabízíme?
- práci na hlavní pracovní poměr, v jednosměnném provozu (žádné noční ani víkendy)
- pravidelnou pracovní dobu a každý den doma na večeři
- 5 dnů volna ročně nad rámec zákonné dovolené
- měsíční výkonnostní odměny
- roční bonus až do výše 13. platu
- náborový příspěvek 10.000 Kč
- Multisport karta za zvýhodněnou cenu
- příspěvek na stravování
- káva, čaj, ovoce - občerstvení zdarma na pracovišti
- fajn tým, pohodové vedení, příjemné prostředí v Kuřimi
- firemní teambuildingy a společné snídaně

Zaujalo tě to? Tak neváhej a pošli nám svůj životopis.

Nástup ideálně co nejdříve.

geen sluitingsdatum
Sommige functies gaan over beleid. Deze gaat over wat er morgen zichtbaar is in de stad.
In Almere werk je aan een toekomst waarin afval geen eindpunt is, maar een nieuwe grondstof. Jij ontwikkelt niet alleen plannen, je zorgt dat ze ook echt worden uitgevoerd.
Van minder restafval tot slimme inzamelsystemen en circulaire projecten, jouw werk heeft direct impact op hoe inwoners omgaan met grondstoffen.
We zoeken iemand die het werkveld kent, eigenaarschap pakt en energie krijgt van beweging creëren. Iemand die beleid niet op papier laat staan, maar het tot leven brengt in de stad.
Wat ga jij doen
In deze rol werk je aan een stad waarin afval steeds meer grondstof wordt. Jij ontwikkelt beleid en zorgt dat het uitgevoerd wordt.
Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen strategie en praktijk en weet hoe je ideeën omzet in concrete resultaten. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Stadsreiniging, partners en andere stakeholders.
Concreet ga je aan de slag met het: - ontwikkelen en realiseren van beleid rondom afval, grondstoffen en circulariteit; - trekken van projecten op het gebied van afvalreductie, inzamelsystemen en hergebruik; - vertalen van landelijke en lokale ambities naar concrete maatregelen in de stad; - samenwerken met uitvoering, partners en collega's om plannen ook echt waar te maken; - bijdragen aan thema's zoals circulaire econ...

Als het stralende gezicht van onze locatie sta jij klaar om bezoekers met een big smile te verwelkomen. Telefoontjes en vragen? Geen probleem, jij handelt ze vakkundig af. En als het aankomt op de verkoop van toegangsbewijzen en consumpties, ben jij de overtuigende expert die gasten precies geeft wat ze nodig hebben. Met jouw kennis van Optisport-producten geef je enthousiast advies en zie je commerciële kansen als spannende uitdagingen om onze gastvrijheid naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Daarnaast werk je ook mee in de horeca.
Klaar voor deze veelzijdige rol waarin jij de beleving van onze gasten naar ongekende hoogtes tilt? Solliciteer direct en word onderdeel van ons dynamische Optisport-team!
Over de locatie
Optisport Helmond, beter bekend als De Braak, is dé sportieve ontmoetingsplek op de Sportcampus in Helmond. Wij brengen hier iedereen in beweging. Jong en oud kunnen bij ons komen zwemmen, ontmoeten, vergaderen, ontspannen en genieten van een drankje en een hapje. Ook voor evenementen en vergaderen zijn onze gasten aan het juiste adres.

Weet jij hoe je als leidinggevende een team professionals verder kan ontwikkelen? En ben jij een echte verbinder? Waterschap Hollandse Delta is op zoek naar een enthousiaste Teamleider.
Wat ga je doen
Als Teamleider Veiligheid & Crisisbeheersing geef je leiding aan een vakgebied dat volop in ontwikkeling is. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het verder ontwikkelen, positioneren en professionaliseren van veiligheid binnen de organisatie. Daarbij gaat het om de veiligheid van mensen en objecten, de crisisorganisatie en de voorbereiding op incidenten en calamiteiten.
Je zorgt ervoor dat veiligheid niet wordt gezien als een afzonderlijke verantwoordelijkheid van één team, maar als een integraal onderdeel van het dagelijks handelen van de gehele organisatie.
Daarbij werk je voor vanuit de principes van het Three Lines of Defense-model. De verantwoordelijkheid voor veiligheid ligt primair bij de lijnorganisatie: medewerkers, teamleiders en managers zijn eigenaar van de risico's binnen hun werkgebied. Het team Veiligheid & Crisisbeheersing vervult de tweede lijn door kaders te ontwikkelen, te adviseren, te ondersteunen en te monitoren. Jij helpt de organisatie om deze verantwoordelijkheden goed in te vullen, zonder deze over te nemen. jobs.description:
About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

The Account Executive, Strategic, is responsible for managing and expanding relationships with key strategic accounts. This role involves a deep understanding of the client's business, the ability to develop strategic plans to increase revenue, and ensuring client satisfaction through excellent service. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in sales, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to navigate complex negotiations.

Responsibilities

  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships with strategic clients. Act as the main point of contact and advocate for client needs within the company.

  • Strategic Business Planning: Develop a thorough understanding of key client needs and requirements. Work closely with clients to devise and implement strategic plans that align with their business goals and drive mutual growth.

  • Sales Targets: Achieve and exceed sales quotas within assigned portfolio by identifying and closing business opportunities.

  • Market Analysis: Conduct research and analysis to understand industry trends, competitive landscape, and client feedback to inform strategic planning and identify new business opportunities.

  • Collaboration: with cross-functional teams (including marketing, product development, and customer service) to ensure a cohesive and comprehensive approach to market.

  • Reporting and Forecasting: Provide accurate forecasts and track key account metrics. Report on the status of accounts and transactions, and monitor sales performance against goals.

  • Contract Negotiation: Lead contract negotiations, ensuring favorable terms for both the client and the company.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years experience selling to large, complex F100 businesses, demonstrating a successful track record of meeting or exceeding targets, preferably in a similar industry or role.

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate, present, and influence credibly and effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level.

  • Experience delivering client-focused solutions to customer needs.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple account management projects at a time while maintaining sharp attention to detail.

  • Excellent listening, negotiation, and presentation abilities.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

  • Above and beyond: Trained in Command of the Message and MEDDPICC

What to expect

First 30 days:

  • Understanding the Company and Product: Gain a deep understanding of the company's products or services, value proposition, and the competitive landscape. This includes completing all necessary onboarding training and familiarizing oneself with the company culture and processes.

  • Relationship Building: Begin to establish relationships with key internal stakeholders, including sales, marketing, product, and customer support teams. Understanding their roles and how they can contribute to the success of strategic accounts is crucial.

  • Client Familiarization: Start to get acquainted with the portfolio of strategic accounts, including reviewing account histories, previous interactions, and current contracts or agreements. Initial meetings with some key clients may also take place to introduce yourself as their new point of contact.

First 90 Days:

  • Strategic Planning: Develop detailed strategic plans for each key account, identifying opportunities for growth, potential challenges, and strategic objectives. This should be done in collaboration with clients and internal teams.

  • Performance Metrics: Establish clear KPIs for success within your accounts, aligned with both client expectations and company goals. Begin tracking these metrics closely.

  • Sales and Negotiations: Start actively pursuing new business opportunities within strategic accounts, which may involve negotiating terms for contracts or renewals. Efforts to cross-sell or up-sell should also be underway.

  • Feedback Loop: Implement a process for regularly gathering and acting on client feedback to improve service delivery and client satisfaction.

One Year Outlook:

  • Achieving Sales Targets: By the one-year mark, you should have met or exceeded the initial sales targets set for your strategic accounts. This includes successfully closing new deals and expanding business within existing accounts.

  • Strategic Account Growth: Demonstrated growth in strategic accounts through increased engagement, higher revenue, and enhanced partnership levels. Your strategic planning and execution should result in tangible benefits for both the clients and your company.

  • Relationship Depth: At this point, you should have established deep, trust-based relationships with key stakeholders within each strategic account. You're seen as a strategic advisor rather than just a sales contact.

  • Process Improvements: Identification and implementation of process improvements based on lessons learned over the year to increase efficiency, customer satisfaction, and sales effectiveness.

  • Professional Development: Continued professional growth, possibly including leadership development, advanced sales strategies, and industry knowledge enhancement to better serve strategic accounts and contribute to the company's objectives.

Success in an Account Executive Strategic role is measured not just by sales figures but by the depth of relationships built, the strategic value delivered to clients, and the positive impact on the company’s long-term growth. Regular reviews against these expectations can help in identifying areas for improvement and adjusting strategies as necessary.

jobs.title: Partnerships Associate
jobs.description:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

If you don’t choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself then, choose the challenge, choose Heidi.

The role

Heidi Evidence is clinical decision support with no commercial influence: nothing shapes what a clinician sees except clinical quality. Getting there means earning the trust of the organisations that hold the world's clinical knowledge, the journals, publishers, guideline bodies, professional societies and universities, and running large information-gathering programs across the NHS. That is the work of this role.

You'll sit next to our founder across partnerships, evidence and strategic projects, and you'll own the machinery underneath them. Hundreds of contacts, documents, deadlines and follow-ups, all current. AI-agent workflows doing the repetitive multi-step parts of outreach at a scale no one could reach by hand, with you auditing what comes out and drawing the line where a human has to look. The role starts part-time and grows with what you show you can carry. It fits an F3 or F4 doctor who wants into health tech, product and partnerships without putting their NHS experience on a shelf.

This is a part-time role, with the potential to become full-time.

What you’ll do

  • Run information-gathering, outreach and partnership programs across NHS organizations, end to end.

  • Build the tracking systems that hold it together: contacts, documents, deadlines, responses, follow-ups, one place, always current.

  • Set up AI-agent workflows for the repetitive, multi-step parts of the work, then keep them running in production.

  • Audit what those agents produce. Find the failure modes, fix the workflow, decide where human review is non-negotiable.

  • Write to NHS teams, publishers, societies and universities in a register they trust.

  • Map the clinical knowledge landscape: who holds what, who decides, which conversations to open first.

  • Prepare founder-level partnership meetings, keep accurate notes and close every action.

  • Surface risks, gaps and decisions early. Short updates, no surprises.

If we’d worked together the last 6 weeks

  • You'd have designed an outreach wave to several hundred NHS trusts, handed the first pass to an agent workflow, and caught the small percentage it got wrong before anything left the building.

  • You'd have mapped the UK guideline and specialty society landscape, then told us which five conversations actually move Evidence forward.

  • You'd have joined a founder call with a major clinical publisher, written the notes and closed every action inside the week.

  • A tracker someone had outgrown would have been rebuilt properly, so nothing now waits on a person remembering.

  • You'd have found a manual process, automated it, and taught the team to run it without you.

What you’ll need

  • 2+ years owning complex operational, clinical or partnership work, though we care more about what you’ve shipped than years on the clock.

  • A romantic streak about software. You believe great products can transform someone’s day.

  • Fluency with AI tools that goes past using them. You’ve built agent workflows or automations other people now depend on, and you know their failure modes.

  • Composure across many open threads. Nothing you own drops, and you can tell which thread to pick up first.

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects.

  • You default to building over requesting.

  • You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. Great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them.

Useful, not essential

  • Experience working in or closely with the NHS.

  • Medical training at FY2 level or beyond, particularly if you’re currently F3 or F4.

  • A current NHS affiliation and NHS.net address. Useful, not required, and any NHS account must be used in line with your organisation’s policies.

  • A feel for UK hospital workflows and how clinicians reach information at the point of care.

  • Familiarity with the clinical journals, publishers, guideline bodies, societies and universities that hold medical knowledge.

  • A background in health tech, clinical informatics, research, quality improvement, product operations or an early-stage company.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team focused on real-world impact over imaginary valuations and glossy PR. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders, and designers who’ve felt the moral and practical toll of what non-care feels like. True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose to build something that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognise that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it. The work is hard, but you will trust and admire the people you work beside, and rest easy knowing you’re doing the defining work of your career.

We take care of you.

We offer comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a £100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a £500 home office budget, a £700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to £7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.
