jobs.title: Kiinteistöinsinööri
jobs.description:
Haluatko vastata ainutlaatuisten matkailukohteiden teknisestä kehittämisestä, energiatehokkuudesta ja turvallisuudesta keskellä Tunturi-Lapin upeaa luontoa?

Haemme Harriniva Oy kiinteistöhuoltoyksikköön kehityshaluista ja asiantuntevaa kiinteistöinsinööriä vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Muonioon.

Kiinteistöinsinöörinä vastaat siitä, että matkailukohteidemme rakennukset, tekniset järjestelmät ja kiinteistöautomaatio toimivat energiatehokkaasti, turvallisesti ja suunnitelmallisesti kaikissa olosuhteissa. Toimit myös yhtiön kiinteistöjen turvallisuuspäällikkönä ja vastaat kiinteistöturvallisuuden toimintamallien ylläpidosta ja kehittämisestä.

Pääset työskentelemään monipuolisen kiinteistökannan parissa sekä vaikuttamaan konkreettisesti kiinteistöjemme elinkaareen, energiankulutukseen, turvallisuuteen ja tuleviin kehitysinvestointeihin.

Raportoit tehtävässäsi kiinteistöjohtajalle ja työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä kiinteistöhuoltotiimin, kohteidemme esihenkilöiden, muun henkilöstön, urakoitsijoiden ja yhteistyökumppaneiden kanssa.

**Tehtäväsi Harrinivalla**

Tehtävässä vastaat erityisesti:

- kiinteistöjen energiankulutuksen seurannasta, analysoinnista ja raportoinnista

- energiatehokkuutta parantavien toimenpiteiden suunnittelusta ja käytäntöön viemisestä

- kiinteistöautomaatiojärjestelmien valvonnasta, säätämisestä ja kehittämisestä

- rakennusten teknisten olosuhteiden sekä taloteknisten järjestelmien toiminnan seurannasta

- pitkän tähtäimen kunnossapitosuunnitelmien laatimisesta, ylläpidosta ja toteutuksen seurannasta

- kunnossapito-, korjaus- ja kehityshankkeiden suunnittelusta, kilpailutuksesta ja valvonnasta

- huoltokirjojen, piirustusten ja muun teknisen dokumentaation ajantasaisuudesta

- teknisestä raportoinnista ja kiinteistönhallinnan digitaalisten järjestelmien kehittämisestä

- kiinteistöhuoltotiimin teknisenä asiantuntijatukena toimimisesta

- ulkopuolisten suunnittelijoiden, huoltoliikkeiden ja urakoitsijoiden ohjaamisesta

- kiinteistöjen turvallisuuspäällikön tehtävistä

- palo-, pelastus- ja turvallisuusohjeistusten laatimisesta, ylläpidosta ja ajantasaisuuden varmistamisesta

- turvallisuuteen liittyvien tarkastusten, harjoitusten ja kehittämistoimenpiteiden koordinoinnista

- henkilöstön tarvittavien turvallisuus-, palo- ja pelastusasioiden perehdytysten suunnittelusta ja toteuttamisesta

- turvallisuuspoikkeamien käsittelyn, dokumentoinnin ja korjaavien toimenpiteiden seurannasta.


Tehtävän tarkempi sisältö muodostuu valittavan henkilön osaamisen ja kokemuksen perusteella.

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Odotamme sinulta tehtävään soveltuvaa teknistä koulutusta, kuten LVI-, sähkö-, automaatio-, energia- tai rakennustekniikan insinöörin AMK- tai YAMK-tutkintoa.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää:

- kokemusta kiinteistöjen taloteknisistä järjestelmistä ja niiden toiminnan kehittämisestä

- kiinteistöautomaatiojärjestelmien tuntemusta

- ymmärrystä energiankulutuksen seurannasta ja energiatehokkuustoimenpiteistä

- kokemusta huoltokirja- tai kiinteistönhallintajärjestelmistä

- valmiutta suunnitella ja seurata PTS-töitä sekä teknisiä hankkeita

- ymmärrystä kiinteistö-, palo- ja pelastusturvallisuudesta

- kykyä laatia selkeitä ohjeistuksia ja perehdyttää henkilöstöä

- analyyttistä, järjestelmällistä ja dokumentointiin sitoutunutta työotetta

- kykyä itsenäiseen päätöksentekoon ja asioiden määrätietoiseen loppuun viemiseen

- hyviä yhteistyö-, neuvottelu-, esiintymis- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa sekä riittävää englannin kielen osaamista

- B-ajokorttia.


Arvostamme käytännönläheistä ja ratkaisukeskeistä otetta. Osaat hahmottaa laajoja kokonaisuuksia, mutta olet tarvittaessa valmis selvittämään asioita myös paikan päällä teknisissä tiloissa ja eri kohteissamme. Lapin vaihtelevat olosuhteet eivät lamaannuta sinua, vaan motivoivat löytämään toimivia, turvallisia ja kestäviä ratkaisuja.

Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen matkailu-, hotelli- tai majoituskiinteistöistä, rakennuttamisesta, projektinjohdosta, energiahankkeista, teknisten urakoiden valvonnasta tai kiinteistöjen turvallisuustehtävistä.

**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työsuhteen

- vastuullisen ja monipuolisen asiantuntijatehtävän

- mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa aidosti kiinteistöjemme energiatehokkuuteen, turvallisuuteen, hiilijalanjälkeen ja arvon säilymiseen

- kiinnostavan ja vaihtelevan kiinteistökannan keskellä Tunturi-Lapin luontoa

- mahdollisuuden osallistua kunnossapidon lisäksi merkittäviin kehitys- ja investointihankkeisiin

- osaavan kiinteistöhuoltotiimin ja kiinteistöjohtajan tuen

- vakaan ja kehittyvän perheyrityksen puitteet

- Harrinivan henkilöstöedut

- mahdollisuuden kehittyä tehtävässä ja rakentaa roolia oman osaamisesi pohjalta.


Meillä työpäivät eivät ole keskenään samanlaisia. Työsi jälki näkyy suoraan asiakkaidemme viihtyvyydessä ja turvallisuudessa, henkilöstömme arjessa sekä rakennustemme pitkäjänteisessä ja vastuullisessa ylläpidossa.

**Harriniva Hotels & Safaris**

Harriniva Hotels & Safaris on perheomisteinen Lapin matkailun pioneeri Muoniossa, Ruotsin rajan tuntumassa. Vuonna 1973 Tornion–Muonionjoen rannalle perustettu leirintä- ja karavaanialue on kasvanut kolmeksi täyden palvelun lomakeskukseksi keskelle Lapin puhdasta luontoa.

jobs.title: Aktiviteettiopas Arcora Boutique Hotel & Villas
jobs.description:
**Arcora Boutique Hotel & Villas avautuu joulukuussa 2026 Torassiepissä, Muoniossa, Pallas–Yllästunturin kansallispuiston maisemissa. Haemme nyt elämyksistä, luonnosta ja ensiluokkaisesta vieraanvaraisuudesta innostuneita oppaita talvikaudelle 2026–2027.**

Arcora on uuden sukupolven arktinen luksushotelli, jossa pohjoisen luonto, tarkkaan suunnitellut yksityiskohdat ja henkilökohtainen palvelu muodostavat ainutlaatuisen kokonaisuuden. Vieraamme saapuvat luoksemme eri puolilta maailmaa kokemaan Lapin tavalla, joka tuntuu aidolta, rauhalliselta ja merkitykselliseltä.

Oppaana olet yksi Arcoran tärkeimmistä kohtaamispisteistä. Et ainoastaan ohjaa retkeä, vaan rakennat vieraille muistoja, kerrot pohjoisen luonnosta ja elämästä sekä huolehdit siitä, että jokainen ohjelma toteutuu turvallisesti, sujuvasti ja Arcoran palvelulupauksen mukaisesti.

**Tehtävässäsi**

Ohjaat muun muassa moottorikelkka-, lumikenkä-, hiihto-, revontuli- ja muita arktisia luontoelämyksiä. Ohjelmat toteutetaan pääosin pienille ryhmille ja yksityisasiakkaille, joten tehtävässä korostuvat henkilökohtainen palvelu, tilanteiden ennakointi ja kyky huomioida jokainen vieras yksilöllisesti.

Työhön voi kuulua myös vieraiden kuljetuksia, varusteiden valmistelua ja huoltoa sekä osallistumista aktiviteettituotannon päivittäisiin tehtäviin. Arcora on uusi kokonaisuus, joten pääset samalla vaikuttamaan toimintatapojen ja vieraskokemuksen rakentamiseen yhdessä kokeneen tiimin kanssa.

**Toivomme sinulta**

- aikaisempaa kokemusta opastamisesta, matkailusta tai kansainvälisestä asiakaspalvelusta

- erinomaista englannin kielen taitoa

- rauhallista, luotettavaa ja turvallisuuslähtöistä työotetta

- aitoa kiinnostusta Lapin luontoon, kulttuuriin ja arktiseen elämäntapaan

- kykyä kohdata erilaisia vieraita lämpimästi ja luontevasti

- oma-aloitteisuutta, joustavuutta ja hyvää tiimihenkeä

- voimassa olevaa B-ajokorttia


Muu kielitaito, ensiapuosaaminen sekä kokemus moottorikelkkailusta, maastossa liikkumisesta ja vaativien kansainvälisten asiakkaiden palvelemisesta katsotaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme**

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden olla mukana avaamassa yhtä Lapin kiinnostavimmista uusista hotellikokonaisuuksista. Saat ympärillesi ammattitaitoisen ja kunnianhimoisen tiimin, laadukkaat työvälineet sekä poikkeuksellisen toimintaympäristön tuntureiden, metsien ja arktisen luonnon keskellä.

Etsimme ennen kaikkea ihmisiä, joille laadukas palvelu ei tarkoita muodollisuutta, vaan läsnäoloa, tilannetajua ja halua tehdä jokaisesta kokemuksesta erityinen.

- Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig fungere godt i et team

jobs.title: Labour Exploitation Caseworker (permanent, full-time 39 hours)
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Migrant Rights Centre Ireland (MRCI) Labour Exploitation Caseworker - Job Description The role of the Labour Exploitation Caseworker is to provide supports and direct representation to migrant workers who have faced labour exploitation and other labour rights matters, including potential and actual victims of trafficking for labour exploitation. Key Duties and Responsibilities Provide information, guidance, and representation for people who have experienced exploitation at work including bringing of formal complaints to Workplace Relations Bodies (e.g. WRC and Labour Court). Work closely with other MRCI staff to screen and advise on employment rights queries and make referrals. Provide associated supports and advocacy to people on issues related to employment rights cases such as employment permits, immigration, social welfare, etc. Carry out assessments of potential human trafficking cases and, where required, provide written referrals to the Human Trafficking Investigation and Co-ordination Unit (HTICU). Person specifications Essential: Experience in the Irish context of advocacy or casework in immigration, employment or a related field. Experience providing casework, advocacy, or representation to individuals experiencing complex issues. Education to degree level in law, human rights, social rights, social policy or other related area. Proven ability to assess needs, risks and vulnerabilities, develop appropriate support responses, and work sensitively with people. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to advocate, negotiate and liaise effectively with individuals, employers and statutory agencies. Strong commitment to tackling injustice, anti-racism and advancing migrant worker rights. Strong organisational and case-management skills and ability to prioritise cases and manage a varied caseload. Experience using technology for documentation, data management, and virtual communication. Ability to work independently and collaboratively. Desirable: Direct experience working with people who have faced exploitation at work including potential or confirmed victims of trafficking for labour exploitation. Working knowledge of Irish employment rights and legislation. Experience preparing employment rights complaints and representing workers before the WRC or Labour Court. Understanding of offences associated with labour exploitation, such as unlawful recruitment fees, fraud, theft, forced labour or other forms of exploitation. Working knowledge of additional languages Working knowledge of Ireland’s immigration and employment permit system. Experience of identifying and advancing strategic cases for collective outcomes. Familiarity with tracking cases through case management systems. Experience carrying out data analysis to feed into policy and legislative development.

jobs.title: Outcomes Architect Manager, Tokyo
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness.

If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role




WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.

 - Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes.

 - Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership.

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met.

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals.

 - Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value.

 - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion.

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs.




SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy.

 - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation.

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it.

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account.

 - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans.

 - Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams.

 - Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team.

 - Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity.

 - Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership.

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers.

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes.

 - Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management.

 - Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership.

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping teams return customers to a clear value path.

 - Experience partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Sales, Services, or Implementation teams in a shared customer lifecycle model.

 - Familiarity with AI transformation, workflow automation, agents, or collaboration/work management software.




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Work as a GP in scenic Western Norway
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Europe. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Would you like to work in a well-organised GP practice with experienced colleagues, close access to specialist healthcare, and excellent opportunities for outdoor activities?

On behalf of a municipality in Vestland County, we are recruiting a family medicine specialist for a permanent position in a modern and well-established GP practice.

This is an opportunity to join a supportive professional environment where quality of care, collaboration, and continuity for patients are highly valued. The practice is located in a scenic area of Western Norway, surrounded by mountains, lakes, and fjords, with easy access to both outdoor activities and urban amenities.

About the position

You will join a GP practice consisting of three experienced GPs and one resident doctor. The available patient list currently includes approximately 800 patients, with the possibility of gradually increasing the list size if desired.

The municipality places great emphasis on creating a positive working environment and maintaining a strong professional community with skilled colleagues and experienced support staff.

The position includes:

    Responsibility for your own patient list
    Diagnosis, treatment, and long-term follow-up of patients of all ages
    Preventive healthcare and chronic disease management
    Up to 20% municipal medical duties
    Participation in an organised out-of-hours emergency service rotation

Emergency care services

The municipality participates in an intermunicipal emergency care collaboration involving five municipalities. The emergency clinic is located next to the local hospital and operates from dedicated facilities.

    The service includes responsibility for:
    Out-of-hours emergency care
    Municipal acute care beds (KAD)
    Emergency medical communication centre
    The clinic is staffed by qualified healthcare personnel around the clock, providing a well-supported working environment during emergency shifts.

We offer

    Permanent full-time position
    Annual salary of approx. NOK 1.6 million for specialists, plus additional compensation for emergency service duties
    A well-established GP practice with experienced colleagues
    Strong professional support and collaboration
    Good opportunities for professional development and continuing education
    Assistance with relocation and practical arrangements when moving to Norway
    Free Norwegian language training
    Support throughout the authorisation process

About the area

The position is located in a municipality in Vestland County, one of Norway's most spectacular regions. The area is known for its fjords, mountains, glaciers, and excellent opportunities for hiking, skiing, cycling, and fishing.

The community offers schools, cultural activities, sports facilities, and a wide range of local services. The location also provides good transport connections to larger towns and cities in Western Norway.

Qualifications

We are looking for candidates who:

    Are specialists in family medicine / general practice (GP)
    Hold a valid medical licence and specialist recognition from an EU/EEA country
    Have good English language skills
    Are motivated to learn Norwegian
    Have good communication and collaboration skills
    Wish to establish a long-term career and life in Norway

Why Norway?

General practitioners play a central role in the Norwegian healthcare system and are responsible for the long-term follow-up of their own patients. Norwegian healthcare is characterised by high professional standards, collaborative working environments, and a high degree of professional autonomy.

Norway also offers excellent opportunities to combine a medical career with a balanced lifestyle, family life, and access to nature.

Interested?

We would be happy to tell you more about the position and life in Norway. Please contact us for a confidential conversation or send us your CV. We look forward to hearing from you!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.title: Pre-Commissioning Engineer, Frequent travel
jobs.description:
About the role

As a Commissioning Engineer, you will manage the onsite testing and validation of high-voltage power electronic systems. You will work closely with field teams and customers to ensure all systems meet performance standards and operate safely within the global grid.

You are offered
the opportunity to work at the forefront of green energy technology, providing significant international exposure and the chance to lead critical infrastructure projects globally.

Work tasks

You will be responsible for the hands-on execution of pre-commissioning and site acceptance testing for advanced power electronic systems, ensuring seamless grid integration.
- Lead and execute site acceptance testing (SAT) for high-voltage power systems.
- Perform hardware and system-level tests to verify design specifications.
- Identify and also resolve hardware and software defects during the commissioning phase.
- Act as the primary technical contact for customers during onsite walk-throughs.
- Prepare and archive accurate test reports and compliance documentation.
- Manage onsite task schedules and identify risks to project timelines.
- Provide technical guidance to installation contractors and local field teams.

We are looking for

- Advanced knowledge of electrical engineering principles.
- Practical experience in site commissioning or field testing of STATCOM, SVC, or HVDC systems.
- Proficiency using test equipment such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, power analyzers, and Omicron.
- Strong ability to interpret technical schematics, circuit diagrams, and layout drawings.
- High willingness to travel frequently to international customer sites.
- Fluent in written and spoken English.

It is meritorious if you have
- Proven ability to make technical decisions in fast-paced site environments.
- Experience working independently at complex construction sites.

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Työ sopii henkilölle, joka pitää järjestyksestä, osaa ottaa vastuuta omista tehtävistään ja pystyy työskentelemään itsenäisesti erilaisissa toimistotilanteissa.

**Työtehtäviin kuuluu muun muassa**

- toimiston päivittäisten käytännön asioiden hoitaminen

- saapuvan ja lähtevän postin vastaanottaminen, lajittelu ja lähettäminen

- sähköpostien ja muiden toimistoviestien käsittely ja välittäminen

- puheluihin ja yhteydenottoihin vastaaminen sekä asiakkaiden ohjaaminen oikealle henkilölle

Type: Full-time, fixed term (3-6 months)

Location: Maarintie 6, 02150 Espoo, hybrid

Application deadline: 14.09.2026

ICEYE is looking for a **Senior Payroll Specialist** to join the Global Payroll team as an additional resource during an exciting period of growth.

This is a fixed-term position for approximately 3–6 months, and we hope you can start as soon as possible. We review applications throughout the application period and will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply sooner rather than later.

**What will you be doing?**

In this role, you will support global payroll operations across ICEYE's international organization, with a particular focus on Finland, one of the company's largest payroll entities. Working closely with the Senior Payroll Specialist based in Warsaw, as well as colleagues in HR and Finance and external payroll providers, you will help ensure accurate and compliant payroll operations while contributing to the continuous development of payroll processes.

More specifically, your responsibilities include:

- Coordinating end-to-end payroll operations across approximately 12 countries together with external payroll providers

- Preparing, validating, and submitting payroll data to ensure accurate and timely payroll processing

- Ensuring payroll activities comply with local legislation and internal policies

- Supporting the onboarding of new legal entities and contributing to process development and automation initiatives

- Partnering with internal stakeholders and external vendors to continuously improve payroll operations


**What makes you a great fit?**

We hope you are a proactive and detail-oriented payroll professional who enjoys solving problems and improving ways of working. You thrive in a fast-paced international environment, communicate effectively with stakeholders across functions, and take ownership of delivering high-quality payroll services.

**We require you to have:**

- Around 3–5 years of experience in end-to-end payroll, ideally in an international or fast-paced environment

- Strong knowledge of Finnish payroll legislation and payroll processes, with experience supporting payroll across Europe

- Experience working with third-party payroll providers in a multinational environment

- Excellent Excel skills and experience working with payroll and HRIS systems

- A full working proficiency in English


**We consider as an asset:**

- Knowledge of local labor and payroll legislation outside Europe


**We can offer you:**

- A unique opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing New Space company operating globally

- Meaningful ownership in an international payroll environment supporting employees across multiple countries

- The opportunity to improve payroll processes and help shape future ways of working

- A collaborative and experienced team where your expertise is valued from day one

- Cozy office spaces in Otaniemi, Espoo


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and 3-6 months fixed term position. You will be employed as aTalent employee at ICEYE. We hope you can start as soon as possible. The role will be located in Espoo, and we hope you are able to work at the office at least a few days per week as part of a hybrid model. Salary in this position is 5200-5500 €/month (gross) depending on the level of your experience, and will be negotiated individually.

**Sounds like you?** Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF-format in English by the latest 14th of September via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/379777/create/. A motivation letter is optional, but with a role-specific motivation letter you can provide more information about your relevant skills and why this would be an interesting opportunity for you.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary. You can familiarize yourself with ICEYE here: https://www.iceye.com/company. jobs.title: McDonald's Otta søker deg som vil mestre høyt tempo sammen med gode kollegaer

Er du lei av ulike stereotypiske holdninger? Vil du jobbe et sted hvor du kan være deg selv og bli satt pris på akkurat slik DU er? Hos McDonald's vet vi at ulike mennesker gjør det best i team, hos oss kan du selvsagt være deg selv!

Hva kan du forvente hos oss?

  • God opplæring: Du trenger ikke å kunne alt fra dag én. Vi lærer deg å håndtere stress, jobbe i team og levere kundeservice med et smil (ja, selv på en hektisk fredagskveld)

  • En arbeidsplass der alle får muligheten til å være seg selv: din personlighet betyr mer enn din CV
  • Fri når du har fri: Vi skjønner at du har et liv utenfor jobben

  • Du har sterke samarbeidsevner (teamwork er vår superkraft)
  • Du klarer å holde hodet kaldt under press (det er helt avgjørende når grillen streiker en fredagskveld)

  • Du er flink til å kommunisere og samarbeide, både med kollegaer og kunder (når det koker på kjøkkenet er din samarbeidsevne avgjørende)
  • Du trives med kundebehandling, matlaging, rydding og renhold (tiden går fort når du jobber hos oss)

Hos oss får du dette – og litt til.

Vi gir deg muligheten til å lære ferdigheter, som stressmestring, som ikke bare gir deg en fordel i arbeidslivet, men som også vil komme til nytte i livet ellers.

Er du klar for å bli en del av et team som setter pris på mangfold og individuell utvikling?

Vi er klare til å ønske deg velkommen – og muligens til og med dele en Big Mac!

Velkommen til McDonald’s!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Hos McDonald's kan vi tilby deg en hektisk hverdag med mange nye utfordringer. Hos oss er ingen dager like og vi prøver til enhver tid å overgå gjestenes forventninger. Arbeidsoppgavene består av kundebehandling, matlaging og vasking/rydding av lokaler.

For å overgå gjestenes forventninger legger vi stort fokus på vennlig og rask servering, at vi respekterer og verdsetter hver enkelt gjest og at vi skaper gode opplevelser for kunder og hverandre

Hos oss får du lære deg å jobbe som et team med fokus på god kommunikasjon samtidig som du jobber selvstendig. Du får fantastiske utviklingsmuligheter, mange av våre franchisetakere og mange på hovedkontoret startet for eksempel opp som crew og jobbet seg oppover. Det er god opplæring med grundig oppfølging og i tillegg får du oppleve et fantastisk arbeidsmiljø og muligheten til å møte mange nye mennesker.

Les mer på www.mcdonalds.no eller følg oss på Facebook, Instagram og Twitter.

jobs.title: Learning Experiences Creator
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit is where millions of people learn to build software - and our documentation and learning content are where they get going or give up. We're taking ownership of that experience, and we're looking for a Learning Experience Creator who can make it worthy of the product: someone who turns product knowledge into experiences people actually use - clear written docs, guided learning, short video, interactive experiences - findable at the moment of need, accurate every time, and genuinely enjoyable.

You're a learning-experience creator first. You understand how people actually learn a product - what they're trying to accomplish, where they get stuck, what format serves each moment - and you move fluidly between writing a crisp help article, designing a hands-on walkthrough, and producing a short video. Underneath it all, you're a storyteller: you know how to earn attention in the first few seconds, hold it against real-world attention spans, and make ideas stick - and sometimes make something people can't help but share. You're also a builder: unafraid to try new formats and experiment, you read the data and listen to customers, and you continually improve and evolve with speed as our product evolves. You'll turn complex things into simple, useful experiences, and you'll own how well they land.

The Mission: help every user - external customers and internal teams - self-serve to reach their creative and business goals, with content so good, so current, and so findable that they don't need to open a ticket. Success looks like real ticket deflection, faster activation, and high CSAT.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - New documentation and learning content. You'll populate our documentation and learning surfaces with new, accurate, plain-language content - help articles, answer-first FAQs, goal-based tutorials, and rebuilt getting-started paths - prioritized by real reader and ticket data, made at volume with the help of our AI- native content tools.

 - The content lifecycle. Content isn't done when it ships. You'll keep the library current through every product launch - freshness reviews, launch-day updates, retiring what's stale - so nothing published contradicts the product. Our pipeline flags what's drifting; you own making it right.

 - Learning experiences across formats. Written first where reading serves best - plus short-form video, microlearning, interactive courses, quick walkthroughs, GIFs, and in-product tips. You pick the format that fits the job, not the other way around, and you bring a storyteller's instinct for attention and memorability to every one - learning content competes with everything else on someone's screen, and yours wins. You keep pushing into new, innovative experiences as our tools grow.

 - A content calendar built for effectiveness. You plan what gets made and when - covering the topics customers most need help with, sequenced for maximum impact, so the library actually answers the questions people are asking.

 - Findability. You make sure content is easy to discover - titled, tagged, and structured so people (and the AI assistants that read our docs) find the right answer through search, at the moment of need. Great content nobody can find doesn't deflect anything, and this is yours to own.

 - Engagement and outcomes. You care whether it worked - reader feedback, findability, completion and watch-through, self-serve resolution, deflection, CSAT - and you tune the calendar and the craft based on what the data and customers tell you.

 - A recognizable voice. A consistent, human style across docs, learning, and video that makes every piece feel like part of one connected experience, whether someone reads a single article or completes a whole course.

 


HOW YOU'LL WORK WITH THE TEAM

This role is a force-multiplier - it makes the whole team's knowledge reach people. You won't work alone:

• With our Technical Customer Education Specialist for accuracy and depth - they bring the technical truth; you turn it into clear, findable content people trust and enjoy.

• With our Sr. Learning Experience Lead on what content is needed and what's working - they own the learning platform, journeys, and measurement; you read the same effectiveness data to steer the calendar.

• With our docs and product partners on launches - so new features ship with accurate, ready content on day one, not weeks later.

• With the hiring manager and the wider team to scale our content capability together, so the sum is greater than the parts.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• A proven learning-content creator. A portfolio of documentation, tutorials, courses, or product education that people actually used and learned from - across at least two formats, with written content among them. You understand clarity, structure, and story, and you can prove it.

• A strong writer. You make complex or dry topics genuinely clear and engaging in plain language, with warmth and a point of view. Docs people want to read are your craft.

• A gifted storyteller, across media. You understand hooks, pacing, attention spans, and what makes content memorable - sometimes shareable, occasionally viral - and you apply that craft to written, video, and interactive work alike. It shows up in a doc's first sentence as much as a video's first five seconds.

• A capable short-form video creator. Video is one of your formats - you understand watchability and modern platform sensibilities, and you're comfortable producing (on or off camera) with AI-assisted workflows.

• A builder and experimenter. You try new formats and ideas, take calculated content risks, glean insights from data and customers, and continually improve - determining the right approach even when the problem is ambiguous.

• Fast to learn a product. You get up to speed quickly and can represent it accurately to newcomers - you don't need to be a developer, but you make technical things make sense.

• Outcome-minded. You define what success looks like for your work, and you care about real results (deflection, activation, self-serve success, CSAT), not just output.

• A strong thought partner. You share ideas openly, seek other perspectives, and collaborate well across a small, fast team.

 


BONUS

• Experience writing or maintaining developer or product documentation (docs-as-code, Markdown-based platforms) - and a feel for content lifecycle at scale.

• Hands-on with AI-native build or content tools (Replit) and modern editing/production workflows.

• Instructional design fundamentals - you know why a checklist beats a paragraph and when a video beats both.

• A feel for discoverability and search - how people (and AI assistants) find content and how to help them.

• Experience running a content channel, editorial calendar, or creator program with an audience - bonus points if something you made really took off.

 

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Soft Matter
jobs.description:
About the position

Position as PhD Research Fellow in chemistry/physical chemistry available at Department of Chemistry.

The fellowship period is three years. 
A fourth year may be considered, and it will involve 25% of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualification of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

Starting date: as soon as possible, no later than January 1st, 2027.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is Department of Chemistry in the Life Science Building at the University of Oslo, Gaustad, Oslo.


Job description

This position is part of the convergence environment PERMEATE – Peptides for Membrane Targeting and Synergistic Drug Delivery. Convergence environments are interdisciplinary research initiatives that aim to address major challenges in health and the environment. They are funded by UiO’s interdisciplinary strategic area UiO:Life Science.
PERMEATE focuses on overcoming cell membrane barriers using peptides to enable targeted delivery of therapeutic molecules. The project adopts a multidisciplinary approach, integrating expertise from computational sciences, chemistry, pharmacy, biology, and medicine. The convergence environment comprises three PhD positions and one postdoctoral position.

PhD Position within PERMEATE
We are seeking a highly motivated candidate to work on peptide-membrane interactions and the development of lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) for applications in both cancer therapy and the treatment of bacterial infections. The work will be situated at the interface of (bio)physical chemistry, soft matter, and organic chemistry. The candidate should have a strong interest in multidisciplinary research and a clear motivation for interdisciplinary collaboration.

The PhD project will focus on:

  • Characterizing and understanding the dynamical and structural effects of different peptides on a range of membrane systems
  • Developing strategies to formulate and prepare building blocks for stable LNPs through organic synthesis and click chemistry.
  • Use broad advanced instrumentation for X-ray/neutron scattering studies, surface studies (QCM-D, AFM), analytics (SEC-MALS/A4F) as well as spectroscopy (NMR/fluorescence/UV/vis) – all supported by quantitative data analysis.

The PhD candidate will contribute to bridging research activities across groups based in:
Pharmacy, Theoretical chemistry, Medicine, Microbiology and Biophysics and will play an active role in fostering collaboration within the PERMEATE convergence environment.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in chemistry, physical chemistry, biophysics or physics or related fields  
  • Documented practical wet lab experience and basic skills in organic chemistry 
  • Documented basic knowledge and some practical experience in programming and numerical methods.
  • Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in English

Desired qualifications:

  • Demonstrated ability in developing, executing and analysing data from experimental lab work
  • Documented experience within quantitative data analysis and interpretation
  • Documented experience within soft matter and (bio)polymer science 
  • Documented experience in organic synthesis and characterization
  • Previous expertise in nanostructural characterization tools, in particular scattering techniques will be given weight
  • Earlier experience in soft matter, synthesis, conjugation chemistry and click chemistry will be considered positively

Language requirement:

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 

All candidates and projects will have to undergo a check versus national export, sanctions and security regulations. Candidates may be excluded based on these checks. Primary checkpoints are the Export Control regulation, the Sanctions regulation, and the national security regulation.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Strong motivation for research and able to work proactively in a multidisciplinary team 
  • Ability to work independently in a self-driven manner
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • A cover letter specific for this position - statement of motivation and research interests in the specific scope of the current position
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications)
  • Transcripts of records, copies of the original Bachelor and Master degree diploma (see below)
  • Documentation of English proficiency if applicable
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".
Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society.

The Department of Chemistry is Norway's largest institution within research and education in chemistry. Our research excels internationally and we educate students to a wide variety of jobs in industry, academia, research institutions, schools and public administration. Our research ranges from the core topics of chemistry to applied science within in environmental, health, energy and materials. The Department has extensive contacts with industry, research and educational institutions at home and abroad. As partner in the Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology our researchers contributes to a significant interdisciplinary efforts in cooperation with the Department of Physics. The Department of Chemistry has its own school laboratory as a great resource for teachers, public outreach and the didactics of chemistry.

jobs.title: Ready to make an impact on the green energy transition? Join Voith Hydro AS as our next HSE Manager!
jobs.description:
The Voith Hydro Division is a worldwide provider of hydropower technology and services. In Norway, Voith Hydro AS acts as a turnkey supplier of new hydropower facilities, power plant control systems, and modernization projects for turbines and generators, as well as comprehensive service and maintenance solutions. The company employs 173 people across its offices in Oslo, Trondheim, and Fredrikstad and reports annual revenues of NOK 580 million.

Voith Hydro AS is actively engaged in a broad portfolio of hydropower projects throughout Norway and has a strong outlook for the future. As part of our continued growth, we are expanding our HSE organization and are looking for an HSE Manager to join our team. Working in close collaboration with our existing HSE Manager, you will play a key role in promoting a strong safety culture and supporting the successful delivery of our projects.

Position: HSE Manager- Norway

Reporting Line: Managing Director Voith Hydro AS, and functionally to the Regional Head of HSE.

Role Purpose

The HSE Manager is responsible for implementing and continuously improving the VHE HSE Management System within the Norwegian organization and ensuring safe, compliant and efficient execution of all operational activities.

The role acts as the primary HSE advisor to the Managing Director, drives a Zero Incident culture, maintains a strong field presence, and ensures HSE is fully integrated into project delivery, field service, workshop activities and business operations.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Culture

  • Drive a proactive safety culture across the the company.

  • Lead implementation of VHE HSE standards, Life Saving Rules and STOP Work Authority.

  • Conduct regular sites, workshop and field service visits.

  • Challenge unsafe conditions, behaviors and decisions.

  • Coach leaders and employees to improve HSE performance.

  • Local functional leadership of HSE coordination function

Operational HSE Management

  • Ensure effective management of operational risks.

  • Verify implementation of critical risk controls.

  • Support safe execution of high-risk activities.

  • Manage contractor HSE performance.

Incident Management & Compliance

  • Lead incident investigations and root cause analyses.

  • Ensure effective corrective and preventive actions.

  • Develop meaningful Lessons Learned.

  • Ensure compliance with legal, customer and VHE HSE requirements.

  • Maintain and improve the local HSE Management System.

Performance & Reporting

  • Monitor and report HSE performance.

  • Identify trends, risks and improvement opportunities.

  • Provide transparent reporting to the Managing Director and Regional Head of HSE.

Qualifications & Experience

Essential

  • Degree in Engineering, HSE or related discipline.

  • NEBOSH IGC or equivalent.

  • Minimum 8 years HSE experience within hydropower, offshore oil & gas, offshore wind, energy, OEM, EPC or heavy industry.

  • Experience leading incident investigations and contractor management.

  • The successful candidate must demonstrate strong proficiency in Norwegian, both written and spoken, as this is essential for carrying out the responsibilities of the position.

Preferred

  • NEBOSH Diploma or equivalent Level 6 qualification.

  • ISO 45001 Lead Auditor qualification.

  • Formal incident investigation training.

  • Experience within major projects or high-risk operational environments.

Success Profile

The successful candidate:

  • Demonstrates visible HSE leadership and strong field presence.

  • Ensures uncompromised safe execution across all operations.

  • Leads high-quality investigations and organizational learning.

  • Acts as a trusted advisor and challenger to management.

  • Promotes a proactive Zero Incident culture.

  • Drives continuous improvement and sustainable HSE performance.

  • Demonstrates a collaborative, accountable and "walk the talk" leadership style

What We Offer

  • A meaningful career in the hydropower industry, supporting Norway's renewable energy sector. Our solutions ensure the reliable operation of critical infrastructure and contribute to the generation of clean, renewable energy.

  • The opportunity to make a real impact on how we develop, standardize, and modernize solutions for the hydropower plants of the future.

  • Interesting and challenging responsibilities in a multidisciplinary environment within hydropower and renewable energy.

  • Exciting professional and career development opportunities within a large international organization.

  • A collaborative and supportive work environment, combining strong technical expertise with an excellent team culture. We offer modern office facilities and a variety of social activities.

  • Competitive salary and benefits.

Diversity and Inclusion

We believe that diversity and inclusion make us stronger. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, experiences, competencies, and perspectives, as we believe this contributes to better solutions and stronger teams.

Background Check

In accordance with regulations related to power-sector security and access to sensitive information, Voith Hydro AS uses Semac to conduct background checks on employees. Employment is therefore subject to a satisfactory background check.

Location

The preferred place of work is one of our offices in:

Oslo (Østre Aker Vei 90)

Trondheim (Sluppenvegen 25)

Travel Requerements

As part of this role, you should expect regular travel to customer sites and project's locations across Norway, as well as periodic travel between our office locations.

Industry Background

Experience from the hydropower industry is considered an advantage; however, candidates with relevant HSE experience from other industrial, energy, engineering, or infrastructure sectors are also encouraged to apply.

If this opportunity sounds like the right fit for you, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV and application through our recruitment portal. Please note that both your CV and application must be submitted in English.

For further information about the position, please contact: Siv-Anita Nilsen HR Manager Norway Phone: +47 920 64 300

Ready for your next challenge? Submit your CV and application and join us in shaping the future of hydropower.

jobs.title: Project Researcher (PhD. Student) or Postdoctoral Researcher, engine emission aftertreatment modelling, simulation, experiments and control (Energy Technology)
jobs.description:
The University of Vaasa is an inspiring and international community where we work together for a sustainable and responsible future. We combine expertise in business and technology in a unique way, tackling current challenges with determination and collaboration. As part of the Nordic regions largest energy technology hub, we promote sustainable business, energy, and society. We educate future professionals who will create a fairer and more sustainable world.

The position is offered initially for two (2) years starting on January 2027 or at an earliest possible date mutually agreed between both parties. The position is located in the School of Technology and Innovation and under energy technology discipline.

https://www.univaasa.fi/en/about/organisation/schools/technology-and-innovations/

Your role

You will be part of the Efficient Powertrain Solutions (EPS) Research group working on several challenging projects, at the forefront of research and development of novel combustion engine technologies. With over 40 researchers and 3 MEUR of annual research turnover, we are the biggest focused powertrain-oriented research group in Finland. Our focus is on model-based development of advanced engine solutions supporting our industry partners in conforming to tightening emissions and noise regulation in marine and off-road sectors.

Hydrogen represents a promising zero-carbon alternative fuel for large oceangoing vessels, where internal combustion engines are expected to remain a prime mover. Hydrogen-biogas combustion is a green solution in marine application, where the methane slip in exhaust gases is challenging to remove by catalytic and thermal management methods, which require further development. Methane is counted parallel to CO2 as a greenhouse gas, which emissions are regulated. In addition, significant challenges have restrained its large-scale onboard integration, catalyst durability, amid concerns related to safety, fuel availability, and cost. This research is related to green shift in off-road applications (marine, machinery), where conventional fossil fuels like diesel oil will be replaced with low-/zero-carbon fuels with flexible mixtures.

The new EU-funded [H4PERION](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/research/projects/h4perion-hydrogen-performance-enhancement-and-reliable-ice-operation) project directly addresses these barriers by developing a new ultra-efficient hydrogen-capable internal combustion engine (TRL 7, while meeting 55% thermal efficiency target), followed by concept integration at ship level through a pilot demonstration.

In this context as a part of the EPS team, you will contribute to:

- Developing novel catalytic methane removal solutions securing low pollutant emissions and flexible operation with hydrogen and other gaseous fuels.
- 1D modelling and simulations of catalytic aftertreatment systems based on engine-out emissions and experimental catalyst performance results.
- Experimental catalyst testing campaign in corresponding off-road application.
- Integrating the exhaust aftertreatment systems together with appropriate thermal and energy management strategies to ensure compliance with the projects emission and efficiency targets.

Achieving the targeted efficiency within the project timeline requires deep integration of catalyst simulation and testing environments with autonomous calibration routines. To this end we are seeking talented and motivated researchers in simulation-driven catalytic aftertreatment development and optimization.

All tasks are agreed in more detail in the Annual Work Plan. The annual working time is 1612 hours.

Requirements

- You have a masters degree or a PhD in a relevant field. For example chemical/mechanical/process engineering, with a specialization in emission catalyst reaction reactions/modelling or combustion engines.
- You have documented experience in 1D aftertreatment/combustion model calibration and validation with experimental data. Experience in 3D simulation environments is a benefit.
- You are able to efficiently plan and conduct engine laboratory experiments and postprocess emission data. Laboratory experience such as test-rig development, instrumentation, and data-acquisition is considered a strong advantage.
- Engine emission aftertreatment involves chemical reactions, as a result good knowledge on catalysts as well as chemical reaction mechanisms and kinetics is a benefit.
- Excellent analytical skills in addition to good academic writing skills are highly advantageous for your candidature.
- Proven track record in high-quality journals/conferences/projects on the topics related to the position, is an additional advantage.
- You enjoy developing innovative solutions to technically challenging problems and have the right mix of intellectual curiosity and practical pragmatism.
- You have good communication and language (English is required) skills and enjoy working both independently and as part of a team. You are open to sharing your knowledge with colleagues and ambitious to develop yourself as a researcher.

To be eligible for a full PhD student position, the candidate is required to participate in a separate application process which is arranged at least twice a year in order to be admitted and enrolled as a doctoral student at the University of Vaasa. For more information about eligibility and the application process, please visit the Graduate School's website: [Doctoral education | University of Vaasa (uwasa.fi)](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/education/doctoral-education)

Inspirational work environment

In the University of Vaasa, we conduct combustion engine research focused on advanced energy concepts and alternative fuels. We have a special focus on large bore-marine and stationary engines, for which we have a unique, state of the art, research facilities at EnergyLab. With close collaboration with industry, we are transforming the energy sector by bringing the cutting-edge technology to real-world application. We welcome you to join one of the most fascinating energy innovation centers in the Nordic region in combustion modelling and control. For more information about the facilities see: [EnergyLab](https://www.uwasa.fi/en/research/research-platforms/vebic/laboratories)https://www.uwasa.fi/en/newshub/news/university-vaasa-university-oulu-vtt-and-wartsila-are-building-energy-laboratoryhttps://w

Keskeiset tehtäväsi ovat:

Liiketoimintadatan analysointi ja tiedolla johtamisen vahvistaminen: jalostat kattavasta datasta olennaisia havaintoja ja kehität raportointi- ja analysointimalleja liiketoiminnan päätöksenteon tueksi.

Taloudellinen raportointi ja sen kehittäminen: tuotat ajantasaista raportointia ja kehität sitä vastaamaan entistä paremmin liiketoiminnan tarpeita.

Ennuste- ja budjetointiprosessien kehittäminen: osallistut suunnittelun, ennustamisen ja budjetoinnin kehittämiseen sekä tuot prosesseihin analyyttistä näkökulmaa.


Millaista tekijää etsimme?

Onnistuaksesi tehtävässä tarvitset aiempaa kokemusta business controllerin tai muun vastaavan analytiikkaa ja liiketoiminnan sparrausta sisältävän roolin tehtävästä. Tarjoamme sinulle vaikuttavan roolin, jossa pääset vahvistamaan yrityksemme tiedolla johtamista ja rakentamaan entistä parempia toimintatapoja liiketoiminnan arkeen. jobs.title: Pitkäaikainen sijaisperhe huostaanotetuille nuorille/teineille
jobs.description:
Olisitko valmis auttamaan apua tarvitsevia nuoria tarjoamalla heille pitkäaikaisen kodin, tasapainoisen elinympäristön ja tukemalla heidän kasvuaan ja kehitystään? Sijaisperheenä pääset tekemään todella tärkeää työtä ja vaikuttamaan lapsen elämään kokonaisvaltaisesti. Tällä hetkellä tarvitaan erityisesti sijaisperheitä, joilla on mahdollisuus ottaa sijoitukseen teini-ikäisiä lapsia ja kykyä vastata heidän vaativiinkin tarpeisiinsa.

Sijaisperhe on perhe, joka antaa kodin lapselle, joka ei voi asua omassa kodissaan. Sijaisperhe huolehtii lapsen arjesta, kasvatuksesta ja hyvinvoinnista. Sijaisperheelle maksetaan palkkiota ja kulukorvausta jokaiselta kuukaudelta, kun sijoitettu lapsi asuu perheessä. Kuukausitulot riippuvat sijoitettujen lasten määrästä (alla olevan taulukon mukaisesti). Tulot kerryttävät eläkettä.

-Yksi lapsi: palkkio 2009 euroa, kulukorvaus 1035 euroa, yhteensä 3044 euroa
-Kaksi lasta: palkkio 4018 euroa, kulukorvaus 2071 euroa, yhteensä 6089 euroa
-Kolme lasta: palkkio 6027 euroa, kulukorvaus 3107 euroa, yhteensä 9134 euroa
-Neljä lasta: palkkio 8036 euroa, kulukorvaus 4143 euroa, yhteensä 12179 euroa

Ennen kuin voitte toimia sijaisperheenä, tulee teidän osallistua sijaisperhevalmennukseen. Haemme nyt sopivia perheitä tähän yksilöllisesti toteutettavaan valmennukseemme. Valmennus räätälöidään teille sopivaksi ja sen voi aloittaa sopimuksen mukaan, vaikka heti. Osa valmennustapaamisista on perhekohtaisia ja osa toteutuu ryhmässä muiden valmennettavien perheiden kanssa (etäyhteydellä). Valmennus on prosessi, jonka kesto on keskimäärin 5-7kk.

Perhehoitajana eli sijaisvanhempana toimiminen edellyttää:
-Ikä noin 25-60 vuotta. Tätä ikähaitaria voi hieman venyttää lapsen iästä riippuen, mutta ajatuksena on, että henkilön tulee olla kypsä päättämään pitkästä (mahdollisesti yli kymmenen vuoden) sitoutumisesta ja henkilön ei tulisi saavuttaa eläkeikää, ennen kuin lapsi on täysi-ikäinen.

-Vakaa talous ja elämäntilanne. Traumatisoituneiden ja erityistarpeisten lasten hoitaminen on vaativaa ja jos oma elämäntilanne ei ole tasapainossa, saattaa se vaikuttaa voimavaroihin ja kyvykkyyteen toimia sijaisperheenä.

-Ei mielenterveys-, päihde- eikä rikostaustaa. Nämä lienevät itsestään selviä esteitä.

-Sopiva asumismuoto. Teinille pitää pystyä järjestämään omaa huonetta.

Arvostamme seuraavia asioita, mutta tiedämme, ettei koko listan mukaista superperhettä välttämättä löydy. Ota siis rohkeasti yhteyttä, vaikkei jokainen kohta täyttyisi.
-Ei omia alle kouluikäisiä lapsia
-Kahden vanhemman perhe
-Mahdollisuutta auttaa kahta tai useampaa lasta (esim. sisarukset)
-Kokemusta erityisyydestä, esim. nepsyoireista, traumatyöskentelystä, oppimishäiriöistä
-Kokemusta kiintymyssuhteen rakentamisesta
-Kokemusta kasvatustyöstä
-Kokemusta lastensuojelusta

Työtä tukevia ammattikoulutuksia ovat esim. sosiaali- ja terveysalan- sekä kasvatustieteen koulutukset. Näiden lisäksi erilaiset terapeuttiset, ohjaukselliset ja psykiatriset lisäkoulutukset tarjoavat vahvaa tukea työssä menestymiseen. Virallista koulutusvaatimusta ei perhehoitajan työssä kuitenkaan ole.

Aikaisempi työkokemus voisi esimerkiksi olla joku näistä:
-Lastenkodin ohjaaja, perhetyöntekijä, sosiaaliohjaaja
-Opettaja, erityisopettaja, varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja
-Sairaanhoitaja, terveydenhoitaja
-Psykologi / psykoterapeutti / toimintaterapeutti
-Nuoriso-ohjaaja, yhteisöpedagogi
Tai muu vastaava työkokemus.

Perhehoitajan tehtävässä pärjää parhaiten, jos osaa nähdä lapsen mahdollisesti haastavan käytöksen taakse ja ymmärtää aiempien elämänkokemusten merkityksen lapsen kasvulle ja kehitykselle. Työssä tarvitaan joustavuutta ja valmiutta ymmärtää ja kohdata lapsen biologinen perhe ja suku, eli läheisverkostot. Tämä voi joskus olla haastavaa, koska lapsen sijoitus herättää vanhemmissa usein paljon tunteita. Työhön kuuluu myös yhteistyötä sosiaalitoimen sekä muiden viranomaisverkostojen kanssa. Sijoitettu lapsi tarvitsee turvallisen kodin, paljon aikuisen huomiota, säännöllisyyttä ja rutiineja sekä tietysti kiintymystä, läheisyyttä ja rakkautta. Lapsesta tulee vähitellen sijaisperheen tärkeä ja tasaveroinen perheenjäsen.

Sijaisperheen arki mukailee tavallista lapsiperhearkea, sisältäen arkea ja juhlaa, itkua ja naurua. Perheen toisen vanhemman tulee jäädä kotiin hoitamaan sijoitettua lasta/lapsia ainakin vuodeksi, jotta kiintymyssuhde ja asettuminen perheeseen mahdollistuu. Työn tukena on meiltä ammattitaitoinen tukityöntekijä, jonka kanssa käydään säännöllisesti läpi kuulumiset sekä paneudutaan lapsen asioihin myös syvällisemmin, lapsen yksilöllinen tilanne huomioiden. Kuljemme sijaisperheen rinnalla ja meille on tärkeää saavuttaa avoin ja luotettava yhteistyösuhde. Tukityömme on säännöllistä ja toteutuu puheluin ja kotikäynnein. Tukityön lisäksi tarjoamme perhehoitajillemme työnohjauksen ja lisäkoulutusmahdollisuuksia.

Suomen Perhekodit Oy on nuori suomalainen yritys. Valmennamme ja tuemme sijaisperheitä arjen tilanteissa, koko lapsen perheessä asumisen ajan. Huolehdimme byrokratiasta niin että sinä voit huolehtia lapsesta ilman turhaa stressiä. Olemme helposti lähestyttävä, ihmisläheinen ja aidosti lapsen asioista huolehtiva joukko. Verkkosivuiltamme löydät kattavat tiedot sijaisperheenä toimimisesta.

Ota yhteyttä, niin mietitään yhdessä, olisiko teidän perheenne sopiva sijaisperheeksi!

jobs.description:

**Your Impact**

- 2+ year work experience within logistics / transport / supply chain area, Fluent English skills (written and oral). Finnish seeing as an advantage. Strong or good Excel skills


- Understanding supply chain and material flow principles. Strong pressure resistance

- Our team works in Suolahti and across the globe. We are a professional, yet easy-going team, ready to welcome you to AGCO.


- We value our employees' well-being, offering flexible working hours, remote work options, Smartum-benefits, and comprehensive occupational health services.

jobs.title: Pitkäaikainen sijaisperhe huostaanotetuille lapsille
jobs.description:
Olisitko valmis auttamaan apua tarvitsevia lapsia tarjoamalla heille pitkäaikaisen kodin, tasapainoisen elinympäristön ja tukemalla heidän kasvuaan ja kehitystään? Sijaisperheenä pääset tekemään todella tärkeää työtä ja vaikuttamaan lapsen elämään kokonaisvaltaisesti. Tällä hetkellä tarvitaan erityisesti sijaisperheitä, joilla on kokemusta vaativista lapsista.

Sijaisperhe on perhe, joka antaa kodin lapselle, joka ei voi asua omassa kodissaan. Sijaisperhe huolehtii lapsen arjesta, kasvatuksesta ja hyvinvoinnista. Sijaisperheelle maksetaan palkkiota ja kulukorvausta jokaiselta kuukaudelta, kun sijoitettu lapsi asuu perheessä. Kuukausitulot riippuvat sijoitettujen lasten määrästä (alla olevan taulukon mukaisesti). Tulot kerryttävät eläkettä.

-Yksi lapsi: palkkio 2009 euroa, kulukorvaus 1035 euroa, yhteensä 3044 euroa
-Kaksi lasta: palkkio 4018 euroa, kulukorvaus 2071 euroa, yhteensä 6089 euroa
-Kolme lasta: palkkio 6027 euroa, kulukorvaus 3107 euroa, yhteensä 9134 euroa
-Neljä lasta: palkkio 8036 euroa, kulukorvaus 4143 euroa, yhteensä 12179 euroa

Ennen kuin voitte toimia sijaisperheenä, tulee teidän osallistua sijaisperhevalmennukseen. Haemme nyt sopivia perheitä tähän yksilöllisesti, eli perhekohtaisesti, toteutettavaan valmennukseemme. Valmennus räätälöidään teille sopivaksi ja sen voi aloittaa sopimuksen mukaan, vaikka heti. Valmennus on prosessi, jonka kesto on keskimäärin 5-7kk.

Perhehoitajana eli sijaisvanhempana toimiminen edellyttää:
-Ikä noin 25-55 vuotta. Tätä ikähaitaria voi hieman venyttää, mutta ajatuksena on, että henkilön tulee olla kypsä päättämään pitkästä (mahdollisesti yli kymmenen vuoden) sitoutumisesta ja henkilön ei tulisi saavuttaa eläkeikää, ennen kuin lapsi on täysi-ikäinen.
-Vakaa talous ja elämäntilanne. Traumatisoituneiden ja erityistarpeisten lasten hoitaminen on vaativaa ja jos oma elämäntilanne ei ole tasapainossa, saattaa se vaikuttaa voimavaroihin ja kyvykkyyteen toimia sijaisperheenä.
-Ei mielenterveys-, päihde- eikä rikostaustaa. Nämä lienevät itsestään selviä esteitä.
-Sopiva asumismuoto. Sijoitetuille lapsille tarvitaan omat huoneet. Alle kouluikäiset sijoitetut lapset eivät välttämättä heti tarvitse omaa huonetta, mutta viimeistään kouluikäisellä lapsella tulee olla oma huone.

Arvostamme seuraavia asioita, mutta tiedämme, ettei koko listan mukaista superperhettä välttämättä löydy. Ota siis rohkeasti yhteyttä, vaikkei jokainen kohta täyttyisi.
-Ei omia alle kouluikäisiä lapsia
-Kahden vanhemman perhe
-Mahdollisuutta auttaa kahta tai useampaa lasta (esim. sisarukset)
-Kokemusta erityisyydestä, esim. nepsyoireista, traumatyöskentelystä, oppimishäiriöistä
-Kokemusta kiintymyssuhteen rakentamisesta
-Kokemusta kasvatustyöstä
-Kokemusta lastensuojelusta

Työtä tukevia ammattikoulutuksia ovat esim. sosiaali- ja terveysalan- sekä kasvatustieteen koulutukset. Näiden lisäksi erilaiset terapeuttiset, ohjaukselliset ja psykiatriset lisäkoulutukset tarjoavat vahvaa tukea työssä menestymiseen. Virallista koulutusvaatimusta ei perhehoitajan työssä kuitenkaan ole.

Aikaisempi työkokemus voisi esimerkiksi olla joku näistä:
-Lastenkodin ohjaaja, perhetyöntekijä, sosiaaliohjaaja
-Opettaja, erityisopettaja, varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja
-Sairaanhoitaja, terveydenhoitaja
-Psykologi / psykoterapeutti / toimintaterapeutti
-Nuoriso-ohjaaja, yhteisöpedagogi

Tai muu vastaava työkokemus.

Perhehoitajan tehtävässä pärjää parhaiten, jos osaa nähdä lapsen mahdollisesti haastavan käytöksen taakse ja ymmärtää aiempien elämänkokemusten merkityksen lapsen kasvulle ja kehitykselle. Työssä tarvitaan joustavuutta ja valmiutta ymmärtää ja kohdata lapsen biologinen perhe ja suku, eli läheisverkostot. Tämä voi joskus olla haastavaa, koska lapsen sijoitus herättää vanhemmissa usein paljon tunteita. Työhön kuuluu myös yhteistyötä sosiaalitoimen sekä muiden viranomaisverkostojen kanssa. Sijoitettu lapsi tarvitsee turvallisen kodin, paljon aikuisen huomiota, säännöllisyyttä ja rutiineja sekä tietysti kiintymystä, läheisyyttä ja rakkautta. Lapsesta tulee vähitellen sijaisperheen tärkeä ja tasaveroinen perheenjäsen.

Sijaisperheen arki mukailee tavallista lapsiperhearkea, sisältäen arkea ja juhlaa, itkua ja naurua. Perheen toisen vanhemman tulee jäädä kotiin hoitamaan sijoitettua lasta/lapsia ainakin vuodeksi, jotta kiintymyssuhde ja asettuminen perheeseen mahdollistuu. Työn tukena on meiltä ammattitaitoinen tukityöntekijä, jonka kanssa käydään säännöllisesti läpi kuulumiset sekä paneudutaan lapsen asioihin myös syvällisemmin, lapsen yksilöllinen tilanne huomioiden. Kuljemme sijaisperheen rinnalla ja meille on tärkeää saavuttaa avoin ja luotettava yhteistyösuhde. Tukityömme on säännöllistä ja toteutuu puheluin ja kotikäynnein. Tukityön lisäksi tarjoamme perhehoitajillemme työnohjauksen ja lisäkoulutusmahdollisuuksia.

Suomen Perhekodit Oy on nuori suomalainen yritys. Valmennamme ja tuemme sijaisperheitä arjen tilanteissa, koko lapsen perheessä asumisen ajan. Huolehdimme byrokratiasta niin että sinä voit huolehtia lapsesta ilman turhaa stressiä. Olemme helposti lähestyttävä, ihmisläheinen ja aidosti lapsen asioista huolehtiva joukko. Verkkosivuiltamme löydät kattavat tiedot sijaisperheenä toimimisesta.

Ota yhteyttä, niin mietitään yhdessä, olisiko teidän perheenne sopiva sijaisperheeksi!

Koulutuksena vaadimme vähintään LÄHIHOITAJA koulutuksen saanutta. Työhön perehdytetään. Viikossa työpäiviä 3-4 päivää säännöllisesti ma-pe välisenä aikana.
