jobs.title: DIAS Fellow in Engineering within Robotics
jobs.description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS) and the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) seek an outstanding candidate to fill a tenure track Fellow (Assistant Professor level) position in the field of Robotics. The candidate is expected to start on January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

The application deadline is September 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

We are looking for a researcher with clear potential for research excellence who thrives in and is inspired by interdisciplinary collaboration. The ideal candidate will be expected to contribute to high-quality research in their field while embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven inquiry and interdisciplinary dialogue. The successful candidate should have a strong and promising research profile, with potential for attracting external research funding, and a demonstrated ability to work across disciplines. The candidate will be attached to both the Department and DIAS and should be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU. 

 

Who are we looking for

We seek a researcher with expertise in the field of Robotics, who is eager to develop their research career within the DIAS framework. The ideal candidate should demonstrate: 

  • A commitment to engaging in boundary-crossing interdisciplinary research and dialogue.

  • A strong commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration, contributing to research that bridges multiple fields. 

  • Strong interest in driving internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition. 

  • Engagement in various forms of research dissemination, including interdisciplinary research and dialogue. 

 

Qualifications

Successful applicants must: 

  • Have research experience in computer vision fields related to laboratory automation. This could include (but is not limited to) methods for:

    • vision-based handling of laboratory equipment, in particular glassware and fluids 

    • segmentation and vision-based handling of medical specimens and fluids

  • Hold a PhD or similar qualifications within relevant fields of Robotics, such as robotics control, modelling, computer vision, medical/industrial robotics and artificial intelligence. 

  • Exhibit curiosity-driven research excellence, thinking beyond traditional boundaries. 

  • Be fluent in English.

  • Show potential for attracting external research funding. Experience in applying for external funding and a strong international network, are considered comparative advantages.

  • Have research publications that demonstrate their excellence and broad thinking. 

 

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally. 

 

The Department

MMMI

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute is an internationally recognized institute, which has maintained a leading position in robotics for more than three decades. The institute is the origin of robotics research in Denmark and has spawned the world-renowned cluster of robotics in Odense with more than 130 robotics companies including Universal Robots and Mobile Industrial Robots. Building on our expertise in AI, robotics and software, we have raised strong research centres in related domains, such as Health Informatics and Energy Informatics, Drones and other relevant research areas. 

SDU Robotics

SDU Robotics conducts research among others within the fields of robotics and computer vision. The unit focuses on research problems from real robotics applications within manufacturing industries, hospitals, elderly care, and other partners in society. The unit also focuses on Robot related vision technologies for facilitating industrial part feeding, automated product assembly, uncertainty aware quality inspection, and biomedical segmentation for diagnosis and robot control. 

SDU Robotics’ research involves mathematical modeling and control of robots, robotic processes and robot systems, human-robot interactions, computer vision for reliable inspection and robot control, and simulation technologies for robotics and computer vision aimed at closing the Sim2Real gap. Artificial Intelligence is widely applied within all research fields. 

 

Additional information

For further information about being a professor at DIAS, please contact DIAS director Sten Rynning at +45 6550 2193 or via email at director-dias@sdu.dk.

For more questions about the position please contact Head of Unit, Professor Thiusius Rajeeth Savarimuthu at trs@mmmi.sdu.dk.

 

Application, salary, and employment terms

The candidate will be attached to The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute in Odense and is also expected to participate in DIAS activities and interdisciplinary cooperation in Odense regularly.
The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for tenure track assistant professor as described herein. Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”. 

Further information on salary and taxation.

 

The tenure track programme the Faculty of Engineering is aimed at the most talented scholars who have established a high level in their current research and other professional work, and those who possess exceptional potential to achieve the highest international level within their research area. Candidates enter the assistant professor level (for up to 6 years) and, upon successful completion, will be promoted to a permanent position of associate professor, subject to a positive assessment by an expert committee. Indicators of relevant scholarly merits include documented independent scholarly output, ground-breaking publications, achievement of excellence grants, and international research network.
Teaching obligations will be reduced compared to a standard professorship at SDU, allowing more time for research and leadership activities.

To qualify for the position, you must have obtained a PhD or similar degree by the application deadline. 

 

Application requirements
The application must include the following:

  • Letter of motivation that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position.

  • Detailed CV including documentation of experience, and contacts for possible references. 

  • An elaborate research and funding plan (max 4 pages) for the next three years including a description of synergy with the department's activities and the potential to benefit from DIAS’s interdisciplinary environment.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications, indicating which publications are most relevant for the position.

  • Up to five of the most relevant research articles – if you submit a monograph, it counts as 3 articles. Please upload a pdf for each publication. For co-authored publications, briefly describe the extent of the co-authorship or your contribution to the publications (please do this for each co-authored publication). You can do so by using this form or by describing the co-authorship in such a way that the committee can assess the extent of your contribution.

  • Teaching Portfolio as documentation for teaching and learning experience as well as supervision qualifications. Any format is acceptable, but you can find inspiration for structuring your teaching portfolio on the Faculty's teaching portfolio page.

All application materials must be submitted in English, and only applications written in English will be considered.

We recommend that international applicants take the time to visit websites of Work in Denmark and the International Staff Office at SDU. Here you can find information and facts about moving to, working and living in Denmark.

Submission guidelines

  • All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be protected by password. 

  • Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

Assessment

Shortlisting may be used as part of the assessment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU.

Assessment of applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicant will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. 

Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation and references may be obtained. 

 

About SDU
SDU is committed to fostering a diverse staff that reflects society’s diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background.
SDU was founded in 1966 and now has over 27,000 students, nearly 20% of whom are international. SDU employs more than 3,800 staff and offers 115 study programmes across disciplines such as the humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, health sciences, and engineering. While SDU’s main campus is in Odense, it also has campuses in other locations.



Equal opportunity employment
The University of Southern Denmark is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, or any other protected status.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes our staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.



How to apply
Applications must be submitted electronically via the "Apply online" link provided in the job posting.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.
 

The application deadline is September 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST)

jobs.title: Vauvauinnin ja uimakoulun ohjaaja, Tampere
jobs.description:
Oletko työtä pelkäämätön, ihmisten kanssa toimeen tuleva ja liikunnallinen? Pidätkö lapsista? Sinulla on myös rohkeaa asennetta tarttua asioihin. Työ meillä vaatii tekijältään vastuuntuntoista asennetta ja rohkeutta tarttua toimeen. Haemme vauvauinninohjaajia ja uimaopettajia Tampereelle Uimakoulu Pikku Joutseneen. Kyseessä on ohjaustyö tarpeen mukaa. Valitsemme ensisijaisesti henkilöitä, jotka voivat ohjata arki-iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin ja kouluttautua loka-marraskuun aikana.

Kelluta Oy kehittää ja toteuttaa vauvauinti- ja uimakoulupalveluja. Meillä on vahva vesiliikunnan ammattilaisten kouluttamisen taustaosaaminen ja koulutamme säännöllisesti alan ammattilaisia niin Suomessa kuin ulkomaillakin.

Olemme alan edelläkävijä ja siksi haluamme taloomme alan parhaat tekijät. Tarjolla on haasteellinen, luova työ ja kilpailukykyinen palkka. Koulutamme tarvittaessa, eli työtä voi hakea, vaikka ei ole vielä esimerkiksi uimaopettaja tai vauva- ja perheuinninohjaajakoulutusta. Työ vaatii täysi-ikäisyyden.

Edellytämme valmiutta kouluttautua konseptimme mukaiseksi ohjaajaksi. Suomalainen Vesiliikuntainstituutti tarjoaa Vauvauinninohjaaja- ja uimaopettajavalmennuksen tehtävään valituille. Eduksi katsotaan uimaopettajan tutkinto (Suomen Uimaopetus- ja hengenpelastusliitto ry, SUH tai vastaava koulutus) ja/tai Vauva- ja perheuinninohjaajakurssi (Suomen Uimaopetus- ja hengenpelastusliitto ry, SUH tai vastaava koulutus).

Aloitamme hakemusten käsittelyn jo hakuaikana.

jobs.title: Postdoc in material flow analysis and resource management
jobs.description:
The SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a postdoctoral position in material flow analysis and resource management. The position is initially offered for one year, with the possibility of extension depending on available funding.

The position will focus on quantitative assessment of material and resource systems. The work will involve analysis of material stocks and flows, resource use, waste management and recycling, and associated environmental impacts across different material systems and end-use sectors.

The postdoc will apply material flow analysis, life cycle assessment and scenario analysis to support research on resource and waste management. Application areas may include plastics, phosphorus, critical raw materials and other material systems.

The position will contribute to ongoing research projects and activities at SDU Life Cycle Engineering.

Main tasks

The main tasks include:

·         Quantifying material stocks and flows across different material systems and end-use sectors

·         Assessing secondary resource availability and future resource demand

·         Applying life cycle assessment and scenario analysis

·         Contributing to scientific publications and research projects

·         Contributing to teaching and supervision within relevant areas

Qualifications

The successful candidate should have:

·         A PhD in environmental engineering, industrial ecology, environmental science or a related field

·         Strong experience with material flow analysis, life cycle assessment, and scenario analysis

·         Strong quantitative and analytical skills

·         A strong publication record in relevant international journals

·         Experience in international research collaboration

·         Good written and spoken English

·         Ability to work independently and as part of a research team

Experience with plastics, phosphorus, critical raw materials or related resource systems will be considered an advantage. 

Research environment

As a postdoc, you will conduct independent research, contribute to high-quality scientific publications and participate actively in a collaborative research environment.

You will join SDU Life Cycle Engineering, where research covers industrial ecology, material flow analysis, life cycle assessment, circular economy and energy system optimization.

The position provides opportunities for collaboration across SDU and with external partners, including international conferences and research visits.

Application

The application must be submitted in English through the SDU online recruitment system.

Assessment of applicants will be based on the submitted application material. The application must include:

  • Curriculum Vitae

  • A motivated application describing the applicant’s research interests, relevant qualifications and motivation for applying

  • PhD degree certificate(s)

  • A list of publications with the most relevant publications highlighted

  • Documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

Submission guideline: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file).

The application deadline is 10. September 2026 at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)  

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology. The research environment conducts interdisciplinary research on the global and systemic interactions between materials, technologies, energy, the environment and society.

The Department of Green Technology is located in Odense, the main campus of the University of Southern Denmark. Odense offers an international research environment and an open Scandinavian working culture.

Further Information

Further information about the scientific content of the position is available from:

Wu Chen
Associate Professor
Department of Green Technology
SDU Life Cycle Engineering
University of Southern Denmark
Email: wuc@igt.sdu.dk

Assessment and selection process 

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. 

Read about the Assessment and selection process.    

Employment terms 

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 1-year period, and the preferred start date is from 15 October 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein.  

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation.  

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”. 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s). 

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information. 

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering. 

Apply at https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu.

jobs.title: Safari- ja aktiviteettiopas
jobs.description:
Nuorgamin Lomakeskus Oy on pieni kodikas perheyritys Suomen ja EU:n pohjoisimmassa kylässä - Nuorgamissa. Lomakeskus sijaitsee upeissa avarissa tunturimaisemissa, aivan Norjan ja Jäämeren läheisyydessä, Tenojoen rannalla. Lomakeskus on toiminut jo yli 50 vuotta saman perheen käsissä. Yrityksemme tärkeitä arvoja ovat kestävä matkailu, paikallisuus ja luonto. Henkilökuntaamme kuuluu 2-8 vakituista ja kausityöntekijää omistajaperheen lisäksi. . Haemme joukkoomme safari- ja aktiviteettioppaita talvikauteen 2026-2027. Työt alkavat joulukuussa ja kestävät maaliskuun loppuun asti tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Asiakasryhmämme ovat pieniä, ja haluammekin painottaa työssämme asiakkaiden aitoa kohtaamista, vieraanvaraisuutta ja henkilökohtaista palvelua. Tavoitteenamme on luoda asiakkaillemme ainutlaatuinen elämysmatka pohjoisimman Lapin arktisella tundra-alueella.

Safari- ja aktiviteettioppaana tehtäviisi kuuluu kansainvälisten viikkoasiakkaidemme ohjaaminen kelkkasafareilla, lumikenkäretkillä sekä muilla tunturiretkillä ja ulkoaktiviteeteilla. Opastöiden lisäksi työtehtäviisi kuuluu aktiviteettien valmistelu- ja purkutyöt, huoltotehtävät, eräruokailut, asiakaspalvelu sekä asiakkaiden kuljetustehtävät.

Oppaamme työskentelevät niin yhdessä, yksin kuin pareittainkin. Etsimme opasta, joka on reipas, vastuuntuntoinen tiimipelaaja ja ystävällinen asiakaspalvelija.

Edellytämme sinulta:

- Kokemusta matkailualan opastyöstä, mieluiten Lapista

- Oma-aloitteisuutta, joustavuutta ja paineensietokykyä

- Sujuvaa englannin kielen taitoa

- B-ajokorttia sekä kokemusta moottorikelkan käsittelystä


Tarjoamme sinulle

- Kokoaikaisen työn talvikaudeksi 2026-2027

- Kilpailukykyisen palkan 14-17 €/tunti kokemuksen ja osaamisen huomioiden (MARATES)

- Hyvän perehdytyksen ja osaavien kollegoiden tuen läpi kauden

- Työsuhdeasumisen (vuokra alkaen 400 €/kk)

- Työpaikkaruokailut: 8 €/lounas ja 4,50 €/aamupala

- Pienen työyhteisön rennon ja yhteisöllisen ilmapiirin

- Erinomaiset vapaa-ajanviettomahdollisuudet kauniissa tunturiluonnossa

- Vuokravälineitä edullisesti luontoharrastuksiin

- Ilmaisen pääsyn kunnan kuntosalille

- Mahdollisuuden vuokrata kauttamme tilapäisesti myös autoa

- Laadukkaan työterveyshuollon


Eduksi katsomme:

- Matkailualan moniosaamisen ja koulutuksen alalta

- Muun sujuvan kielitaidon (esim. saksa, ranska, hollanti)

- Ensiapu-kortin

- Hygieniapassin

- Pohjois-Lapin alueellisen tuntemuksen


Jos kiinnostuit ja koet, että kausityö Suomen huipulla olisi juuri sinua varten, lähetä hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi meille sähköpostitse. Etenemme työntekijöiden valinnassa jo hakuajan aikana sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Hakuaika päättyy 20.9.2026. Ilmoitamme valinnan etenemisestä ja päätöksistä henkilökohtaisesti.

Hakemukset: eemeli@visitnuorgam.fi

Lisätietoja: Eemeli Hekkanen, puh. 0400 282845

jobs.title: Senior Sales Account Manager, Marine
jobs.description:
Cadmatic is a leading global developer of digital and intelligent 3D-based design, engineering, and information management solutions for the marine, process, and construction industries. Our journey started in the 1980s. Over the past decade, we have grown by 20 percent annually, and it's all about talent. We truly value our people – many stay with us for years, with an average tenure of 10 years. Today we have over 330 proactive, engaged, and growth-minded people in 20 countries around the world. Over 6000 customers are using our software solutions in 60 countries. In the marine industry, our technology supports around 45 percent of the worlds shipyards. We continue strong growth.

We are looking for a Senior Sales Account Manager, Marine to strengthen and grow our Marine business across the Nordic & Baltic region. In this role, you will combine strategic account management, new business development, and regional growth. You will take ownership of selected key customer relationships, develop new opportunities across the marine ecosystem, drive complex sales opportunities end-to-end, and help customers improve engineering productivity, collaboration, and information management.

The position is preferably based in Finland, with flexibility for the right candidate elsewhere in the Nordics. You will work as part of an international sales organization as a senior individual contributor.

In short, your job includes:

- Growing Cadmatics Marine business across the Nordic & Baltic region through strategic account management, new customer acquisition, and regional business development
- Owning and developing selected strategic customer relationships, creating long-term account plans, and identifying growth opportunities across the Marine portfolio, including Cadmatic Hull, Cadmatic Outfitting, Cadmatic Electrical, Cadmatic P&ID, eShare, and Wave (PLM)
- Identifying, pursuing, and closing new business opportunities with shipyards, ship design and engineering companies, shipowners, and other marine industry stakeholders
- Leading complex enterprise sales cycles from discovery and stakeholder mapping through commercial negotiations and closing
- Building trusted relationships with senior technical, operational, procurement, and executive stakeholders
- Collaborating closely with solution consulting, product, customer success, delivery, and marketing teams to create customer value, maintain a healthy pipeline, and represent Cadmatic at industry events and customer meetings

We wish you to bring:

- A degree in Engineering, Naval Architecture, Business, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience gained within marine, shipbuilding, engineering software, or industrial technology
- 8+ years of experience in complex B2B sales, strategic account management, or business development ideally within engineering software, marine technology, PLM, CAD/CAE, digital twin, or related industrial software solutions
- Strong understanding of the marine and shipbuilding ecosystem and how technology purchasing decisions are made, with a proven track record of growing strategic accounts and winning new business in enterprise-level environments
- Experience managing long, multi-stakeholder sales processes, commercial negotiations, and competitive evaluations, combined with confidence in discussing engineering workflows, information management, and digitalization topics with both technical and commercial decision-makers
- A structured, proactive, and self-driven approach to territory planning, forecasting, and opportunity management
- Excellent English skills. Finnish or another Nordic language is considered a strong advantage

Cadmatic as an employer:

- A stable, global company with a long history, strong future, and advanced software solutions
- A friendly, supportive, and truly multicultural work environment where we succeed together
- Autonomy, ownership, and trust: youre encouraged to do your best work and develop professionally
- Competitive benefits and flexible working practices that support work-life balance
- An engineer-minded, people-first culture where we take our work seriously and also enjoy ourselves along the way

Join our growth journey!

Delight us with your application by September 30, 2026. If you have any questions, feel free to contact our Talent Manager Irene Paju via email at irene.paju@cadmatic.com. Please note that we only accept applications submitted through our Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

We will share the salary range in the interview invitation with candidates who progress to the interview stage.

We believe in diversity, equity, and inclusion. We are committed to building a company culture where we cherish diversity and promote equity, and where everyone feels valued and respected. We firmly believe that success comes from building an inclusive company culture and providing equal opportunities for our People.

jobs.title: DIAS Fellow in Engineering within Organoid Intelligence
jobs.description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS) and the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) seek an outstanding candidate to fill a tenure track Fellow (Assistant Professor level) position in the field of Organoid Intelligence. The candidate is expected to start on January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

The application deadline is September 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

We are looking for a researcher with clear potential for research excellence who thrives in and is inspired by interdisciplinary collaboration. The ideal candidate will be expected to contribute to high-quality research in their field while embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven inquiry and interdisciplinary dialogue. The successful candidate should have a strong and promising research profile, with potential for attracting external research funding, and a demonstrated ability to work across disciplines. The candidate will be attached to both the Department and DIAS and should be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU. 

 

Who are we looking for

We seek a researcher with expertise in the field of Organoid Intelligence, capable of combining multiple disciplines, including Neuroscience, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science and Bioimaging. The candidate must develop their research career within the DIAS framework. The ideal candidate should: 

  • Drive internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition.

  • Publish in high-level peer-reviewed academic journals.

  • Engage in various forms of research dissemination, including interdisciplinary research and dialogue.

  • Play an active role in securing external funding, including both EU and Danish sources.

  • Commit to excellence in teaching at both undergraduate and graduate levels, including participation in teaching, development of new courses, and supervision of BSc, MSc, and PhD students.

  • Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams on artificial intelligence, neuroscience, biochemistry and molecular biology, bioimaging, and across various domains, also in the framework of DIAS.

Qualifications

Successful applicants must: 

  • Hold a PhD or similar qualifications within relevant fields of data science such as AI and machine learning, neuroscience, physics and applied mathematics. Experience working within bioimaging is an advantage but not a precondition.

  • Demonstrate an outstanding track record to be qualified at the Assistant Professor level by the hiring time. The candidate may have experience at the Assistant Professor level or must be qualified at the time of being hired. The candidate may also have postdoctoral experience and may already have experience at the assistant professor level.

  • Demonstrate a strong track record of research and scientific publication.

  • Have a well-documented teaching record. 

  • Be fluent in English; the ability to communicate in Danish is an advantage but not a precondition.

  • Exhibit a commitment to excellence and multidisciplinary collaboration.

 

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally. 

 

MMMI

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute is an internationally recognized institute, which has maintained a leading position in robotics for more than three decades. The institute is the origin of robotics research in Denmark and has spawned the world-renowned cluster of robotics in Odense with more than 130 robotics companies including Universal Robots and Mobile Industrial Robots. Building on our expertise in AI, robotics and software, we have raised strong research centres in related domains, such as Health Informatics and Energy Informatics, Drones and other relevant research areas.

SDU Applied AI and Data Science (SDU-AID)

SDU Applied AI and Data Science is one of MMMI’s 12 units and conducts interdisciplinary research in artificial intelligence and data science within the medical and energy sector, where we apply artificial intelligence and data science to improve procedures, provide information for decision makers and gain new knowledge.

SDU-AID’s backgrounds span from pure science (including mathematics and physics) to applied disciplines (such as biostatistics, epidemiology, computer science, and engineering). This gives the team a broad perspective on researching new, innovative solutions in a variety of fields.

The focus lies on the application of artificial intelligence and data science to advance research and provide data-driven solutions within the medical and energy sectors. Due to our long presence at SDU, we have established over the years strong collaborations with clinical researchers and companies, both in Denmark and abroad. Together with our collaborators, we are improving the way of handling and gaining insight from data, therefore creating knowledge and value for society. 

 

Additional information

For further information about being a fellow at DIAS, please contact DIAS director Sten Rynning at +45 6550 2193 or via email at director-dias@sdu.dk.

For more questions about the position, please contact Head of Unit, Professor Nadimi at esi@mmmi.sdu.dk.

 

Application, salary, and employment terms

The candidate will be attached to SDU Applied AI and Data Science Unit in Odense and is also expected to participate in DIAS activities and interdisciplinary cooperation in Odense regularly.
The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for tenure track assistant professor as described herein. Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”. 

Further information on salary and taxation.

The tenure track programme the Faculty of Engineering is aimed at the most talented scholars who have established a high level in their current research and other professional work, and those who possess exceptional potential to achieve the highest international level within their research area. Candidates enter the assistant professor level (for up to 6 years) and, upon successful completion, will be promoted to a permanent position of associate professor, subject to a positive assessment by an expert committee. Indicators of relevant scholarly merits include documented independent scholarly output, ground-breaking publications, achievement of excellence grants, and international research network.


Teaching obligations will be reduced compared to a standard professorship at SDU, allowing more time for research and leadership activities.

To qualify for the position, you must have obtained a PhD or similar degree by the application deadline. 

 

Application requirements
The application must include the following:

  • Letter of motivation that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position.

  • Detailed CV including documentation of experience, and contacts for possible references. 

  • An elaborate research and funding plan (max 4 pages) for the next three years including a description of synergy with the department's activities and the potential to benefit from DIAS’s interdisciplinary environment.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications, indicating which publications are most relevant for the position.

  • Up to five of the most relevant research articles – if you submit a monograph, it counts as 3 articles. Please upload a pdf for each publication. For co-authored publications, briefly describe the extent of the co-authorship or your contribution to the publications (please do this for each co-authored publication). You can do so by using this form or by describing the co-authorship in such a way that the committee can assess the extent of your contribution.

  • Teaching Portfolio as documentation for teaching and learning experience as well as supervision qualifications. Any format is acceptable, but you can find inspiration for structuring your teaching portfolio on the Faculty's teaching portfolio page.

All application materials must be submitted in English, and only applications written in English will be considered.

We recommend that international applicants take the time to visit websites of Work in Denmark and the International Staff Office at SDU. Here you can find information and facts about moving to, working and living in Denmark.

 

Submission guidelines

  • All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be protected by password. 

  • Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

Assessment

Shortlisting may be used as part of the assessment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU.

Assessment of applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicant will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. 

Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation and references may be obtained. 

 

About SDU
SDU is committed to fostering a diverse staff that reflects society’s diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background.
SDU was founded in 1966 and now has over 27,000 students, nearly 20% of whom are international. SDU employs more than 3,800 staff and offers 115 study programmes across disciplines such as the humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, health sciences, and engineering. While SDU’s main campus is in Odense, it also has campuses in other locations.

 

Equal opportunity employment
The University of Southern Denmark is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, or any other protected status.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes our staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.



How to apply
Applications must be submitted electronically via the "Apply online" link provided in the job posting.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

The application deadline is September 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST)

jobs.title: Mid-Market Outcomes Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion

 - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the  opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals

 - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews

 - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion

 - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system

 - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 5+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working

 - Native level Japanese, business level English




NICE TO HAVES

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s  Global Recruiting Privacy Policy.  https://dev.notion.so/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: MAX  søker skiftleder
jobs.description:
Max er Sveriges eldste og mest likte hamburgerkjede! Vi startet allerede i 1968 i Gällivare i Sverige. Det gjør familiebedriften vår til en av de hamburgerkjedene som har eksistert lengst i hele Europa. 12. mai 2011 åpnet Max sin første restaurant i Oslo i Norge. Ambisjonen er den samme som for 50 år siden – med de beste råvarene skal vi servere de beste hamburgerne.

Vi vil bli verdens beste burgerkjede, og vi vet at veien dit går gjennom engasjerte ledere, sterke team, god service og virkelig gode burgere. Nå søker vi deg som vil ta første steg i lederkarrieren din og være med på å skape serviceopplevelser i verdensklasse ved hvert besøk. 

Som skiftleder hos MAX er du en nøkkelperson i restaurantens daglige arbeid. Du leder teamet på stedet, sørger for at gjestene får best mulig opplevelse, og at restauranten alltid leverer på topp – både når det gjelder kvalitet, tempo og service. Du har oversikt over hele virksomheten: fra kjøkken og kasse til servering og uteområder. Sammen med kollegaene dine skaper du en arbeidsplass der arbeidsglede, fellesskap og utvikling står i sentrum. 

Vi søker deg som er serviceinnstilt, trives i høyt tempo og har en naturlig evne til å inspirere andre. Du er et forbilde som leder ved å være til stede, engasjert og løsningsorientert. Du liker å se kollegaene dine vokse og utvikle seg, og du forstår viktigheten av alltid å sette gjesten i fokus. 

 

Hovedarbeidsoppgaver 

  • Lede og coache teamet i det daglige arbeidet 
  • Sikre at gjestene får en serviceopplevelse i verdensklasse 
  • Planlegge, bemanne og lære opp innenfor restaurantens ulike områder 
  • Ha oversikt over kjøkken, kasse, restaurantområde og uteområde 
  • Bidra til at restauranten er ren, ryddig og innbydende 
  • Jobbe aktivt med våre verdier: Mot, Lidenskap og Fellesskap 

 

Hva tilbyr vi? 

  • En jobb med høyt tempo og gode utviklingsmuligheter 
  • Intern opplæring og mulighet til å søke vårt utdanningsprogram for fremtidige restaurantsjefer 
  • Varierende arbeidstider – dag, kveld, natt og helg 
  • Lønn og vilkår i henhold til tariffavtale samt ledertillegg 
  • En arbeidsplass der alle har like muligheter, rettigheter og plikter

jobs.title: AI Agent Security Architect
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the Role

We are looking for an AI Agent Security Architect to function as the primary technical

authority for Replit’s autonomous and AI agent security blueprint. In this critical role, you

will design, implement, and maintain the runtime defense systems, guardrail

frameworks, and sandboxing architectures that govern AI agents executing code,

invoking tools, and reasoning across our platform. You will be a key technical

contributor—leading high-impact AI security initiatives and bridging the gap between

non-deterministic AI behavior and rigorous cybersecurity controls for both engineering

and executive leadership.



What You'll Do

 - AI Agent Security Strategy & Technical Execution

 - AI Agent Security Blueprint: Define the long-term vision and architectural patterns for securing autonomous agent workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, multi-turn reasoning loops, and multi-agent coordination.

 - Runtime Guardrails & Policy Enforcement: Architect and deploy dynamic input/output guardrail systems, semantic firewalls, and real-time intent verification filters to prevent goal hijacking, system prompt leaks, and indirect prompt injections.

 - Agent Execution & Tool Sandboxing: Partner with Infrastructure and AppSec teams to design secure, short-lived, micro-isolated environments (e.g., microVMs, WebAssembly, container sandboxes) where agents can dynamically execute code, run shell commands, and interact with host operating systems safely.

 - Agentic Threat Modeling & Red Teaming: Conduct specialized threat modeling against non-deterministic systems. Lead automated and manual AI red-teaming initiatives to uncover vulnerabilities in RAG context pipelines, vector stores, and tool-calling interfaces.

 - Identity, Delegation & Least Privilege: Architect fine-grained permission models and step-up Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) authorization patterns for agents acting on behalf of users—ensuring agents never exceed the delegated privileges of the end user or misuse API keys.

 - Context & Memory Boundary Security: Design strict data isolation and poisoning prevention controls for vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and long-term conversation memories across multi-tenant workloads.

 - Risk Management & Cross-Functional Enablement

 - Maintain the AI Security Source of Truth: Define, document, and maintain authoritative secure design patterns and SDKs for engineering teams building internal or customer-facing AI agent capabilities.

 - Contribution to Risk Register: Identify, quantify, and document non-deterministic and agentic security risks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs & AI Agents, MITRE ATLAS), ensuring they are accurately represented in the Cybersecurity Risk Register.

 - Auditability & Observability: Design tamper-evident logging and telemetry standards for agent reasoning chains, tool execution history, and context assembly to support incident response, forensics, and GRC requirements.

 - Compliance & Sales Enablement: Partner with GRC to translate complex AI security controls into enterprise-ready audit documentation (e.g., ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act readiness) and support Sales on complex enterprise security inquiries regarding AI safety.

Required Skills & Experience

 - 6+ years of experience in security engineering or security architecture, with at least 2+ years dedicated specifically to AI/ML security, LLM application security, or securing agentic frameworks.

 - Deep understanding of agentic architectures and protocols (e.g., Model Context. Protocol (MCP), LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, ReAct frameworks, and vector database technologies).

 - Hands-on expertise with threat vectors unique to agentic AI: Indirect Prompt

 - Injection, Goal Hijacking, Tool Parameter Tampering, Data Poisoning, and Context Contamination.

 - Strong background in applying safety standards and risk frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 for LLMs & AI Agents, NIST AI RMF, and MITRE ATLAS.

 - Proficiency in Python, Go, or TypeScript/JavaScript with a proven track record of reviewing code and building functional security tooling or guardrails.

 - Experience authoring, maintaining, and evangelizing technical security architecture documentation.

 - Exceptional ability to communicate complex non-deterministic AI risks to both deep technical engineers and executive stakeholders.

 - Proven track record of contributing to an enterprise Cybersecurity Risk Register.

Bonus Qualifications

 - Experience designing runtime sandboxing and isolation technologies (e.g., Firecracker, gVisor, Docker, WebAssembly) for dynamic code execution environments.





Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

jobs.title: Daglig leder – skap trivsel & drift i Bodøs største legesenter
jobs.description:
Sentrumslegene Bodø AS søker en dyktig og engasjert daglig leder. Stillingen er todelt med 50% daglig leder-funksjon og 50% pasientrettet arbeid.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi søker primært autorisert helsesekretær med ledererfaring, men personer med relevant helsefaglig utdanning vil også bli vurdert.

Vi ønsker en samlende leder som kan arbeide for en god arbeidshverdag for alle.

  • Du har god evne til å kommunisere og samarbeide med andre

  • Du liker å arbeid i team, men har også evne til å arbeide selvstendig og til å ta ansvar for egne vurdering

  • Du har gode samarbeidsevner og arbeidslyst

  • Du er fleksibel i forhold til arbeidsoppgaver, viser handlekraft og evne til å beholde roen i stressende situasjoner

  • Du er faglig dyktig, har et godt klinisk blikk og vet å prioritere pasienter som trenger det mest

  • Du mestrer norsk muntlig og skriftlig

Faglig dyktighet og personlig egnethet vektlegges.

  • I samarbeid med styret, kontinuerlig jobbe med gjennomføring av visjon, målsettinger og strategier

  • Konkurransedyktig lønn

  • Et moderne legesenter med høy kompetanse, interessante arbeidsoppgaver og et godt arbeidsmiljø

Sentrumslegene er et hyggelig legesenter med ca 8 000 pasienter og høyt aktivitetsnivå. Vi er 8 leger og 6 helsesekretærer. Vi holder til i store og moderne lokaler sentralt i Bodø sentrum.

Vi har Pridok som journalsystem og kontrakt med ekstern IT-konsulent som har ansvar for data og telefoni.

Vi har tett samarbeid med regnskapsfører for betaling av fakturaer, bilagshåndtering, lønnsarbeid, hjelp til budsjett m.v.

Aukštojo inžinerinio arba techninio išsilavinimo.

jobs.title: Legal Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Legal Operations Manager at Replit, you will be the central point of contact for legal requests across the company and the operational backbone of our contract lifecycle. You will triage and manage incoming legal requests, own contract management end to end, and support broader corporate compliance and data privacy work. Your meticulous attention to detail and proactive approach will keep legal operations running smoothly and reduce risk across the business.

Think of yourself as the air traffic controller of our legal universe — making sure every contract, request, and approval lands safely, on time, and in the right hands. Your meticulous attention to detail and proactive approach will not just keep Legal running smoothly — it will make the whole company move faster.

If you love building systems, closing loops, and being the person everyone turns to when they need to get something done right, this role was made for you.

 
 


WHAT YOU'LL DO:



Legal Operations

 - Drive the Legal team's operational strategy, understand operational challenges, identify opportunities to improve systems and workflows

 - Implement, maintain, and optimize a best in class AI driven tech stack. Partner cross functionally with AI and GTM/marketing/partnerships teams to identify technologies, negotiate with vendors, and drive implementation.

 - Partner closely with Finance and Legal leadership to manage budget, forecasting, accruals, and track spend

 - Working closely with leadership, own planning cycles, OKRs, and data reporting and metrics

 - Manage outside counsel relationships, including new engagements, billing guidelines invoicing, and e-billing. Drive outside counsel management strategy with a focus on cost discipline and operational accountability

 - Build and maintain knowledge management platforms and learning and development programs that keep the team current and operating effectively.

 - Run the day-to-day operations of the Legal & team, driving efficiencies that enable the team to perform its best work (for example, manage vendors, contract signatures, attorney memberships, internal practice guidelines, expenses, team meetings).



Contract Lifecycle Management

 - Serve as the primary intake point for legal requests, triaging by urgency and complexity and routing to the right owner

 - Organize and consolidate incoming legal requests into a centralized tracking system

 - Handle baseline legal reviews and approvals directly, escalating complex or high-risk matters to legal counsel

 - Develop and maintain tooling and processes to track requests, contracts, and deadlines

 - Track responsible managers and renewal deadlines

 - Manage contract templates and organization (Vendor MSA, NDAs, offer letters)

 - Implement and maintain safeguards



Corporate and Compliance Matters

 - Assist in strategic corporate transactions, including due diligence and virtual data room building

 - Support post-closing integrations and follow-ups

 - Manage annual filings, updates, and deadline tracking

 - Prepare and update internal company policies

 - Prepare and update team trainings on legal issue spotting, privacy, governance, and HR

 - Track and implement updates to website and privacy policy terms

 - Organize and maintain general records

 - Prepare checklists and provide project support as needed



Data Privacy

 - Track data subject requests (deletions) and assist preparing transparency reporting

 - Organize and maintain data maps

 - Coordinate and track data protection impact assessments



Required Skills & Experience

 - Minimum of 5 years of proven legal administrative experience

 - Motivation to grow and expand knowledge base

 - Strong attention to detail and proofreading ability

 - Ability to prioritize multiple tasks simultaneously and work independently to complete tasks within given deadlines



Bonus Points

 - High growth startup experience

 - Experience building out lean legal teams to carry out corporate responsibilities

 



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.description:
Position Title: Produce Clerk - Full Time

Position Type: Full time

Job Requisition ID: 49560

Banner: Food Basics

Employment Type: Permanent

This position is part of a unionized bargaining unit. The hourly wage for this position starts at $18.00 - $21.35 and is established in accordance with the collective agreement. Depending on a candidateâs relevant knowledge, skills, education, and prior experience, a higher hourly wage may be offered. Any hourly wage offered for this role, whether starting or higher, will fall within the wage scale established for this position in accordance with the collective agreement.

This is a posting for an existing permanent full-time position

Experience a rewarding role at Food Basics as a Produce Clerk! You'll be the go-to person for ensuring our produce section is always fresh, well-stocked, and beautifully presented. Share your enthusiasm for fresh fruits and vegetables with our customers and help them find exactly what they need.

Our produce team is crucial to Food Basics' success, and we're looking for energetic individuals who love working with fresh food and enjoy helping others. If you thrive in a lively environment and are passionate about quality produce, we want you on our team!

What Youâll Do

  • Unload shipments of produce and sort items in the backroom and cooler.
  • Stock shelves and displays with fresh produce, ensuring items are rotated (first-in, first-out method) to maintain freshness.
  • Create visually appealing displays and arrange items neatly.
  • Inspect produce for freshness and quality, removing any damaged or spoiled items.
  • Ensure that all produce meets the store's quality standards.
  • Monitor temperature and humidity levels in the produce section to maintain optimal storage conditions.
  • Assist customers with locating specific items and provide information about different produce or products in other departments.
  • Offer recommendations on how to select and store produce.
  • Answer customer inquiries and address concerns.
  • Keep the produce section clean and organized, including sweeping and mopping as needed.
  • Clean and sanitize work areas, equipment, and tools regularly.
  • Dispose of waste and compostable materials properly.
  • Monitor inventory levels and restock items as needed.
  • Perform regular inventory counts and report any discrepancies.
  • Notify management of low stock or out-of-stock items.
  • Ensure all produce is correctly labeled with prices and product information.
  • Update signage for promotions, sales, and seasonal items.
  • Verify that prices in the system match the displayed prices.
  • Reduce and price items as needed.
  • Adhere to food safety and sanitation guidelines.
  • Use equipment and tools safely and properly.
  • Report any safety concerns or incidents to management.
  • Assist with gathering shopping carts or baskets and putting them away when needed.
  • Assist with special promotions, events, or projects as assigned by management.
  • Collaborate with other departments as needed.
  • Additional duties assigned by Management.

Qualifications

  • Customer service driven.
  • Able to stock merchandise and create displays.
  • Good product knowledge and attention to detail.
  • Able to lift between 30 to 50 pounds.
  • Retail experience is considered an asset.
  • Able to stand for extend periods of time.
  • Must be available to work flexible shifts which may include nights, weekends and holidays.

The responsibilities and relationships assigned to this role may change as is necessary to achieve Metro's business objectives.

jobs.title: Head of MI & Reporting (m/f)
jobs.description:
Head of MI & Reporting
Finance - Group - UI0801 - Senningerberg, Luxembourg (Hybrid)

About Waystone  

Waystone is a leading asset-servicing solutions provider of institutional governance, administration, risk and compliance services to financial institutions. With over 25 years' experience and a comprehensive range of specialist services to its name, Waystone helps our clients structure, operate and grow through our expertise, innovation and digitisation, backed by the operational scale to support global expansion.

Summary:

The Head of MI & Reporting is the engine room of Group FP&A's management information function. The role owns the monthly MI cycle end-to-end  from data aggregation and system integrity through to investor-grade reporting and executive presentations- and leads two direct reports in delivering that cycle with rigour and consistency. Critically, this role is the integrating layer between the FP&A business partners and the broader finance function. Success depends on aligning inputs across the team, driving standardisation in how we aggregate and analyse large data sets, and ensuring that reporting outputs are consistently high-quality, actionable and suited to an executive audience.
          
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

MI & Investor Reporting

• Own the monthly Group MI pack end-to-end: production, commentary, quality control and delivery to FP&A leadership, Waystone Executive team and investors, on time and to a consistently high standard.
• Lead all standard investor reporting on a monthly, quarterly and annual basis; manage ad-hoc queries from investors promptly and accurately.
• Own the Group reporting calendar, ensuring all key reporting requirements are known, tracked and executed by the FP&A team.
• Produce flash revenue reporting across legal entities, countries and product structures, with KPI and trend analysis that gives management a clear and timely read on performance.

FP&A Systems, Data & analytics

• Own the FP&A systems and toolset, ensuring data is well-controlled, models are scalable, and that new data sources are integrated in a structured and controlled way.
• Ensuring that the structuring of our data leads to improvements in our data quality/governance, and also surfaces relevant data in a more impactful way
• Comfortable with driving finance systems & finance process efficiency. You will identify and drive positive change to system structures and related processes which will support FP&A in raising our level.
• Experienced in driving automation in financial processes, and curious about the deployment of AI tooling to support efficiencies or deeper insights.
• Drive standardisation across the team in how we aggregate and analyse large data sets, reducing reliance on fragmented individual processes and moving to consistent, repeatable approaches.
• Coordinate the wider FP&A team to engage with Financial Control with the goal of addressing potential General Ledger integrity issues or identifying improvements to ERP data entry to enhance reporting.
• Work with relevant departments to gather client revenue and cost of sales data for analytical purposes, building reliable data flows that FP&A can depend on.

Revenue Analysis & Forward-Looking Insight

• Deliver monthly analysis on Opportunities, Wins and Onboarding to provide forward-looking insight into revenue trends and the pipeline impact on future performance.
• Connect revenue run-rate and ARR outputs (built by the wider FP&A team) into the MI reporting suite so that executives have a consistent view of both current and forward performance.
• Identify performance trends, anomalies and risks in the data and surface these with clear, well-evidenced commentary in the MI materials.

Budgeting & Forecasting

• Partner across FP&A and broader Finance function to co-ordinate the annual budget process for revenue and cost of sales, ensuring alignment of inputs and consistent methodology.
• Co-ordinate the quarterly revenue and cost of sales forecasting process with the country business partners.
• Prepare high-quality presentation materials to support budgeting and forecasting conversations with senior stakeholders.

Business Partnering & Coordination

• Act as the integrating layer between FP&A business partners and the MI function - aligning inputs, resolving data conflicts, ensuring all FP&A output is consistent across the various reporting layers and ensuring that what goes into the monthly pack reflects a single, agreed version of the truth.
• Collaborate with Country and Product leadership to provide financial guidance and ensure MI outputs are relevant, actionable and understood by the business.
• Build and maintain strong working relationships with all key internal and external stakeholders, including investors and senior leadership.

Team Leadership

• Lead and develop a team of two, setting clear priorities, defining reporting outputs and creating an environment where the team can do their best work.
• Continuously evolve how the team measures and presents performance, always seeking to increase the actionable impact of the analysis.
• Raise the bar on presentation quality across the team, ensuring all outputs - whether for internal leadership or external investors — are executive-ready.

REQUIREMENTS

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Experience:

• 10+ years post-qualified finance experience, with a meaningful proportion in FP&A or financial reporting in a complex, multi-entity environment.
• Proven track record of producing high-quality MI and management reporting for a senior or executive audience.
• Experience owning or managing financial planning and reporting systems, with a strong understanding of data flows and model architecture.
• Demonstrable ability to work with large, complex data sets- extracting insight, identifying anomalies and communicating findings clearly.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to translate complex financial analysis into clear, commercially relevant messaging for non-finance audiences.
• Experience managing and developing direct reports.
• Advanced Excel and Microsoft Office proficiency.

Desirable

• Experience with Power BI, Power Automate or similar BI and automation tooling; a track record of improving reporting efficiency through technology.
• Familiarity with Sage Intacct, Adaptive Planning or Salesforce.
• Experience in financial services, asset management or a similarly data-intensive, multi-jurisdiction business.

Education:

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field.
• Professional accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or international equivalent) preferred

Please apply via webiste.
